text: Bhāgavata Purāṇa: Kapila's Upadeśa to Devahūti (Skandha 3, chapters 25-33)

units.sanskrit:
राजोवाच-
कपिलस्तत्त्वसङ्ख्याता भगवानात्ममायया। जातः स्वयमजः साक्षादात्मप्रज्ञप्तये नृणाम्॥ ३/२६/१॥
units.english: [Text 1] Śaunaka said: Although He is unborn, the Lord took birth as Kapila Muni by His internal potency. He descended to disseminate transcendental knowledge for the benefit of the whole human race.

english_edits.rule: honorific Śrī before a name removed
(the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 1] Śrī Śaunaka said: Although He is unborn, the Supreme Personality of Godhead took birth as Kapila Muni by His internal potency. He descended to disseminate transcendental knowledge for the benefit of the whole human race.

units.sanskrit: अर्हस्य धर्मिणां पुंसां गरिम्णः सर्वयोगिनाम्। विश्रुतौ श्रुतदेवस्य भूरि तृप्यन्ति मेऽसवः॥ ३/२६/२॥
units.english: [Text 2] Śaunaka continued: There is no one who knows more than the Lord Himself. No one is more worshipable or more mature a yogī than He. He is therefore the master of the Vedas, and to hear about Him always is the actual pleasure of the senses.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 2] Śaunaka continued: There is no one who knows more than the Lord Himself. No one is more worshipable or more mature a yogī than He. He is therefore the master of the Vedas, and to hear about Him always is the actual pleasure of the senses.

units.sanskrit: यद्यद् विधत्ते भगवान् स्वच्छन्दात्माऽऽत्ममायया। तानि मे श्रद्धधानस्य कार्तन्यान्यनुकार्तय॥ ३/२६/३॥
units.english: [Text 3] Therefore please precisely describe all the activities and pastimes of the Lord, who is full of self-desire and who assumes all these activities by His internal potency.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 3] Therefore please precisely describe all the activities and pastimes of the Personality of Godhead, who is full of self-desire and who assumes all these activities by His internal potency.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीशुक उवाच-
द्वैपायनसखश्चैवं मैत्रेयो भगवांस्तथा। प्राहेदं विदुरं प्रीत आन्वीक्षिक्यां प्रचोदितः॥ ३/२६/४॥
units.english: [Text 4] Sūta Paurāṇika said: The most powerful sage Maitreya was a friend of Vyāsadeva. Being encouraged and pleased by Vidura’s inquiry about transcendental knowledge, Maitreya spoke as follows.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 4] Śrī Sūta Gosvāmī said: The most powerful sage Maitreya was a friend of Vyāsadeva. Being encouraged and pleased by Vidura’s inquiry about transcendental knowledge, Maitreya spoke as follows.

units.sanskrit: पितरि प्रस्थितेऽरण्यं मातुः प्रियचिकार्षया। तस्मिन् बिन्दुसरेऽवात्सीद् भगवान् कपिलः किल॥ ३/२६/५॥
units.english: [Text 5] Maitreya said: When Kardama left for the forest, Lord Kapila stayed on the strand of the Bindu-sarovara to please His mother, Devahūti.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 5] Maitreya said: When Kardama left for the forest, Lord Kapila stayed on the strand of the Bindu-sarovara to please His mother, Devahūti.

units.sanskrit: तमासीनमकर्माणं तत्त्वमार्गाग्य्रदर्शनम्। स्वसुतं देवहूत्याह धातुः संस्मरती वचः॥ ३/२६/६॥
units.english: [Text 6] When Kapila, who could show her the ultimate goal of the Absolute Truth, was sitting leisurely before her, Devahūti remembered the words Brahmā had spoken to her, and she therefore began to question Kapila as follows.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 6] When Kapila, who could show her the ultimate goal of the Absolute Truth, was sitting leisurely before her, Devahūti remembered the words Brahmā had spoken to her, and she therefore began to question Kapila as follows.

units.sanskrit:
देवहूतिरुवाच-
निर्विण्णाऽऽतितरां भूमन्नसदिन्द्रियतर्पणात्। येन सम्भाव्यमानेन प्रपन्नाऽन्धतमः प्रभो॥ ३/२६/७॥
units.english: [Text 7] Devahūti said: I am very sick of the disturbance caused by my material senses, for because of this sense disturbance, my Lord, I have fallen into the abyss of ignorance.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 7] Devahūti said: I am very sick of the disturbance caused by my material senses, for because of this sense disturbance, my Lord, I have fallen into the abyss of ignorance.

units.sanskrit: तस्य त्वं तमसोऽन्धस्य दुष्पारस्याद्य पारगः। सच्चक्षुर्जन्मनामन्ते लब्धं मे त्वदनुग्रहात्॥ ३/२६/८॥
units.english: [Text 8] Your Lordship is my only means of getting out of this darkest region of ignorance because You are my transcendental eye, which, by Your mercy only, I have attained after many, many births.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 8] Your Lordship is my only means of getting out of this darkest region of ignorance because You are my transcendental eye, which, by Your mercy only, I have attained after many, many births.

units.sanskrit: य आद्यो भगवान् पुंसामीश्वरो वै भवान् किल। लोकस्य तमसाऽन्धस्य चक्षुः सूर्य इवोदितः॥ ३/२६/९॥
units.english: [Text 9] You are the Lord, the origin and Supreme Lord of all living beings. You have arisen to disseminate the rays of the sun in order to dissipate the darkness of the ignorance of the universe.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 9] You are the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the origin and Supreme Lord of all living entities. You have arisen to disseminate the rays of the sun in order to dissipate the darkness of the ignorance of the universe.

units.sanskrit: अथ मे देव सम्मोहमपाक्रष्टुं त्वमर्हसि। योऽवग्रहोऽहम्ममेतीत्येतस्मिन् योजितस्त्वया॥ ३/२६/१०॥
units.english: [Text 10] Now be pleased, my Lord, to dispel my great delusion. Due to my feeling of false ego, I have been engaged by Your māyā and have identified myself with the body and consequent bodily relations.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 10] Now be pleased, my Lord, to dispel my great delusion. Due to my feeling of false ego, I have been engaged by Your māyā and have identified myself with the body and consequent bodily relations.

units.sanskrit: तं त्वा गताऽहं शरणं शरण्यं स्वभृत्यसंसारतरोः कुठारम्। जिज्ञासया प्रकृतेः पूरुषस्य नमामि सद्धर्मविदां वरिष्ठम्॥ ३/२६/११॥
units.english: [Text 11] Devahūti continued: I have taken shelter of Your lotus feet because You are the only person of whom to take shelter. You are the ax which can cut the tree of material existence. I therefore offer my obeisances unto You, who are the greatest of all transcendentalists, and I inquire from You as to the relationship between man and woman and between spirit and matter.

parts.sanskrit: तं त्वा गताऽहं शरणं शरण्यं स्वभृत्यसंसारतरोः कुठारम्। जिज्ञासया प्रकृतेः पूरुषस्य नमामि सद्धर्मविदां वरिष्ठम्॥ ३/२६/११॥

“नारायणो ब्रह्मवायू वीन्द्रशेषौ हरस्तथा।
कामः शक्रो गुरुर्दक्षो मन्वाद्या भास्करादयः।
सर्वजीवाश्च क्रमशः पुरुषाख्याभिशब्दिताः।
एतत्पत्न्यो बन्धशक्तिः स्त्रियः सर्वास्तथा जडम्।
क्रमात् प्रकृतिशब्दोक्तास्तज्ज्ञानाद् विप्रमुच्यते॥”
इति दत्तात्रेययोगे॥ ११॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 11] Devahūti continued: I have taken shelter of Your lotus feet because You are the only person of whom to take shelter. You are the ax which can cut the tree of material existence. I therefore offer my obeisances unto You, who are the greatest of all transcendentalists, and I inquire from You as to the relationship between man and woman and between spirit and matter.

units.sanskrit:
मैत्रेय उवाच-
इति स्वमातुर्निरवद्यमीप्सितं निशम्य पुंसामपवर्गचोदनम्। धियाऽभिनन्द्यात्मवतां सतां गतिर्बभाष ईषत्स्मितशोभिताननः॥ ३/२६/१२॥
units.english: [Text 12] Maitreya said: After hearing of His mother’s uncontaminated desire for transcendental realization, the Lord thanked her within Himself for her questions, and thus, His face smiling, He explained the path of the transcendentalists, who are interested in self-realization.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 12] Maitreya said: After hearing of His mother’s uncontaminated desire for transcendental realization, the Lord thanked her within Himself for her questions, and thus, His face smiling, He explained the path of the transcendentalists, who are interested in self-realization.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच-
योग आध्यात्मिकः पुंसां मतो निःश्रेयसाय मे। अत्यन्तोपरतिर्यत्र दुःखस्य च सुखस्य च॥ ३/२६/१३॥
units.english: [Text 13] The Lord answered: The yoga system which relates to the Lord and the individual soul, which is meant for the ultimate benefit of the living being, and which causes detachment from all happiness and distress in the material world, is the highest yoga system.

parts.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच-
योग आध्यात्मिकः पुंसां मतो निःश्रेयसाय मे। अत्यन्तोपरतिर्यत्र दुःखस्य च सुखस्य च॥ ३/२६/१३॥

“परमात्मादिकं देहे यदध्यात्मं तदीरितम्” इति च।
“सुखं शरीरभोग्यं तु दुःखं सर्वं तथैव च।
मुक्तौ विलयमायाति नित्यानन्दस्तु भुज्यते॥”
इति च॥ १३॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 13] The Personality of Godhead answered: The yoga system which relates to the Lord and the individual soul, which is meant for the ultimate benefit of the living entity, and which causes detachment from all happiness and distress in the material world, is the highest yoga system.

units.sanskrit: तमिमं ते प्रवक्ष्यामि यमवोचं पुराऽनघे। ऋषीणां श्रोतुकामानां योगमुर्वङ्गनैपुणम्॥ ३/२६/१४॥
units.english: [Text 14] O most pious mother, I shall now explain unto you the ancient yoga system, which I explained formerly to the great sages. It is serviceable and practical in every way.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 14] O most pious mother, I shall now explain unto you the ancient yoga system, which I explained formerly to the great sages. It is serviceable and practical in every way.

units.sanskrit: चेतः खल्वस्य बन्धाय मुक्तये चात्मनो मतम्। गुणेषु सक्तं बन्धाय तेष्वसक्तं हि मुक्तये॥ ३/२६/१५॥
units.english: [Text 15] The stage in which the consciousness of the living being is attracted by the three modes of material nature is called conditional life. But when that same consciousness is attached to the Lord, one is situated in the consciousness of liberation.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 15] The stage in which the consciousness of the living entity is attracted by the three modes of material nature is called conditional life. But when that same consciousness is attached to the Supreme Personality of Godhead, one is situated in the consciousness of liberation.

units.sanskrit: अहम्ममाभिमानोत्थैः कामलोभादिभिर्मलैः। वीतं यदा मनः शुद्धमदुःखमसुखं समम्॥ ३/२६/१६॥
units.english: [Text 16] When one is completely cleansed of the impurities of lust and greed produced from the false identification of the body as “I” and bodily possessions as “mine,” one’s mind becomes purified. In that pure state he transcends the stage of so-called material happiness and distress.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 16] When one is completely cleansed of the impurities of lust and greed produced from the false identification of the body as “I” and bodily possessions as “mine,” one’s mind becomes purified. In that pure state he transcends the stage of so-called material happiness and distress.

units.sanskrit: तदा पुरुष आत्मानं केवलं प्रकृतेः परम्। निरन्तरं स्वयञ्ज्योतिरणिमानमखण्डितम्॥ ३/२६/१७॥
units.english: [Text 17] At that time the soul can see himself to be transcendental to material existence and always self-effulgent, never fragmented, although very minute in size.

parts.sanskrit: तदा पुरुष आत्मानं केवलं प्रकृतेः परम्। निरन्तरं स्वयञ्ज्योतिरणिमानमखण्डितम्॥ ३/२६/१७॥

“बाह्ये सुखे त्वनासक्तेरसुखं दुःखवर्जनात्।
अदुःखं हरिभक्त्यैव नित्यानन्दं यदा मनः।
तदा तं परमात्मानं पश्यत्यात्मप्रसादतः॥”
इति कापिलेये।
“अभेदात् स्वावतारेषु निरन्तर उदाहृतः।
गुणदेहेन्द्रियाभेदात् केवलोऽसदृशत्वतः।
अखण्डः पूर्णशक्तित्वादहमेकः
सदा मतः
॥”
इति च॥ १६-१७॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 17] At that time the soul can see himself to be transcendental to material existence and always self-effulgent, never fragmented, although very minute in size.

units.sanskrit: ज्ञानवैराग्ययुक्तेन भक्तियोगेन चात्मना। परिपश्यत्युदासीनां प्रकृतिं च हतौजसम्॥ ३/२६/१८॥
units.english: [Text 18] In that position of self-realization, by practice of knowledge and renunciation in devotion, one sees everything in the right perspective; he becomes indifferent to material existence, and the material influence acts less powerfully upon him.

parts.sanskrit: ज्ञानवैराग्ययुक्तेन भक्तियोगेन चात्मना। परिपश्यत्युदासीनां प्रकृतिं च हतौजसम्॥ ३/२६/१८॥
“बन्धशक्तिः प्रकृत्याख्या विष्णुशक्त्या वियुज्यते” इति च॥ १८॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 18] In that position of self-realization, by practice of knowledge and renunciation in devotional service, one sees everything in the right perspective; he becomes indifferent to material existence, and the material influence acts less powerfully upon him.

units.sanskrit: न युज्यमानया भक्त्या भगवत्यखिलात्मनि। सदृशोऽस्ति शिवः पन्था योगिनां ब्रह्मसिद्धये॥ ३/२६/१९॥
units.english: [Text 19] Perfection in self-realization cannot be attained by any kind of yogī unless he engages in devotion to the Lord, for that is the only auspicious path.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 19] Perfection in self-realization cannot be attained by any kind of yogī unless he engages in devotional service to the Supreme Personality of Godhead, for that is the only auspicious path.

units.sanskrit: प्रसङ्गमजरं पाशमात्मनः कवयो विदुः। स एव साधुषु कृतो मोक्षद्वारमपावृतम्॥ ३/२६/२०॥
units.english: [Text 20] Every learned man knows very well that attachment for the material is the greatest entanglement of the spirit soul. But that same attachment, when applied to the self-realized devotees, opens the door of liberation.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 20] Every learned man knows very well that attachment for the material is the greatest entanglement of the spirit soul. But that same attachment, when applied to the self-realized devotees, opens the door of liberation.

units.sanskrit: तितिक्षवः कारुणिकाः सुहृदः सर्वदेहिनाम्। अजातशत्रवः शान्ताः साधवः साधुभूषणाः॥ ३/२६/२१॥
units.english: [Text 21] The symptoms of a sādhu are that he is tolerant, merciful and friendly to all living beings. He has no enemies, he is peaceful, he abides by the scriptures, and all his characteristics are sublime.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 21] The symptoms of a sādhu are that he is tolerant, merciful and friendly to all living entities. He has no enemies, he is peaceful, he abides by the scriptures, and all his characteristics are sublime.

units.sanskrit: मय्यनन्येन भावेन भक्तिं कुर्वन्ति ये दृढाम्। मत्कृते त्यक्तकर्माणस्त्यक्तस्वजनबान्धवाः॥ ३/२६/२२॥
units.english: [Text 22] Such a sādhu engages in staunch devotion to the Lord without deviation. For the sake of the Lord he renounces all other connections, such as family relationships and friendly acquaintances within the world.

parts.sanskrit: मय्यनन्येन भावेन भक्तिं कुर्वन्ति ये दृढाम्। मत्कृते त्यक्तकर्माणस्त्यक्तस्वजनबान्धवाः॥ ३/२६/२२॥

“यादृशी मयि भक्तिः स्यात् तादृश्यन्यत्र नैव चेत्।
अनन्यभक्तिरुद्रेकात् सा ययैव तरेत् सृतिम्॥”
इति च॥ २२॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 22] Such a sādhu engages in staunch devotional service to the Lord without deviation. For the sake of the Lord he renounces all other connections, such as family relationships and friendly acquaintances within the world.

units.sanskrit: मदाश्रयाः कथा हृष्टाः शृण्वन्ति कथयन्ति च। तपन्ति विविधांस्तापानैकात्म्यगतचेतसः॥ ३/२६/२३॥
units.english: [Text 23] Engaged constantly in chanting and hearing about Me, the Lord, the sādhus do not suffer from material miseries because they are always filled with thoughts of My pastimes and activities.

parts.sanskrit: मदाश्रयाः कथा हृष्टाः शृण्वन्ति कथयन्ति च। तपन्ति विविधांस्तापानैकात्म्यगतचेतसः॥ ३/२६/२३॥

“एकः पूर्णो हरिर्नान्यस्तदन्ये तद्वशा मताः।
इति ज्ञानं स्थिरं यत् तदैकात्म्यज्ञानमुच्यते॥”
इति ब्रह्माण्डे॥ २३॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 23] Engaged constantly in chanting and hearing about Me, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the sādhus do not suffer from material miseries because they are always filled with thoughts of My pastimes and activities.

units.sanskrit: त एते साधवः साध्वि सर्वसङ्गविवर्जिताः। सङ्गस्तेष्वथ ते प्रार्थ्यः सङ्गदोषहरा हि ते॥ ३/२६/२४॥
units.english: [Text 24] O My mother, O virtuous lady, these are the qualities of great devotees who are free from all attachment. You must seek attachment to such holy men, for this counteracts the pernicious effects of material attachment.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 24] O My mother, O virtuous lady, these are the qualities of great devotees who are free from all attachment. You must seek attachment to such holy men, for this counteracts the pernicious effects of material attachment.

units.sanskrit: सतां प्रसङ्गान्मम वीर्यसम्पदो भवन्ति हृत्कर्णरसायनाः कथाः। तज्जोषणादाश्वपवर्गवर्त्मनि श्रद्धावती भक्तिरनुक्रमिष्यति॥ ३/२६/२५॥
units.english: [Text 25] In the association of devotees, discussion of the pastimes and activities of the Lord is very pleasing and satisfying to the ear and the heart. By cultivating such knowledge one gradually becomes advanced on the path of liberation, and thereafter he is freed, and his attraction becomes fixed. Then real devotion and devotion begin.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 25] In the association of pure devotees, discussion of the pastimes and activities of the Supreme Personality of Godhead is very pleasing and satisfying to the ear and the heart. By cultivating such knowledge one gradually becomes advanced on the path of liberation, and thereafter he is freed, and his attraction becomes fixed. Then real devotion and devotional service begin.

units.sanskrit: भक्त्या पुमान् जातविराग ऐन्द्रियाद् दृष्टश्रुतात्मद्रविणानुचिन्तया। चित्तस्य यत्तो ग्रहणे योगयुक्तो यतिष्यते ऋजुभिर्योगमार्गैः॥ ३/२६/२६॥
units.english: [Text 26] Thus consciously engaged in devotion in the association of devotees, a person gains distaste for sense enjoyment, both in this world and in the next, by constantly thinking about the activities of the Lord. This process of Kṛṣṇa consciousness is the easiest process of mystic power; when one is actually situated on that path of devotion, he is able to control the mind.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 26] Thus consciously engaged in devotional service in the association of devotees, a person gains distaste for sense gratification, both in this world and in the next, by constantly thinking about the activities of the Lord. This process of Kṛṣṇa consciousness is the easiest process of mystic power; when one is actually situated on that path of devotional service, he is able to control the mind.

units.sanskrit: असेवयाऽयं प्रकृतेर्गुणानां ज्ञानेन वैराग्यविजृम्भितेन। योगेन मय्यर्पितया च भक्त्या मां प्रत्यगात्मानमिहावरुन्धे॥ ३/२६/२७॥
units.english: [Text 27] Thus by not engaging in the service of the modes of material nature but by developing Kṛṣṇa consciousness, knowledge in renunciation, and by practicing yoga, in which the mind is always fixed in devotion unto the Lord, one achieves My association in this very life, for I am the Supreme Personality, the Absolute Truth.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 27] Thus by not engaging in the service of the modes of material nature but by developing Kṛṣṇa consciousness, knowledge in renunciation, and by practicing yoga, in which the mind is always fixed in devotional service unto the Supreme Personality of Godhead, one achieves My association in this very life, for I am the Supreme Personality, the Absolute Truth.

units.sanskrit:
देवहूतिरुवाच-
का स्वित् त्यय्यर्पिता भक्तिः कादृशी मम गोचरा। यया पदं ते निर्वाणमञ्जसा ह्यश्नवान्यहम्॥ ३/२६/२८॥
units.english: [Text 28] On hearing this statement of the Lord, Devahūti inquired: What kind of devotion is worth developing and practicing to help me easily and immediately attain the service of Your lotus feet?

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 28] On hearing this statement of the Lord, Devahūti inquired: What kind of devotional service is worth developing and practicing to help me easily and immediately attain the service of Your lotus feet?

units.sanskrit: यो योगो भगवत्प्राप्तौ निर्वाणात्मंस्त्वयोदितः। कादृशः कति चाङ्गानि यतस्तत्त्वावबोधनम्॥ ३/२६/२९॥
units.english: [Text 29] The mystic yoga system, as You have explained, aims at the Lord and is meant for completely ending material existence. Please let me know the nature of that yoga system. How many ways are there by which one can understand in truth that sublime yoga?

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 29] The mystic yoga system, as You have explained, aims at the Supreme Personality of Godhead and is meant for completely ending material existence. Please let me know the nature of that yoga system. How many ways are there by which one can understand in truth that sublime yoga?

units.sanskrit: तदेतन्मे विजानीहि यथाऽहं मन्दधीर्हरे। सुखं बुद्ध्येय दुर्बोधं योषा भवदनुग्रहात्॥ ३/२६/३०॥
units.english: [Text 30] My dear son, Kapila, after all, I am a woman. It is very difficult for me to understand the Absolute Truth because my intelligence is not very great. But if You will kindly explain it to me, even though I am not very intelligent, I can understand it and thereby feel transcendental happiness.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 30] My dear son, Kapila, after all, I am a woman. It is very difficult for me to understand the Absolute Truth because my intelligence is not very great. But if You will kindly explain it to me, even though I am not very intelligent, I can understand it and thereby feel transcendental happiness.

units.sanskrit:
मैत्रेय उवाच-
विदित्वाऽर्थं कपिलो मातुरित्थं जातस्नेहो यत्र तन्वाऽभिजातः। तत्त्वाम्नायं यत् प्रवदन्ति साङ्ख्यं प्रावोचद् वै भक्तिवितानयोगम्॥ ३/२६/३१॥
units.english: [Text 31] Maitreya said: After hearing the statement of His mother, Kapila could understand her purpose, and He became compassionate towards her because of being born of her body. He described the Sāṅkhya system of philosophy, which is a combination of devotion and mystic realization, as received by disciplic succession.

parts.sanskrit:
मैत्रेय उवाच-
विदित्वाऽर्थं कपिलो मातुरित्थं जातस्नेहो यत्र तन्वाऽभिजातः। तत्त्वाम्नायं यत् प्रवदन्ति साङ्ख्यं प्रावोचद् वै भक्तिवितानयोगम्॥ ३/२६/३१॥

“शुक्लेन जनिरन्येषां हरेः स्वतनुवैव तु।
नित्योदितज्ञानतनोः कुतः स्याच्छुक्लतो जनिः॥”
इति गारुडे॥ ३१॥

english_edits.rule: honorific Śrī before a name removed

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 31] Śrī Maitreya said: After hearing the statement of His mother, Kapila could understand her purpose, and He became compassionate towards her because of being born of her body. He described the Sāṅkhya system of philosophy, which is a combination of devotional service and mystic realization, as received by disciplic succession.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच-
देवानां गुणलिङ्गानामानुश्रविककर्मणाम्। सत्त्व एवैकमनसो वृत्तिः स्वाभाविका तु या॥ ३/२६/३२॥
units.english: [Text 32] Lord Kapila said: The senses are symbolic representations of the gods, and their natural inclination is to work under the direction of the Vedic injunctions. As the senses are representatives of the gods, so the mind is the representative of the Lord. The mind’s natural duty is to serve. When that service spirit is engaged in devotion to the Lord, without any motive, that is far better even than salvation.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 32] Lord Kapila said: The senses are symbolic representations of the demigods, and their natural inclination is to work under the direction of the Vedic injunctions. As the senses are representatives of the demigods, so the mind is the representative of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. The mind’s natural duty is to serve. When that service spirit is engaged in devotional service to the Personality of Godhead, without any motive, that is far better even than salvation.

units.sanskrit: अनिमित्ता भगवति भक्तिः सिद्धेर्गरीयसी। जरयत्याशु या कोशं निगीर्णमनलो यथा॥ ३/२६/३३॥
units.english: [Text 33] Bhakti, devotion, dissolves the subtle body of the living being without separate effort, just as fire in the stomach digests all that we eat.

parts.sanskrit: अनिमित्ता भगवति भक्तिः सिद्धेर्गरीयसी। जरयत्याशु या कोशं निगीर्णमनलो यथा॥ ३/२६/३३॥

“आनुश्राविककर्माऽसौ श्रुत्युक्तं यो न लङ्घयेत्” इति भविष्यत्पर्वणि।
“सदा सर्वगुणाढ्यत्वात् सत्त्वो विष्णुरुदीर्यते” इति कापिलेये।
“अपूर्णभक्तेर्मुक्तौ तु न सुखं पूर्तिमेष्यति।
अतस्तादृशमुक्तेश्च भक्तिः पूर्णा गरीयसी॥”
इति च॥ ३२-३३॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 33] Bhakti, devotional service, dissolves the subtle body of the living entity without separate effort, just as fire in the stomach digests all that we eat.

units.sanskrit: नैकात्म्यतां मे स्पृहयन्ति केचिन्मत्पादसेवाभिरता मदीहाः। येऽन्योन्यतो भागवताः प्रसज्य सम्भाजयन्ते मम पौरुषाणि॥ ३/२६/३४॥
units.english: [Text 34] A devotee, who is attached to the activities of devotion and who always engages in the service of My lotus feet, never desires to become one with Me. Such a devotee, who is unflinchingly engaged, always glorifies My pastimes and activities.

parts.sanskrit: नैकात्म्यतां मे स्पृहयन्ति केचिन्मत्पादसेवाभिरता मदीहाः। येऽन्योन्यतो भागवताः प्रसज्य सम्भाजयन्ते मम पौरुषाणि॥ ३/२६/३४॥

“नेच्छन्ति सायुज्यमपि फलत्वेन हरिर्यदि।
ददाति भक्तिसन्तुष्ट आज्ञात्वेनैव गृह्णते।
तादृशानां सुखाधिक्यं पुनर्मुक्तौ भविष्यति॥”
इति च॥ ३४॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 34] A pure devotee, who is attached to the activities of devotional service and who always engages in the service of My lotus feet, never desires to become one with Me. Such a devotee, who is unflinchingly engaged, always glorifies My pastimes and activities.

units.sanskrit: पश्यन्ति मे ते रुचिराण्येव सन्तः प्रसन्नवक्त्रारुणलोचनानि। रूपाणि दिव्यानि वरप्रदानि साकं वाचं स्पृहणीयां वदन्ति॥ ३/२६/३५॥
units.english: [Text 35] O My mother, My devotees always see the smiling face of My form, with eyes like the rising morning sun. They like to see My various transcendental forms, which are all benevolent, and they also talk favorably with Me.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 35] O My mother, My devotees always see the smiling face of My form, with eyes like the rising morning sun. They like to see My various transcendental forms, which are all benevolent, and they also talk favorably with Me.

units.sanskrit: तैर्दर्शनीयावयवैरुदारविलासहासेक्षितवामसूक्तैः। हृतात्मनो हृतप्राणस्य भक्तिमन्विच्छतो गतिमण्वीं प्रयुञ्जे॥ ३/२६/३६॥
units.english: [Text 36] Upon seeing the charming forms of the Lord, smiling and attractive, and hearing His very pleasing words, the devotee almost loses all other consciousness. His senses are freed from all other engagements, and he becomes absorbed in devotion. Thus in spite of his unwillingness, he attains liberation without separate endeavor.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 36] Upon seeing the charming forms of the Lord, smiling and attractive, and hearing His very pleasing words, the pure devotee almost loses all other consciousness. His senses are freed from all other engagements, and he becomes absorbed in devotional service. Thus in spite of his unwillingness, he attains liberation without separate endeavor.

units.sanskrit: अथो विभूतिं मम मायया चितामैश्वर्यमष्टाङ्गमनुप्रवृत्तम्। श्रियं न देवीं स्पृहयन्ति भद्रां परस्य मे तेऽश्नुवते हि लोके॥ ३/२६/३७॥
units.english: [Text 37] Thus because he is completely absorbed in thought of Me, the devotee does not desire even the highest benediction obtainable in the upper planetary systems, including Satyaloka. He does not desire the eight material perfections obtained from mystic yoga, nor does he desire to be elevated to the kingdom of God. Yet even without desiring them, the devotee enjoys, even in this life, all the offered benedictions.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 37] Thus because he is completely absorbed in thought of Me, the devotee does not desire even the highest benediction obtainable in the upper planetary systems, including Satyaloka. He does not desire the eight material perfections obtained from mystic yoga, nor does he desire to be elevated to the kingdom of God. Yet even without desiring them, the devotee enjoys, even in this life, all the offered benedictions.

units.sanskrit: न कर्हिचिन्मत्पराः शान्तरूपा नङ्क्ष्यन्ति मे नोऽनिमिषो लेढि हेतिः। येषामहं प्रिय आत्मा सुतश्च सखा गुरुः सुहृदो दैवमिष्टम्॥ ३/२६/३८॥
units.english: [Text 38] The Lord continued: My dear mother, devotees who receive such transcendental opulences are never bereft of them; neither weapons nor the change of time can destroy such opulences. Because the devotees accept Me as their friend, their relative, their son, preceptor, benefactor and Supreme Deity, they cannot be deprived of their possessions at any time.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 38] The Lord continued: My dear mother, devotees who receive such transcendental opulences are never bereft of them; neither weapons nor the change of time can destroy such opulences. Because the devotees accept Me as their friend, their relative, their son, preceptor, benefactor and Supreme Deity, they cannot be deprived of their possessions at any time.

units.sanskrit:
इमं लोकं तथैवामुमात्मानमुभयायिनम्। आत्मानमनु ये चेमे ये रायः पशवो गृहाः॥ ३/२६/३९॥
विसृज्य सर्वानन्यांश्च मामेवं विश्वतोमुखम्। भजन्त्यनन्यया भक्त्या तान् मृत्योरतिपारये॥ ३/२६/४०॥
units.english: [Text 39-40] Thus the devotee who worships Me, the all-pervading Lord of the universe, in unflinching devotion, gives up all aspirations to be promoted to heavenly planets or to become happy in this world with wealth, children, cattle, home or anything in relationship with the body. I take him to the other side of birth and death.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 39-40] Thus the devotee who worships Me, the all-pervading Lord of the universe, in unflinching devotional service, gives up all aspirations to be promoted to heavenly planets or to become happy in this world with wealth, children, cattle, home or anything in relationship with the body. I take him to the other side of birth and death.

units.sanskrit: नान्यत्र मद् भगवतः प्रधानपुरुषेश्वरात्। आत्मनः सर्वभूतानां भयं तीव्रं निवर्तते॥ ३/२६/४१॥
units.english: [Text 41] The terrible fear of birth and death can never be forsaken by anyone who resorts to any shelter other than Myself, for I am the almighty Lord, the Lord, the original source of all creation, and also the Supreme Soul of all souls.

parts.sanskrit: नान्यत्र मद् भगवतः प्रधानपुरुषेश्वरात्। आत्मनः सर्वभूतानां भयं तीव्रं निवर्तते॥ ३/२६/४१॥
आदानादिकर्तृत्वादात्मा॥ ४१॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 41] The terrible fear of birth and death can never be forsaken by anyone who resorts to any shelter other than Myself, for I am the almighty Lord, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the original source of all creation, and also the Supreme Soul of all souls.

units.sanskrit: मद्भयाद् वाति वातोऽयं सूर्यस्तपति मद्भयात्। वर्षतीन्द्रो दहत्यग्निर्मृत्युश्चरति मद्भयात्॥ ३/२६/४२॥
units.english: [Text 42] It is because of My supremacy that the wind blows, out of fear of Me; the sun shines out of fear of Me, and the lord of the clouds, Indra, sends forth showers out of fear of Me. Fire burns out of fear of Me, and death goes about taking its toll out of fear of Me.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 42] It is because of My supremacy that the wind blows, out of fear of Me; the sun shines out of fear of Me, and the lord of the clouds, Indra, sends forth showers out of fear of Me. Fire burns out of fear of Me, and death goes about taking its toll out of fear of Me.

units.sanskrit: ज्ञानवैराग्ययुक्तेन भक्तियोगेन योगिनः। क्षेमाय पादमूलं मे प्रविशन्त्यकुतोभयम्॥ ३/२६/४३॥
units.english: [Text 43] The yogīs, equipped with transcendental knowledge and renunciation and engaged in devotion for their eternal benefit, take shelter of My lotus feet, and since I am the Lord, they are thus eligible to enter into the kingdom of Godhead without fear.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 43] The yogīs, equipped with transcendental knowledge and renunciation and engaged in devotional service for their eternal benefit, take shelter of My lotus feet, and since I am the Lord, they are thus eligible to enter into the kingdom of Godhead without fear.

units.sanskrit: एतावानेव लोकेऽस्मिन् पुंसां निःश्रेयसोदयः। तीव्रेण भक्तियोगेन मनो मय्यर्पितं स्थितम्॥ ३/२६/४४॥
units.english: [Text 44] Therefore persons whose minds are fixed on the Lord engage in the intensive practice of devotion. That is the only means for attainment of the final perfection of life.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 44] Therefore persons whose minds are fixed on the Lord engage in the intensive practice of devotional service. That is the only means for attainment of the final perfection of life.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच-
अथ ते सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि तत्त्वानां लक्षणं पृथक्। यद् विदित्वा विमुच्येत पुरुषः प्राकृतैर्गुणैः॥ ३/२७/१॥
units.english: [Text 1] The Lord, Kapila, continued: My dear mother, now I shall describe unto you the different categories of the Absolute Truth, knowing which any person can be released from the influence of the modes of material nature.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 1] The Personality of Godhead, Kapila, continued: My dear mother, now I shall describe unto you the different categories of the Absolute Truth, knowing which any person can be released from the influence of the modes of material nature.

units.sanskrit: ज्ञानं निःश्रेयसार्थाय पुरुषस्यात्मदर्शनम्। यदाहुर्वर्णये तत् ते हृदयग्रन्थिभेदनम्॥ ३/२७/२॥
units.english: [Text 2] Knowledge is the ultimate perfection of self-realization. I shall explain that knowledge unto you by which the knots of attachment to the material world are cut.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 2] Knowledge is the ultimate perfection of self-realization. I shall explain that knowledge unto you by which the knots of attachment to the material world are cut.

units.sanskrit: अनादिरात्मा पुरुषो निर्गुणः प्रकृतेः परः। प्रत्यग्धामा स्वयञ्ज्योतिर्विश्वं येन समन्वितम्॥ ३/२७/३॥
units.english: [Text 3] The Lord is the Supreme Soul, and He has no beginning. He is transcendental to the material modes of nature and beyond the existence of this material world. He is perceivable everywhere because He is self-effulgent, and by His self-effulgent luster the entire creation is maintained.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 3] The Supreme Personality of Godhead is the Supreme Soul, and He has no beginning. He is transcendental to the material modes of nature and beyond the existence of this material world. He is perceivable everywhere because He is self-effulgent, and by His self-effulgent luster the entire creation is maintained.

units.sanskrit: न जातो न म्रियेतात्मा स हि देहाद्युपाधिभिः। निमित्तैरात्ततद्धर्मा यथा स्वप्ने तदीक्षिता॥ ३/२७/४॥
units.english: [Text 4] As His pastime, that the Lord, the greatest of the great, accepted the subtle material energy, which is invested with three material modes of nature and which is related with Viṣṇu.

parts.sanskrit: न जातो न म्रियेतात्मा स हि देहाद्युपाधिभिः। निमित्तैरात्ततद्धर्मा यथा स्वप्ने तदीक्षिता॥ ३/२७/४॥

स परमो न जायते न म्रियत इति प्रसिद्धं हि। देहाद्युपाधिभिरात्तधर्मो जीवोऽपि स्वप्नवद् भ्रान्त्या जायते म्रियते च। भ्रान्तित्वाद् देहात्मत्वस्य। किमु सर्वज्ञत्वस्वतन्त्रत्वादिवैलक्षण्ययुक्त ईश्वरः।
“परस्य जन्ममृत्याद्याः स्युः स्वतन्त्रस्य किम्पुनः।
जीवस्यापि यतो भ्रान्त्या जन्ममृत्यादिसङ्गतिः॥”
इति महाकौर्मे॥ ४॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 4] As His pastime, that Supreme Personality of Godhead, the greatest of the great, accepted the subtle material energy, which is invested with three material modes of nature and which is related with Viṣṇu.

units.sanskrit: स एव प्रकृतिं सूक्ष्मां दैवीं गुणमयीं विभुः। यदृच्छयैवोपगतामभ्यपद्यत लीलया॥ ३/२७/५॥
units.english: [Text 5] Divided into varieties by her threefold modes, material nature creates the forms of the living beings, and the living beings, seeing this, are illusioned by the knowledge-covering feature of the illusory energy.

parts.sanskrit: स एव प्रकृतिं सूक्ष्मां दैवीं गुणमयीं विभुः। यदृच्छयैवोपगतामभ्यपद्यत लीलया॥ ३/२७/५॥
उपगतां समीपस्थाम्॥ ५॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 5] Divided into varieties by her threefold modes, material nature creates the forms of the living entities, and the living entities, seeing this, are illusioned by the knowledge-covering feature of the illusory energy.

units.sanskrit: गुणैर्विचित्राः सृजतीं सरूपाः प्रकृतिं प्रजाः। विलोक्य मुमुहे सद्यः स इह ज्ञानगूहया॥ ३/२७/६॥
units.english: [Text 6] Because of his forgetfulness, the transcendental living being accepts the influence of material energy as his field of activities, and thus actuated, he wrongly applies the activities to himself.

parts.sanskrit: गुणैर्विचित्राः सृजतीं सरूपाः प्रकृतिं प्रजाः। विलोक्य मुमुहे सद्यः स इह ज्ञानगूहया॥ ३/२७/६॥

मुमुहे मोहयामास। “तदेतन्मे विजानीहि” “कृत्वा विवाहम्” इत्यादिवत्।
“यत्र कारयिताऽतीव स्वतन्त्रस्तत्र कर्तृता।
प्रोच्यते तु यथा ब्रह्म त्वज्ञं संसारभागिति॥”
इति च।
“लये वाऽप्यथवा सृष्टौ त्वन्तरालेऽपि न क्वचित्।
प्रकृत्या रहितं ब्रह्म कदाचिदपि तिष्ठति॥”
इति कापिलेये॥ ६॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 6] Because of his forgetfulness, the transcendental living entity accepts the influence of material energy as his field of activities, and thus actuated, he wrongly applies the activities to himself.

units.sanskrit: एवं पराभिध्यानेन कर्तृत्वं प्रकृतेः पुमान्। कर्मसु क्रियमाणेषु गुणैरात्मनि मन्यते॥ ३/२७/७॥
units.english: [Text 7] Material consciousness is the cause of one’s conditional life, in which conditions are enforced upon the living being by the material energy. Although the spirit soul does not do anything and is transcendental to such activities, he is thus affected by conditional life.

parts.sanskrit: एवं पराभिध्यानेन कर्तृत्वं प्रकृतेः पुमान्। कर्मसु क्रियमाणेषु गुणैरात्मनि मन्यते॥ ३/२७/७॥
एवं पराभिध्यानेन परात्मेच्छया। प्रकृतेः कर्तृत्वं जीव आत्मनि मन्यते॥ ७॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 7] Material consciousness is the cause of one’s conditional life, in which conditions are enforced upon the living entity by the material energy. Although the spirit soul does not do anything and is transcendental to such activities, he is thus affected by conditional life.

units.sanskrit: तदस्य संसृतिर्बन्धः पारतन्त्र्यं च तत्कृतम्। भवत्यकर्तुरीशस्य साक्षिणो निर्वृतात्मनः॥ ३/२७/८॥
units.english: [Text 8] The cause of the conditioned soul’s material body and senses, and the senses’ presiding deities, the gods, is the material nature. This is understood by learned men. The feelings of happiness and distress of the soul, who is transcendental by nature, are caused by the spirit soul himself.

parts.sanskrit: तदस्य संसृतिर्बन्धः पारतन्त्र्यं च तत्कृतम्। भवत्यकर्तुरीशस्य साक्षिणो निर्वृतात्मनः॥ ३/२७/८॥

“विष्णोः सुराणां गुरूणां नित्या
जीवस्य तन्त्रता। यत् तु तस्यान्यतन्त्रत्वं तज्ज्ञानाद् विनिवर्तते॥” इति च।
अकर्तुरीशस्य सकाशात्। “अक्लिष्टत्वादकर्ताऽसावकार्यत्वादथापि वा” इति च। “एष कर्ता न क्रियते कारणं च जगत्प्रभुः” इति भारते॥ ८॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 8] The cause of the conditioned soul’s material body and senses, and the senses’ presiding deities, the demigods, is the material nature. This is understood by learned men. The feelings of happiness and distress of the soul, who is transcendental by nature, are caused by the spirit soul himself.

units.sanskrit: कार्यकारणकर्तृत्वे कारणं प्रकृतिं विदुः। भोक्तृत्वे सुखदुःखानां पुरुषः प्रकृतेः परः॥ ३/२७/९॥
units.english: [Text 9] Devahūti said: O Lord, kindly explain the characteristics of the Supreme Person and His energies, for both of these are the causes of this manifest and unmanifest creation.

parts.sanskrit: कार्यकारणकर्तृत्वे कारणं प्रकृतिं विदुः। भोक्तृत्वे सुखदुःखानां पुरुषः प्रकृतेः परः॥ ३/२७/९॥

“ब्रह्मादिभिः सर्गकरी श्रीर्विष्णुबलसंश्रयात्।
सुखदुःखप्रदो विष्णुः स्वयमेव सनातनः।
कर्तृत्वं सुखदुःखानामन्येषां तु तदाज्ञया।
भोक्तृत्वं सुखदुःखानां करोत्येको हरिः स्वयम्।
भोक्तृत्वमात्रहेतुत्वं जीवे नान्यत्र कुत्रचित्॥”
इति भविष्यत्पर्वणि।
“प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव विद्ध्यनादी” इति च॥ ९॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 9] Devahūti said: O Supreme Personality of Godhead, kindly explain the characteristics of the Supreme Person and His energies, for both of these are the causes of this manifest and unmanifest creation.

units.sanskrit:
देवहूतिरुवाच-
प्रकृतेः पुरुषस्यापि लक्षणं पुरुषोत्तम। ब्रूहि कारणयोरस्य सदसच्च यदात्मकम्॥ ३/२७/१०॥
units.english: [Text 10] The Lord said: The unmanifested eternal combination of the three modes is the cause of the manifest state and is called pradhāna. It is called prakṛti when in the manifested stage of existence.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 10] The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: The unmanifested eternal combination of the three modes is the cause of the manifest state and is called pradhāna. It is called prakṛti when in the manifested stage of existence.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच-
यत् तत् त्रिगुणमव्यक्तं नित्यं सदसदात्मकम्। प्रधानं प्रकृतिं प्राहुरविशेषं विशेषवत्॥ ३/२७/११॥
units.english: [Text 11] The aggregate elements, namely the five gross elements, the five subtle elements, the four internal senses, the five senses for gathering knowledge and the five outward organs of action, are known as the pradhāna.

parts.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच-
यत् तत् त्रिगुणमव्यक्तं नित्यं सदसदात्मकम्। प्रधानं प्रकृतिं प्राहुरविशेषं विशेषवत्॥ ३/२७/११॥

“व्यक्ताव्यक्तात्मकं यत् तद् विद्यात् सदसदात्मकम्।
असर्गा केवलाऽव्यक्ता सिसृक्षुरुभयात्मिका।
व्यक्तैव कार्यरूपा तु प्रकृतिस्त्रिविधा मता।
कार्यतः सा प्रधानत्वात् प्रधानमिति कीर्त्यते।
अविशेषा ह्यकार्यत्वात् सा च श्रीर्विणुसंश्रया॥”
इति हरिवंशेषु।
“विशेषः कार्यमुद्दिष्टं विशेषाद् दृश्यते यतः” इति पाद्मे॥ ११॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 11] The aggregate elements, namely the five gross elements, the five subtle elements, the four internal senses, the five senses for gathering knowledge and the five outward organs of action, are known as the pradhāna.

units.sanskrit: पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिर्ब्रह्म चतुर्भिर्दशभिस्तथा। एतच्चतुर्विंशतिकं गणं प्राधानिकं विदुः॥ ३/२७/१२॥
units.english: [Text 12] There are five gross elements, namely earth, water, fire, air and ether. There are also five subtle elements: smell, taste, color, touch and sound.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 12] There are five gross elements, namely earth, water, fire, air and ether. There are also five subtle elements: smell, taste, color, touch and sound.

units.sanskrit: महाभूतानि पञ्चैव भूरापोऽग्निर्मरुन्नभः। तन्मात्राणि च तावन्ति गन्धादीनि मतानि मे॥ ३/२७/१३॥
units.english: [Text 13] The senses for acquiring knowledge and the organs for action number ten, namely the auditory sense, the sense of taste, the tactile sense, the sense of sight, the sense of smell, and the active organs for speaking, working, traveling, generating and evacuating.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 13] The senses for acquiring knowledge and the organs for action number ten, namely the auditory sense, the sense of taste, the tactile sense, the sense of sight, the sense of smell, and the active organs for speaking, working, traveling, generating and evacuating.

units.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणि दश श्रोत्रं त्वग् दृग्रसननासिकम्। वाक् करौ चरणौ मेढ्रं पायुर्दशम उच्यते॥ ३/२७/१४॥
units.english: [Text 14] The internal, subtle senses are experienced as having four aspects, in the shape of mind, intelligence, ego and contaminated consciousness. Distinctions between them can be made only by different functions, since they represent different characteristics.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 14] The internal, subtle senses are experienced as having four aspects, in the shape of mind, intelligence, ego and contaminated consciousness. Distinctions between them can be made only by different functions, since they represent different characteristics.

units.sanskrit: मनो बुद्धिरहङ्कारश्चित्तमित्यन्तरात्मनः। चतुर्धा लक्ष्यते भेदो वृत्त्या लक्षणरूपया॥ ३/२७/१५॥
units.english: [Text 15] All these are considered the qualified Brahman. The mixing element, which is known as time, is counted as the twenty-fifth element.

parts.sanskrit: मनो बुद्धिरहङ्कारश्चित्तमित्यन्तरात्मनः। चतुर्धा लक्ष्यते भेदो वृत्त्या लक्षणरूपया॥ ३/२७/१५॥

“बुद्धिरध्यवसानाय संशयं कुरुते मनः।
अभिमानो ह्यहङ्कारश्चित्तं स्मरणकारणम्॥”
इति स्कान्दे॥ १५॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 15] All these are considered the qualified Brahman. The mixing element, which is known as time, is counted as the twenty-fifth element.

units.sanskrit: एतावानेव सङ्ख्यातो ब्रह्मणः सगुणस्य हि। सन्निवेशो मया प्रोक्तो यः कालः पञ्चविंशकः॥ ३/२७/१६॥
units.english: [Text 16] The influence of the Lord is felt in the time factor, which causes fear of death due to the false ego of the deluded soul who has contacted material nature.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 16] The influence of the Supreme Personality of Godhead is felt in the time factor, which causes fear of death due to the false ego of the deluded soul who has contacted material nature.

units.sanskrit: प्रभावं पौरुषं प्राहुः कालमेके यतो भयम्। अहङ्कारविमूढस्य कर्तुः प्रकृतिमीयुषः॥ ३/२७/१७॥
units.english: [Text 17] My dear mother, O daughter of Svāyambhuva Manu, the time factor, as I have explained, is the Lord, from whom the creation begins as a result of the agitation of the neutral, unmanifested nature.

parts.sanskrit: प्रभावं पौरुषं प्राहुः कालमेके यतो भयम्। अहङ्कारविमूढस्य कर्तुः प्रकृतिमीयुषः॥ ३/२७/१७॥

“हरिस्तु निर्गुणं ब्रह्म श्रीर्ब्रह्म सगुणं स्मृता।
तदङ्गजानि तत्त्वानि तस्मात् तद्रूपमुच्यते॥”
इति हरिवंशेषु॥ १६॥
“पुरुषो हृदिस्थः परमः कालः सर्वगतो हरिः।
अथवा रुद्रदेहस्थो हरिः काल इतीरितः॥”
इति ब्राह्मे।
पौरुषं प्रभावम्। पुरुषस्य प्रकर्षेण भावं व्याप्तं रूपम्। एके सम्यग्ज्ञानिनः। न प्राकृताः॥ १७॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 17] My dear mother, O daughter of Svāyambhuva Manu, the time factor, as I have explained, is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, from whom the creation begins as a result of the agitation of the neutral, unmanifested nature.

units.sanskrit: प्रकृतेर्गुणसाम्यस्य निर्विशेषस्य मानवि। चेष्टा यतः स भगवान् काल इत्युपलक्षितः॥ ३/२७/१८॥
units.english: [Text 18] By exhibiting His potencies, the Lord adjusts all these different elements, keeping Himself within as the Supreme Self and without as time.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 18] By exhibiting His potencies, the Supreme Personality of Godhead adjusts all these different elements, keeping Himself within as the Supersoul and without as time.

units.sanskrit: अन्तः पुरुषरूपेण कालरूपेण यो बहिः। समन्वेत्येष सत्वानां भगवानात्ममायया॥ ३/२७/१९॥
units.english: [Text 19] After the Lord impregnates material nature with His internal potency, material nature delivers the sum total of the cosmic intelligence, which is known as Hiraṇmaya. This takes place in material nature when she is agitated by the destinations of the conditioned souls.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 19] After the Supreme Personality of Godhead impregnates material nature with His internal potency, material nature delivers the sum total of the cosmic intelligence, which is known as Hiraṇmaya. This takes place in material nature when she is agitated by the destinations of the conditioned souls.

units.sanskrit: दैवात् क्षुभितधर्मिण्यां स्वस्यां योनौ परः पुमान्। आधत्त वीर्यं साऽसूत महत्तत्वं हिरण्मयम्॥ ३/२७/२०॥
units.english: [Text 20] Thus, after manifesting variegatedness, the effulgent mahat-tattva, which contains all the universes within itself, which is the root of all cosmic manifestations and which is not destroyed at the time of annihilation, swallows the darkness that covered the effulgence at the time of dissolution.

parts.sanskrit: दैवात् क्षुभितधर्मिण्यां स्वस्यां योनौ परः पुमान्। आधत्त वीर्यं साऽसूत महत्तत्वं हिरण्मयम्॥ ३/२७/२०॥

“प्रकृतेः क्षोभकं रूपं दैवं नारायणाभिधम्।
प्रकृतौ महतः स्रष्टा परमः पुरुषो मतः।
तदेव वासुदेवाख्यं महत्तत्वनियामकम्।
सङ्कर्षणाख्यस्तु हरिः सूक्ष्माहङ्कारयामकः।
स्थूलाहङ्कारनियमी विष्णुः प्रद्युम्ननामकः।
अनिरुद्धो मनस्तत्त्वनियन्ता भगवान् हरिः।
महत्तत्वादिजीवास्तु ब्रह्मशेषाङ्गजास्तथा।
सूक्ष्मस्थूलविभेदेन कामजश्चानिरुद्धकः॥”
इति कापिलेये॥ २०-२७॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 20] Thus, after manifesting variegatedness, the effulgent mahat-tattva, which contains all the universes within itself, which is the root of all cosmic manifestations and which is not destroyed at the time of annihilation, swallows the darkness that covered the effulgence at the time of dissolution.

units.sanskrit: विश्वमात्मगतं व्यञ्जन् कूटस्थो जगदङ्कुरः। स्वतेजसाऽपिबत् तीव्रमात्मप्रस्वापनं तमः॥ ३/२७/२१॥
units.english: [Text 21] The mode of goodness, which is the clear, sober status of understanding the Lord and which is generally called vāsudeva, or consciousness, becomes manifest in the mahat-tattva.

parts.sanskrit: विश्वमात्मगतं व्यञ्जन् कूटस्थो जगदङ्कुरः। स्वतेजसाऽपिबत् तीव्रमात्मप्रस्वापनं तमः॥ ३/२७/२१॥

“अङ्के रमयते यस्मात् केशवो जगदङ्कुरः।
महान्तं योऽसृजज्जीवमोहकं च तमोऽग्रसत्॥”
इति च॥ २१॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 21] The mode of goodness, which is the clear, sober status of understanding the Personality of Godhead and which is generally called vāsudeva, or consciousness, becomes manifest in the mahat-tattva.

units.sanskrit: यत् तत् सत्त्वगुणं स्वच्छं शान्तं भगवतः पदम्। यदाहुर्वासुदेवाख्यं चित्तं तन्महदात्मकम्॥ ३/२७/२२॥
units.english: [Text 22] After the manifestation of the mahat-tattva, these features appear simultaneously. As water in its natural state, before coming in contact with earth, is clear, sweet and unruffled, so the characteristic traits of pure consciousness are complete serenity, clarity, and freedom from distraction.

parts.sanskrit: यत् तत् सत्त्वगुणं स्वच्छं शान्तं भगवतः पदम्। यदाहुर्वासुदेवाख्यं चित्तं तन्महदात्मकम्॥ ३/२७/२२॥

यद् वासुदेवाख्यं भगवद्रूपं ततो महदात्मकं चित्तं जायते।
“सत्त्वशब्देन चोच्यन्ते पूर्णानन्दादयो गुणाः” इति च।
“महत्तत्त्वगतो योऽसौ वासुदेवाभिधो हरिः।
स चित्तजनकः प्रोक्तः प्राणिनां च पृथक्पृथक्॥”
इति च॥ २२॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 22] After the manifestation of the mahat-tattva, these features appear simultaneously. As water in its natural state, before coming in contact with earth, is clear, sweet and unruffled, so the characteristic traits of pure consciousness are complete serenity, clarity, and freedom from distraction.

units.sanskrit:
स्वच्छत्वमविकारित्वं शान्तत्वमिति चेतसः। वृत्तिभिर्लक्षणं प्रोक्तं यथाऽपां प्रकृतिः परा॥ ३/२७/२३॥
महत्तत्वाद् विकुर्वाणाद् भगवद्वीर्यसम्भवात्। क्रियाशक्तिरहङ्कारस्त्रिविधः समपद्यत॥ ३/२७/२४॥
units.english: [Text 23-24] The material ego springs up from the mahat-tattva, which evolved from the Lord’s own energy. The material ego is endowed predominantly with active power of three kinds: good, passionate and ignorant. It is from these three types of material ego that the mind, the senses of perception, the organs of action, and the gross elements evolve.

parts.sanskrit:
स्वच्छत्वमविकारित्वं शान्तत्वमिति चेतसः। वृत्तिभिर्लक्षणं प्रोक्तं यथाऽपां प्रकृतिः परा॥ ३/२७/२३॥
महत्तत्वाद् विकुर्वाणाद् भगवद्वीर्यसम्भवात्। क्रियाशक्तिरहङ्कारस्त्रिविधः समपद्यत॥ ३/२७/२४॥

चित्तस्य स्वच्छत्वादयः पृथग् गुणा उच्यन्ते स्वच्छत्वमित्यादि।
“स्तिमितोदकचित्तादेरविकारोऽल्पविक्रिया” इति तत्त्वविवेके।
“वृत्तिः स्वभावो वृत्तं च स्थितिरित्यभिधीयते” इति तत्त्वनिर्णये।
वृत्तिभिर्लक्षणं प्रोक्तमिति स्वाभाविकं लक्षणमित्यर्थः॥ २३॥
“ज्ञानप्रधानस्तु महानहङ्कारः क्रियाधिकः।
इतरापेक्षया सोऽपि ज्ञानाधिक उदाहृतः॥”
इति च॥ २४॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 23-24] The material ego springs up from the mahat-tattva, which evolved from the Lord’s own energy. The material ego is endowed predominantly with active power of three kinds: good, passionate and ignorant. It is from these three types of material ego that the mind, the senses of perception, the organs of action, and the gross elements evolve.

units.sanskrit: वैकारिकस्तैजसश्च तामसश्च यतो भवः। मनसश्चेन्द्रियाणां च भूतानां महतामपि॥ ३/२७/२५॥
units.english: [Text 25] The threefold ahaṅkāra, the source of the gross elements, the senses and the mind, is identical with them because it is their cause. It is known by the name of Saṅkarṣaṇa, who is directly Lord Ananta with a thousand heads.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 25] The threefold ahaṅkāra, the source of the gross elements, the senses and the mind, is identical with them because it is their cause. It is known by the name of Saṅkarṣaṇa, who is directly Lord Ananta with a thousand heads.

units.sanskrit: वैकारिकोऽधिदैवं तु बुद्धिः प्राणश्च तैजसः। तामसस्त्वर्थमात्रं च गुणव्यतिकरस्त्रिवृत्॥ ३/२७/२६॥
units.english: [Text 26] This false ego is characterized as the doer, as an instrument and as an effect. It is further characterized as serene, active or dull according to how it is influenced by the modes of goodness, passion and ignorance.

parts.sanskrit: वैकारिकोऽधिदैवं तु बुद्धिः प्राणश्च तैजसः। तामसस्त्वर्थमात्रं च गुणव्यतिकरस्त्रिवृत्॥ ३/२७/२६॥

“देवताधिकृतं यत् तदधिदैवमिति स्मृतम्” इति च।
वैकारिकोऽधिदैवमित्यादि पञ्चम्यर्थे। “सप्तसु प्रथमा तत्र स्वातन्त्र्यं यद् विवक्षितम्” इति शब्दनिर्णये॥ २६॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 26] This false ego is characterized as the doer, as an instrument and as an effect. It is further characterized as serene, active or dull according to how it is influenced by the modes of goodness, passion and ignorance.

units.sanskrit: सहस्रशिरसं साक्षाद् यमनन्तं प्रचक्षते। सङ्कर्षणाख्यं पुरुषं भूतेन्द्रियमनोमयम्॥ ३/२७/२७॥
units.english: [Text 27] From the false ego of goodness, another transformation takes place. From this evolves the mind, whose thoughts and reflections give rise to desire.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 27] From the false ego of goodness, another transformation takes place. From this evolves the mind, whose thoughts and reflections give rise to desire.

units.sanskrit: कर्तृत्वं करणत्वं च कार्यत्वं चेति लक्षणम्। शान्तघोरविमूढत्वमिति वा स्यादहङ्कृतेः॥ ३/२७/२८॥
units.english: [Text 28] The mind of the living being is known by the name of Lord Aniruddha, the supreme ruler of the senses. He possesses a bluish-black form resembling a lotus flower growing in the autumn. He is found slowly by the yogīs.

parts.sanskrit: कर्तृत्वं करणत्वं च कार्यत्वं चेति लक्षणम्। शान्तघोरविमूढत्वमिति वा स्यादहङ्कृतेः॥ ३/२७/२८॥

“मनोरूपेण कर्तृत्वं देहरूपेण कार्यता।
इन्द्रियात्मतया चैव करणत्वमहङ्कृतेः।
यतो मनस्यहम्भावस्तस्मात् कर्तृ मनः स्मृतम्।
स्वभावकर्तुर्जीवस्य त्वासन्नोपाधि तद् यतः।
कर्मज्ञाने करणता यतः करणमिन्द्रियम्।
कार्यं देहः समुद्दिष्ट उत्पाद्यत्वात् पुनःपुनः॥”
इति तत्त्वविवेके।
“शान्तरूपो देवपिता घोरः करणसृङ् मतः।
तावज्ज्ञानस्याप्रकाशान्मूढो भूतपिता स्मृतः।
त्रिरूपोऽयमहङ्कारः शेष इत्येव तं विदुः॥”
इति निर्णये ॥ २८॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 28] The mind of the living entity is known by the name of Lord Aniruddha, the supreme ruler of the senses. He possesses a bluish-black form resembling a lotus flower growing in the autumn. He is found slowly by the yogīs.

units.sanskrit: वैकारिकाद् विकुर्वाणान्मनस्तत्त्वमजायत। यत् सङ्कल्पविकल्पाभ्यां वर्तते कामसम्भवः॥ ३/२७/२९॥
units.english: [Text 29] By transformation of the false ego in passion, intelligence takes birth, O virtuous lady. The functions of intelligence are to help in ascertaining the nature of objects when they come into view, and to help the senses.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 29] By transformation of the false ego in passion, intelligence takes birth, O virtuous lady. The functions of intelligence are to help in ascertaining the nature of objects when they come into view, and to help the senses.

units.sanskrit: यद् विदुर्ह्यनिरुद्धाख्यं हृषीकाणामधीश्वरम्। शारदेन्दीवरश्यामं संराध्यं योगिभिः शनैः॥ ३/२७/३०॥
units.english: [Text 30] Doubt, misapprehension, correct apprehension, memory and sleep, as determined by their different functions, are said to be the distinct characteristics of intelligence.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 30] Doubt, misapprehension, correct apprehension, memory and sleep, as determined by their different functions, are said to be the distinct characteristics of intelligence.

units.sanskrit: तैजसात् तु विकुर्वाणद् बुद्धितत्त्वमभूत् सति। द्रव्यस्फुरणविज्ञानमिन्द्रियाणामनुग्रहात्। प्रद्युम्नसञ्ज्ञं पुरुषं यमाहुस्तत्वबृंहितम्॥ ३/२७/३१॥
units.english: [Text 31] Egoism in the mode of passion produces two kinds of senses: the senses for acquiring knowledge and the senses of action. The senses of action depend on the vital energy, and the senses for acquiring knowledge depend on intelligence.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 31] Egoism in the mode of passion produces two kinds of senses: the senses for acquiring knowledge and the senses of action. The senses of action depend on the vital energy, and the senses for acquiring knowledge depend on intelligence.

units.sanskrit: संशयोऽथ विपर्यासो निश्चयः स्मृतिरेव च। स्वाप इत्युच्यते बुद्धेर्लक्षणं वृत्तिभिः पृथक्॥ ३/२७/३२॥
units.english: [Text 32] When egoism in ignorance is agitated by the sex energy of the Lord, the subtle element sound is manifested, and from sound come the ethereal sky and the sense of hearing.

parts.sanskrit: संशयोऽथ विपर्यासो निश्चयः स्मृतिरेव च। स्वाप इत्युच्यते बुद्धेर्लक्षणं वृत्तिभिः पृथक्॥ ३/२७/३२॥

द्रव्यस्फुरणे यद्विशेषज्ञानम्।
“सामान्यं मनसा
ज्ञानं
विशेषाद् बुद्धिजं भवेत्।
अचलः संशयो बुद्धेश्चलो मानस उच्यते॥
चञ्चला तु
स्मृतिर्बुद्धेश्चित्तजैव
स्थिरा स्मृतिः॥”
इति च।
“येन यज्ज्ञायते वस्तु तत् तल्लक्षणमुच्यते।
तत् स्वरूपं पृथक् चेति द्विविधं कवयो विदुः॥”
इति कापिलेये॥ ३२॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 32] When egoism in ignorance is agitated by the sex energy of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the subtle element sound is manifested, and from sound come the ethereal sky and the sense of hearing.

units.sanskrit: तैजसानीन्द्रियाण्येव क्रियाज्ञानविभागशः। प्राणस्य हि क्रियाशक्तिर्बुद्धेर्विज्ञानशक्तिता॥ ३/२७/३३॥
units.english: [Text 33] Persons who are learned and who have true knowledge define sound as that which conveys the idea of an object, indicates the presence of a speaker screened from our view and constitutes the subtle form of ether.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 33] Persons who are learned and who have true knowledge define sound as that which conveys the idea of an object, indicates the presence of a speaker screened from our view and constitutes the subtle form of ether.

units.sanskrit: तामसाच्च विकुर्वाणाद् भगवद्वीर्यचोदितात्। शब्दमात्रमभूत् तस्मान्नभः श्रोत्रं तु शब्दगम्॥ ३/२७/३४॥
units.english: [Text 34] The activities and characteristics of the ethereal element can be observed as the accommodation of room for the external and internal existences of all living beings, namely the field of activities of the vital air, the senses and the mind.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 34] The activities and characteristics of the ethereal element can be observed as the accommodation of room for the external and internal existences of all living entities, namely the field of activities of the vital air, the senses and the mind.

units.sanskrit: अर्थाश्रयत्वं शब्दस्य द्रष्टुर्लिङ्गत्वमेव च। तन्मात्रत्वं च नभसो लक्षणं कवयो विदुः॥ ३/२७/३५॥
units.english: [Text 35] From ethereal existence, which evolves from sound, the next transformation takes place under the impulse of time, and thus the subtle element touch and thence the air and sense of touch become prominent.

parts.sanskrit: अर्थाश्रयत्वं शब्दस्य द्रष्टुर्लिङ्गत्वमेव च। तन्मात्रत्वं च नभसो लक्षणं कवयो विदुः॥ ३/२७/३५॥

“प्रधानवायुः सूत्रात्मा महता सह जायते।
तैजसश्च खजः स्पर्श इत्याद्यास्तत्सुताः स्मृताः।
तदाविष्टा अन्यजीवास्तदाधाराश्च तद्बलाः॥”
इति च।
अर्थाश्रयत्वम् अर्थविषयत्वम्।
“शब्देनैव यतो ज्ञेयो हरिर्लिङ्गं तु तस्य तत्।
स्पर्शाद्यभावात् तन्मात्रा नभसश्चेति कीर्त्यते।
स्पर्शादयश्च तन्मात्रा इतरे
पूर्वसंस्थितेः।
तिष्ठत्येको गुणो भूते प्रत्येकं पञ्चसु स्थितः।
शब्दो वर्णात्मको नित्यो ध्वनिराकाशसम्भवः।
आकाश एव सूक्ष्मस्तु ध्वनिरित्येव शब्द्यते।
स एव व्यज्यमानस्तु भवेत् कर्णैकगोचरः॥”
इति च॥ ३३-३५॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 35] From ethereal existence, which evolves from sound, the next transformation takes place under the impulse of time, and thus the subtle element touch and thence the air and sense of touch become prominent.

units.sanskrit: भूतानां छिद्रदातृत्वं बहिरन्तर्दिगेव च। प्राणेन्द्रियात्मधिष्ण्यत्वं नभसो वृत्तिलक्षणम्॥ ३/२७/३६॥
units.english: [Text 36] Softness and hardness and cold and heat are the distinguishing attributes of touch, which is characterized as the subtle form of air.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 36] Softness and hardness and cold and heat are the distinguishing attributes of touch, which is characterized as the subtle form of air.

units.sanskrit: नभसः शब्दतन्मात्रात् कालगत्या विकुर्वतः। स्पर्शोऽभवत् ततो वायुस्त्वक् स्पर्शस्य च सङ्ग्रहः॥ ३/२७/३७॥
units.english: [Text 37] The action of the air is exhibited in movements, mixing, allowing approach to the objects of sound and other sense perceptions, and providing for the proper functioning of all other senses.

parts.sanskrit: नभसः शब्दतन्मात्रात् कालगत्या विकुर्वतः। स्पर्शोऽभवत् ततो वायुस्त्वक् स्पर्शस्य च सङ्ग्रहः॥ ३/२७/३७॥

नभसः शब्दतन्मात्रात् शब्दमात्रगुणादभूत्।
“स्पर्शादयोऽपि वाय्वादेः सूक्ष्मावस्थाः प्रकीर्तिताः”
इति च।
“सूक्ष्मेन्द्रियाणि सन्त्येव स्युः स्थूलान्यप्यहङ्कृतेः।
भूतेभ्यश्चोपचीयन्ते पुनर्ब्रह्मशरीरतः॥”
इति च॥ ३७॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 37] The action of the air is exhibited in movements, mixing, allowing approach to the objects of sound and other sense perceptions, and providing for the proper functioning of all other senses.

units.sanskrit: मृदुत्वं कठिणत्वं च शैत्यमुष्णत्वमेव च। एतत् स्पर्शस्य स्पर्शत्वं तन्मात्रत्वं नभस्वतः॥ ३/२७/३८॥
units.english: [Text 38] By interactions of the air and the sensations of touch, one receives different forms according to destiny. By evolution of such forms, there is fire, and the eye sees different forms in color.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 38] By interactions of the air and the sensations of touch, one receives different forms according to destiny. By evolution of such forms, there is fire, and the eye sees different forms in color.

units.sanskrit: चालनं व्यूहनं प्राप्तिर्नेतृत्वं द्रव्यशब्दयोः। सर्वेन्द्रियाणामात्मत्वं वायोः कर्माभिलक्षणम्॥ ३/२७/३९॥
units.english: [Text 39] My dear mother, the characteristics of form are understood by dimension, quality and individuality. The form of fire is appreciated by its effulgence.

parts.sanskrit: चालनं व्यूहनं प्राप्तिर्नेतृत्वं द्रव्यशब्दयोः। सर्वेन्द्रियाणामात्मत्वं वायोः कर्माभिलक्षणम्॥ ३/२७/३९॥

“प्राप्नोति वायुः सर्वं तु स्वत एव हरेस्तथा।
अतः प्राप्तिरिति प्राहुर्वायुं भूतपतिं प्रभुम्।
प्रधानवायुरन्येषु नित्याविष्टो यतस्ततः।
तद्गुणास्तेषु चोच्यन्ते नीचता नास्य तत्कृता॥”
इति ब्रह्मवैवर्ते।
“स्वरूपमपि कर्मेति विषयत्वादुदीर्यते”
इति शब्दनिर्णये॥ ३९॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 39] My dear mother, the characteristics of form are understood by dimension, quality and individuality. The form of fire is appreciated by its effulgence.

units.sanskrit: वायोश्च स्पर्शतन्मात्राद् रूपं दैवेरितादभूत्। समुत्थितं ततस्तेजश्चक्षू रूपोपलम्भनम्॥ ३/२७/४०॥
units.english: [Text 40] Fire is appreciated by its light and by its ability to cook, to digest, to destroy cold, to evaporate, and to give rise to hunger, thirst, eating and drinking.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 40] Fire is appreciated by its light and by its ability to cook, to digest, to destroy cold, to evaporate, and to give rise to hunger, thirst, eating and drinking.

units.sanskrit: द्रव्याकृतित्वं गुणता व्यक्तिसंस्थात्वमेव च। तेजस्त्वं तेजसः साध्वि रूपमात्रस्य वृत्तयः॥ ३/२७/४१॥
units.english: [Text 41] By the interaction of fire and the visual sensation, the subtle element taste evolves under a superior arrangement. From taste, water is produced, and the tongue, which perceives taste, is also manifested.

parts.sanskrit: द्रव्याकृतित्वं गुणता व्यक्तिसंस्थात्वमेव च। तेजस्त्वं तेजसः साध्वि रूपमात्रस्य वृत्तयः॥ ३/२७/४१॥
व्यक्तिसंस्थात्वं व्यक्तत्वेन स्थितिः। गुणता प्रकाशत्वम्। “आलोको गुण इत्येव प्रकाशश्चेति कथ्यते” इत्यभिधानम्। “तेजस्त्वमथ चोग्रत्वं क्रौर्यमित्यपि चोच्यते” इत्यभिधानम्॥ ४१॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 41] By the interaction of fire and the visual sensation, the subtle element taste evolves under a superior arrangement. From taste, water is produced, and the tongue, which perceives taste, is also manifested.

units.sanskrit: द्योतनं पचनं पानमदनं हिममर्दनम्। तेजसो वृत्तयस्त्वेताः शोषणं क्षुत्तृडुद्भवः॥ ३/२७/४२॥
units.english: [Text 42] Although originally one, taste becomes manifold as astringent, sweet, bitter, pungent, sour and salty due to contact with other substances.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 42] Although originally one, taste becomes manifold as astringent, sweet, bitter, pungent, sour and salty due to contact with other substances.

units.sanskrit: रूपमात्राद् विकुर्वाणात् तेजसो दैवचोदितात्। रसमात्रमभूत् तस्मादम्भो जिह्वा रसग्रहः॥ ३/२७/४३॥
units.english: [Text 43] The characteristics of water are exhibited by its moistening other substances, coagulating various mixtures, causing satisfaction, maintaining life, softening things, driving away heat, incessantly supplying itself to reservoirs of water, and refreshing by slaking thirst.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 43] The characteristics of water are exhibited by its moistening other substances, coagulating various mixtures, causing satisfaction, maintaining life, softening things, driving away heat, incessantly supplying itself to reservoirs of water, and refreshing by slaking thirst.

units.sanskrit: कषायो मधुरस्तिक्तः कद्वाम्ल इति नैकधा। भौतिकानां विकारेण रस एको विभिद्यते॥ ३/२७/४४॥
units.english: [Text 44] Due to the interaction of water with the taste perception, the subtle element odor evolves under superior arrangement. Thence the earth and the olfactory sense, by which we can variously experience the aroma of the earth, become manifest.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 44] Due to the interaction of water with the taste perception, the subtle element odor evolves under superior arrangement. Thence the earth and the olfactory sense, by which we can variously experience the aroma of the earth, become manifest.

units.sanskrit: क्लेदनं पिण्डनं तृप्तिः प्राणनाप्ययनोन्दनम्। तापापनोदो भूयस्त्वमम्भसो वृत्तयस्त्विमाः॥ ३/२७/४५॥
units.english: [Text 45] Odor, although one, becomes many — as mixed, offensive, fragrant, mild, strong, acidic and so on — according to the proportions of associated substances.

parts.sanskrit: क्लेदनं पिण्डनं तृप्तिः प्राणनाप्ययनोन्दनम्। तापापनोदो भूयस्त्वमम्भसो वृत्तयस्त्विमाः॥ ३/२७/४५॥
“उन्दनं बिन्दुभावः स्यात् स्यन्दनं स्रवणं स्मृतम्” इत्यभिधानम्। पृथिव्यग्न्यपेक्षया भूयस्त्वं देहे॥ ४५॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 45] Odor, although one, becomes many — as mixed, offensive, fragrant, mild, strong, acidic and so on — according to the proportions of associated substances.

units.sanskrit: रसमात्राद् विकुर्वाणादम्भसो दैवचोदितात्। गन्धमात्रमभूत् तस्मात् पृथ्वी घ्राणस्तु गन्धगः॥ ३/२७/४६॥
units.english: [Text 46] The characteristics of the functions of earth can be perceived by modeling forms of the Supreme Brahman, by constructing places of residence, by preparing pots to contain water, etc. In other words, the earth is the place of sustenance for all elements.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 46] The characteristics of the functions of earth can be perceived by modeling forms of the Supreme Brahman, by constructing places of residence, by preparing pots to contain water, etc. In other words, the earth is the place of sustenance for all elements.

units.sanskrit: करम्भपूतिसौरभ्यशान्तोग्राम्लादिभिः पृथक्। द्रव्यावयववैषम्याद् गन्ध एको विभिद्यते॥ ३/२७/४७॥
units.english: [Text 47] The sense whose object of perception is sound is called the auditory sense, and that whose object of perception is touch is called the tactile sense.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 47] The sense whose object of perception is sound is called the auditory sense, and that whose object of perception is touch is called the tactile sense.

units.sanskrit: भावनं ब्रह्मणः स्थानं धारणं सद्विशेषणम्। सर्वसत्वगुणोद्भेदः पृथिवीवृत्तिलक्षणम्॥ ३/२७/४८॥
units.english: [Text 48] The sense whose object of perception is form, the distinctive characteristic of fire, is the sense of sight. The sense whose object of perception is taste, the distinctive characteristic of water, is known as the sense of taste. Finally, the sense whose object of perception is odor, the distinctive characteristic of earth, is called the sense of smell.

parts.sanskrit: भावनं ब्रह्मणः स्थानं धारणं सद्विशेषणम्। सर्वसत्वगुणोद्भेदः पृथिवीवृत्तिलक्षणम्॥ ३/२७/४८॥

भावनमुत्पादकत्वम् । “ब्रह्मस्थानं तु पृथिवी शरीरे ब्रह्मदर्शनात्” इति कापिलेये। सद्विशेषणं विशेषेण व्यक्तत्वम्। “असदव्यक्तनाम स्याद् व्यक्तं सदिति चोच्यते” इति ब्राह्मे।
सर्वसत्वगुणोद्भेदः शरीरे हि सर्वप्राणिनां गुणा व्यज्यन्ते संसारावस्थायाम्।
“शरीरं पार्थिवं ज्ञेयमिन्द्रियाण्यौदकानि तु।
तैजसः कोष्ठगो वह्निश्छिद्रमाकाशसम्भवम्।
प्राणा वायुमयाः सर्वे प्रत्येकं प्रञ्चधा पुनः॥”
इति कापिलेये॥ ४८॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 48] The sense whose object of perception is form, the distinctive characteristic of fire, is the sense of sight. The sense whose object of perception is taste, the distinctive characteristic of water, is known as the sense of taste. Finally, the sense whose object of perception is odor, the distinctive characteristic of earth, is called the sense of smell.

units.sanskrit: नभोगुणविशेषोऽर्थो यस्य तच्छ्रोत्रमुच्यते। वायोर्गुणविशेषोऽर्थो यस्य तत् स्पर्शनं विदुः॥ ३/२७/४९॥
units.english: [Text 49] Since the cause exists in its effect as well, the characteristics of the former are observed in the latter. That is why the peculiarities of all the elements exist in the earth alone.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 49] Since the cause exists in its effect as well, the characteristics of the former are observed in the latter. That is why the peculiarities of all the elements exist in the earth alone.

units.sanskrit: तेजोगुणविशेषोऽर्थो यस्य तच्चक्षुरुच्यते। अम्भोगुणविशेषोऽर्थो यस्य तद् रसनं विदुः॥ ३/२७/५०॥
units.english: [Text 50] When all these elements were unmixed, the Lord, the origin of creation, along with time, work, and the qualities of the modes of material nature, entered into the universe with the total material energy in seven divisions.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 50] When all these elements were unmixed, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the origin of creation, along with time, work, and the qualities of the modes of material nature, entered into the universe with the total material energy in seven divisions.

units.sanskrit: भूमेर्गुणविशेषोऽर्थो यस्य स घ्राण उच्यते। परस्य दृश्यते धर्मो ह्यपरस्मिन् समन्वयात्॥ ३/२७/५१॥
units.english: [Text 51] From these seven principles, roused into activity and united by the presence of the Lord, an unintelligent egg arose, from which appeared the celebrated Cosmic Being.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 51] From these seven principles, roused into activity and united by the presence of the Lord, an unintelligent egg arose, from which appeared the celebrated Cosmic Being.

units.sanskrit: अतो विशेषो भावानां भूमावेवोपलक्ष्यते। एतान्यसंहत्य यदा महदादीनि सप्त वै॥ ३/२७/५२॥
units.english: [Text 52] This universal egg, or the universe in the shape of an egg, is called the manifestation of material energy. Its layers of water, air, fire, sky, ego and mahat-tattva increase in thickness one after another. Each layer is ten times bigger than the previous one, and the final outside layer is covered by pradhāna. Within this egg is the universal form of Lord Hari, of whose body the fourteen planetary systems are parts.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 52] This universal egg, or the universe in the shape of an egg, is called the manifestation of material energy. Its layers of water, air, fire, sky, ego and mahat-tattva increase in thickness one after another. Each layer is ten times bigger than the previous one, and the final outside layer is covered by pradhāna. Within this egg is the universal form of Lord Hari, of whose body the fourteen planetary systems are parts.

units.sanskrit: न शेकुः पुरुषं स्रष्टुं भोगायतनमञ्जसा। कालकर्मगुणोपेतो जगदादिरुपाविशत्॥ ३/२७/५३॥
units.english: [Text 53] The Lord, the virāṭ-puruṣa, situated Himself in that golden egg, which was lying on the water, and He divided it into many departments.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 53] The Supreme Personality of Godhead, the virāṭ-puruṣa, situated Himself in that golden egg, which was lying on the water, and He divided it into many departments.

units.sanskrit: ततस्तेनानुविद्धेभ्यस्तत्त्वेभ्योऽण्डमचेतनम्। उत्थितं पुरुषो यस्मादुदतिष्ठदसौ विराट्॥ ३/२७/५४॥
units.english: [Text 54] First of all a mouth appeared in Him, and then came forth the organ of speech, and with it the god of fire, the deity who presides over that organ. Then a pair of nostrils appeared, and in them appeared the olfactory sense, as well as prāṇa, the vital air.

parts.sanskrit: ततस्तेनानुविद्धेभ्यस्तत्त्वेभ्योऽण्डमचेतनम्। उत्थितं पुरुषो यस्मादुदतिष्ठदसौ विराट्॥ ३/२७/५४॥

“अचेतनाद् यतस्त्वण्डाद् ब्रह्मा समजनि स्फुटम्।
अतो ब्रह्माण्डमित्याहुर्विराड् ब्रह्मा प्रकाशनात्॥”
इति च॥ ५४ ॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 54] First of all a mouth appeared in Him, and then came forth the organ of speech, and with it the god of fire, the deity who presides over that organ. Then a pair of nostrils appeared, and in them appeared the olfactory sense, as well as prāṇa, the vital air.

units.sanskrit: एतदण्डं विशेषाख्यं क्रमवृद्धैर्दशोत्तरैः। तोयादिभिः परिवृतं प्रधानेनावृतं बहिः। यत्र लोकवितानोऽयं रूपं भगवतो हरेः॥ ३/२७/५५॥
units.english: [Text 55] In the wake of the olfactory sense came the wind-god, who presides over that sense. Thereafter a pair of eyes appeared in the universal form, and in them the sense of sight. In the wake of this sense came the sun-god, who presides over it. Next there appeared in Him a pair of ears, and in them the auditory sense and in its wake the Dig-devatās, or the deities who preside over the directions.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 55] In the wake of the olfactory sense came the wind-god, who presides over that sense. Thereafter a pair of eyes appeared in the universal form, and in them the sense of sight. In the wake of this sense came the sun-god, who presides over it. Next there appeared in Him a pair of ears, and in them the auditory sense and in its wake the Dig-devatās, or the deities who preside over the directions.

units.sanskrit: हिरण्मयादाण्डकोशादुत्थाय सलिलेशयात्। तमाविश्य महादेवो बहुधा निर्बिभेद खम्॥ ३/२७/५६॥
units.english: [Text 56] Then the universal form of the Lord, the virāṭ-puruṣa, manifested His skin, and thereupon the hair, mustache and beard appeared. After this all the herbs and drugs became manifested, and then His genitals also appeared.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 56] Then the universal form of the Lord, the virāṭ-puruṣa, manifested His skin, and thereupon the hair, mustache and beard appeared. After this all the herbs and drugs became manifested, and then His genitals also appeared.

units.sanskrit: निरभिद्यतास्य प्रथमं मुखं वाणी ततोऽभवत्। वाण्या वह्निरथो नासे घ्राणोऽतः प्राण एतयोः॥ ३/२७/५७॥
units.english: [Text 57] After this, semen (the faculty of procreation) and the god who presides over the waters appeared. Next appeared an anus and then the organs of defecation and thereupon the god of death, who is feared throughout the universe.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 57] After this, semen (the faculty of procreation) and the god who presides over the waters appeared. Next appeared an anus and then the organs of defecation and thereupon the god of death, who is feared throughout the universe.

units.sanskrit: प्राणाद् वायुरभिद्येतामक्षिणी चक्षुरेतयोः। तस्मात् सूर्योऽन्वभिद्येतां कर्णौ श्रोत्रं ततो दिशः॥ ३/२७/५८॥
units.english: [Text 58] Thereafter the two hands of the universal form of the Lord became manifested, and with them the power of grasping and dropping things, and after that Lord Indra appeared. Next the legs became manifested, and with them the process of movement, and after that Lord Viṣṇu appeared.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 58] Thereafter the two hands of the universal form of the Lord became manifested, and with them the power of grasping and dropping things, and after that Lord Indra appeared. Next the legs became manifested, and with them the process of movement, and after that Lord Viṣṇu appeared.

units.sanskrit: निर्बिभेद विराजस्त्वग् लोमश्मश्व्रादयस्ततः। ततश्चौषधयः पश्चाच्छिश्नं निर्बिभिदे ततः॥ ३/२७/५९॥
units.english: [Text 59] The veins of the universal body became manifested and thereafter the red corpuscles, or blood. In their wake came the rivers (the deities presiding over the veins), and then appeared an abdomen.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 59] The veins of the universal body became manifested and thereafter the red corpuscles, or blood. In their wake came the rivers (the deities presiding over the veins), and then appeared an abdomen.

units.sanskrit: रेतस्तस्मादाप आसन् निरभिद्यत वै गुदम्। गुदादपानोऽपानाच्च मृत्युर्लोकभयङ्करः॥ ३/२७/६०॥
units.english: [Text 60] Next grew feelings of hunger and thirst, and in their wake came the manifestation of the oceans. Then a heart became manifest, and in the wake of the heart the mind appeared.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 60] Next grew feelings of hunger and thirst, and in their wake came the manifestation of the oceans. Then a heart became manifest, and in the wake of the heart the mind appeared.

units.sanskrit: हस्तौ तु निरभिद्येतां बलं ताभ्यां ततः स्वराट्। पादौ च निरभिद्येतां गतिस्ताभ्यां ततो हरिः॥ ३/२७/६१॥
units.english: [Text 61] After the mind, the moon appeared. Intelligence appeared next, and after intelligence, Lord Brahmā appeared. Then the false ego appeared and then Lord Śiva, and after the appearance of Lord Śiva came consciousness and the deity presiding over consciousness.

parts.sanskrit: हस्तौ तु निरभिद्येतां बलं ताभ्यां ततः स्वराट्। पादौ च निरभिद्येतां गतिस्ताभ्यां ततो हरिः॥ ३/२७/६१॥

“यज्ञनामा तु देवोऽन्यो विज्ञेयः पाददेवता।
तमाविष्टो
हरिर्नित्यं तमाहुः पाददैवतम्।
तस्येन्द्रियाभिमानित्वं कुतः पूर्णामलात्मनः॥”
इति च॥ ६१॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 61] After the mind, the moon appeared. Intelligence appeared next, and after intelligence, Lord Brahmā appeared. Then the false ego appeared and then Lord Śiva, and after the appearance of Lord Śiva came consciousness and the deity presiding over consciousness.

units.sanskrit: नाड्यश्च निरभिद्यन्त ताभ्यो लोहितमाहितम्। नद्यस्ततः समभवन्नुदरं निरभिद्यत॥ ३/२७/६२॥
units.english: [Text 62] When the gods and presiding deities of the various senses were thus manifested, they wanted to wake their origin of appearance. But upon failing to do so, they reentered the body of the virāṭ-puruṣa one after another in order to wake Him.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 62] When the demigods and presiding deities of the various senses were thus manifested, they wanted to wake their origin of appearance. But upon failing to do so, they reentered the body of the virāṭ-puruṣa one after another in order to wake Him.

units.sanskrit: क्षुत्पिपासे ततः स्यातां समुद्रस्तु तयोरभूत्। अथास्य हृदयं भिन्नं हृदयान्मन उत्थितम्॥ ३/२७/६३॥
units.english: [Text 63] The god of fire entered His mouth with the organ of speech, but the virāṭ-puruṣa could not be aroused. Then the god of wind entered His nostrils with the sense of smell, but still the virāṭ-puruṣa refused to be awakened.
