meta.english_verbatim: [Text 63] The god of fire entered His mouth with the organ of speech, but the virāṭ-puruṣa could not be aroused. Then the god of wind entered His nostrils with the sense of smell, but still the virāṭ-puruṣa refused to be awakened.

units.sanskrit: मनसश्चन्द्रमा जातो बुद्धिर्बुद्धेर्गिरां पतिः। अहङ्कारस्ततो रुद्रश्चित्तं चैत्त्यस्ततोऽभवत्॥ ३/२७/६४॥
units.english: [Text 64] The sun-god entered the eyes of the virāṭ-puruṣa with the sense of sight, but still the virāṭ-puruṣa did not get up. Similarly, the predominating deities of the directions entered through His ears with the sense of hearing, but still He did not get up.

parts.sanskrit: मनसश्चन्द्रमा जातो बुद्धिर्बुद्धेर्गिरां पतिः। अहङ्कारस्ततो रुद्रश्चित्तं चैत्त्यस्ततोऽभवत्॥ ३/२७/६४॥

“चैत्योऽपि भगवान् विष्णुरन्तर्यामी चतुर्मुखात्।
स्वेच्छया व्यक्तिमगमत् ततोऽसौ ब्रह्मजः स्मृतः॥”
इति च॥ ६४॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 64] The sun-god entered the eyes of the virāṭ-puruṣa with the sense of sight, but still the virāṭ-puruṣa did not get up. Similarly, the predominating deities of the directions entered through His ears with the sense of hearing, but still He did not get up.

units.sanskrit: एते ह्यभ्युत्थिता देवा नैवास्योत्थापनेऽशकन्। पुनराविविशुः खानि तमुत्थापयितुं क्रमात्॥ ३/२७/६५॥
units.english: [Text 65] The predominating deities of the skin, herbs and seasoning plants entered the skin of the virāṭ-puruṣa with the hair of the body, but the Cosmic Being refused to get up even then. The god predominating over water entered His organ of generation with the faculty of procreation, but the virāṭ-puruṣa still would not rise.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 65] The predominating deities of the skin, herbs and seasoning plants entered the skin of the virāṭ-puruṣa with the hair of the body, but the Cosmic Being refused to get up even then. The god predominating over water entered His organ of generation with the faculty of procreation, but the virāṭ-puruṣa still would not rise.

units.sanskrit: वह्निर्वाचा मुखं भेजे नोदतिष्ठत् तदा विराट्। घ्राणेन नासिको वायुर्नोदतिष्ठत् तदा विराट्॥ ३/२७/६६॥
units.english: [Text 66] The god of death entered His anus with the organ of defecation, but the virāṭ-puruṣa could not be spurred to activity. The god Indra entered the hands with their power of grasping and dropping things, but the virāṭ-puruṣa would not get up even then.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 66] The god of death entered His anus with the organ of defecation, but the virāṭ-puruṣa could not be spurred to activity. The god Indra entered the hands with their power of grasping and dropping things, but the virāṭ-puruṣa would not get up even then.

units.sanskrit: अक्षिणी चक्षुषाऽऽदित्यो नोदतिष्ठत् तदा विराट्। श्रोत्रेण कर्णौ च दिशो नोदतिष्ठत् तदा विराट्॥ ३/२७/६७॥
units.english: [Text 67] Lord Viṣṇu entered His feet with the faculty of locomotion, but the virāṭ-puruṣa refused to stand up even then. The rivers entered His blood vessels with the blood and the power of circulation, but still the Cosmic Being could not be made to stir.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 67] Lord Viṣṇu entered His feet with the faculty of locomotion, but the virāṭ-puruṣa refused to stand up even then. The rivers entered His blood vessels with the blood and the power of circulation, but still the Cosmic Being could not be made to stir.

units.sanskrit: त्वचं लोमभिरोषध्यो नोदतिष्ठत् तदा विराट्। रेतसा शिश्नमापस्तु नोदतिष्ठत् तदा विराट्॥ ३/२७/६८॥
units.english: [Text 68] The ocean entered His abdomen with hunger and thirst, but the Cosmic Being refused to rise even then. The moon-god entered His heart with the mind, but the Cosmic Being would not be roused.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 68] The ocean entered His abdomen with hunger and thirst, but the Cosmic Being refused to rise even then. The moon-god entered His heart with the mind, but the Cosmic Being would not be roused.

units.sanskrit: गुदं मृत्युरपानेन नोदतिष्ठत् तदा विराट्। हस्ताविन्द्रो बलेनैव नोदतिष्ठत् तदा विराट्॥ ३/२७/६९॥
units.english: [Text 69] Brahmā also entered His heart with intelligence, but even then the Cosmic Being could not be prevailed upon to get up. Lord Rudra also entered His heart with the ego, but even then the Cosmic Being did not stir.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 69] Brahmā also entered His heart with intelligence, but even then the Cosmic Being could not be prevailed upon to get up. Lord Rudra also entered His heart with the ego, but even then the Cosmic Being did not stir.

units.sanskrit: विष्णुर्गत्यैव चरणौ नोदतिष्ठत् तदा विराट्। नाडीर्नद्यो लोहितेन नोदतिष्ठत् तदा विराट्॥ ३/२७/७०॥
units.english: [Text 70] However, when the inner controller, the deity presiding over consciousness, entered the heart with reason, at that very moment the Cosmic Being arose from the causal waters.

parts.sanskrit: विष्णुर्गत्यैव चरणौ नोदतिष्ठत् तदा विराट्। नाडीर्नद्यो लोहितेन नोदतिष्ठत् तदा विराट्॥ ३/२७/७०॥

“यज्ञान्तस्थः स्वयं पादौ विशन् नोत्थापयद्धरिः।
शक्तोऽपि ब्रह्मवाय्वोस्तु बलज्ञप्त्यै जनार्दनः।
तत्स्थ उत्थापयामास ब्रह्मदेहं विशन् प्रभुः॥”
इति च॥ ७०॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 70] However, when the inner controller, the deity presiding over consciousness, entered the heart with reason, at that very moment the Cosmic Being arose from the causal waters.

units.sanskrit: क्षुत्तृड्भ्यामुदरं सिन्धुर्नोदतिष्ठत् तदा विराट्। हृदयं मनसा चन्द्रो नोदतिष्ठत् तदा विराट्॥ ३/२७/७१॥
units.english: [Text 71] When a man is sleeping, all his material assets — namely the vital energy, the senses for recording knowledge, the senses for working, the mind and the intelligence — cannot arouse him. He can be aroused only when the Supreme Self helps him.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 71] When a man is sleeping, all his material assets — namely the vital energy, the senses for recording knowledge, the senses for working, the mind and the intelligence — cannot arouse him. He can be aroused only when the Supersoul helps him.

units.sanskrit: बुद्ध्या ब्रह्माऽपि हृदयं नोदतिष्ठत् तदा विराट्। रुद्रोऽभिमत्या हृदयं नोदतिष्ठत् तदा विराट्॥ ३/२७/७२॥
units.english: [Text 72] Therefore, through devotion, detachment and advancement in spiritual knowledge acquired through concentrated devotion, one should contemplate that the Supreme Self as present in this very body although simultaneously apart from it.

parts.sanskrit: बुद्ध्या ब्रह्माऽपि हृदयं नोदतिष्ठत् तदा विराट्। रुद्रोऽभिमत्या हृदयं नोदतिष्ठत् तदा विराट्॥ ३/२७/७२॥
ब्रह्मा बृहस्पतिः । “यस्मिन् ब्रह्मा राजनि पूर्व एति” इति श्रुतिः। “बृहस्पतिः पुरोधाश्च ब्रह्मा च ब्रह्मणस्पतिः” इत्यभिधानम्॥ ७२॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 72] Therefore, through devotion, detachment and advancement in spiritual knowledge acquired through concentrated devotional service, one should contemplate that Supersoul as present in this very body although simultaneously apart from it.

units.sanskrit: चित्तेन हृदयं चैत्त्यः क्षेत्रज्ञः प्राविशद् यदा। विराट् तदैव पुरुषः सलिलादुदतिष्ठत॥ ३/२७/७३॥

parts.sanskrit: चित्तेन हृदयं चैत्त्यः क्षेत्रज्ञः प्राविशद् यदा। विराट् तदैव पुरुषः सलिलादुदतिष्ठत॥ ३/२७/७३॥

“अंशेन सुप्तो ब्रह्माऽपि अंशेन निरगात् तथा।
स्वदेहाद् वायुसहितो विष्णुना च जगत्प्रभुः।
तमुत्थापयितुं देवास्तानृते त्रीन् महाबलान्।
नाशक्नुवुन् एकसंस्थास्ततस्ते त्वविशंस्त्रयः।
उदतिष्ठद् ब्रह्मदेहस्तदा तेषां प्रभावतः।
विशेषेण हरेरेव प्रभावेन श्रियःपतेः।
चित्ताभिमानी ब्रह्मैव क्षेत्रज्ञस्तद्गतो हरिः।
प्राणो वायुरिति प्रोक्तस्तयोरीशो हरिः स्वयम्॥”
इति च ॥ ७३ ॥

units.sanskrit: यथा प्रसुप्तं पुरुषं प्राणेन्द्रियमनोधियः। प्रभवन्ति विना येन नोत्थापयितुमोजसा॥ ३/२७/७४॥
तमस्मिन् प्रत्यगात्मानं धिया योगविपक्वया। भक्त्या विरक्त्या ज्ञानेन विविच्याऽऽत्मनि चिन्तयेत्॥ ३/२७/७५॥

श्रीभगवानुवाच-
प्रकृतिस्थोऽपि पुरुषो नाज्यते प्रकृतेर्गुणैः। अविकारादकर्तृत्वान्निर्गुणत्वाज्जलार्कवत्॥ ३/२८/१॥
units.english: [Text 1] The Lord Kapila continued: When the living being is thus unaffected by the modes of material nature, because he is unchanging and does not claim proprietorship, he remains apart from the reactions of the modes, although abiding in a material body, just as the sun remains aloof from its reflection on water.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 1] The Personality of Godhead Kapila continued: When the living entity is thus unaffected by the modes of material nature, because he is unchanging and does not claim proprietorship, he remains apart from the reactions of the modes, although abiding in a material body, just as the sun remains aloof from its reflection on water.

units.sanskrit: स एष यर्हि प्रकृतेर्गुणेष्वभिविषज्जते। अहङ्कारविमूढात्मा कर्तास्मीत्यभिमन्यते॥ ३/२८/२॥
units.english: [Text 2] When the soul is under the spell of material nature and false ego, identifying his body as the self, he becomes absorbed in material activities, and by the influence of false ego he thinks that he is the proprietor of everything.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 2] When the soul is under the spell of material nature and false ego, identifying his body as the self, he becomes absorbed in material activities, and by the influence of false ego he thinks that he is the proprietor of everything.

units.sanskrit: तेन संसारपदवीं मनसाऽभ्येत्यनिर्वृतः। प्रासङ्गिकैः कर्मदोषैः सदसन्मिश्रयोनिषु॥ ३/२८/३॥
units.english: [Text 3] The conditioned soul therefore transmigrates into different species of life, higher and lower, because of his association with the modes of material nature. Unless he is relieved of material activities, he has to accept this position because of his faulty work.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 3] The conditioned soul therefore transmigrates into different species of life, higher and lower, because of his association with the modes of material nature. Unless he is relieved of material activities, he has to accept this position because of his faulty work.

units.sanskrit: अर्थे ह्यविद्यमानेऽपि संसृतिर्न निवर्तते। ध्यायतो विषयानस्य स्वप्नेऽनर्थागमो यथा॥ ३/२८/४॥
units.english: [Text 4] Actually a living being is transcendental to material existence, but because of his mentality of lording it over material nature, his material existential condition does not cease, and just as in a dream, he is affected by all sorts of disadvantages.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 4] Actually a living entity is transcendental to material existence, but because of his mentality of lording it over material nature, his material existential condition does not cease, and just as in a dream, he is affected by all sorts of disadvantages.

units.sanskrit: प्रबुद्ध्य स्वप्नसुप्तिभ्यां संस्मरन्नात्मवैशसम्। वैतथ्यं व्यभिचारं च नासौ ध्यायेद् यतो भयम्॥ ३/२८/५॥
units.english: [Text 5] It is the duty of every conditioned soul to engage his polluted consciousness, which is now attached to material enjoyment, in very serious devotion with detachment. Thus his mind and consciousness will be under full control.

parts.sanskrit: प्रबुद्ध्य स्वप्नसुप्तिभ्यां संस्मरन्नात्मवैशसम्। वैतथ्यं व्यभिचारं च नासौ ध्यायेद् यतो भयम्॥ ३/२८/५॥

“अज्ञानं सुप्तिशब्दोक्तं स्वप्नश्चैव विपर्ययः”
इति भारते॥ ५॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 5] It is the duty of every conditioned soul to engage his polluted consciousness, which is now attached to material enjoyment, in very serious devotional service with detachment. Thus his mind and consciousness will be under full control.

units.sanskrit: अत एव शनैश्चित्तं प्रसक्तमसतां पथि। भक्तियोगेन तीव्रेण विरक्त्याऽऽत्मवशं नयेत्॥ ३/२८/६॥
units.english: [Text 6] One has to become faithful by practicing the controlling process of the yoga system and must elevate himself to the platform of unalloyed devotion by chanting and hearing about Me.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 6] One has to become faithful by practicing the controlling process of the yoga system and must elevate himself to the platform of unalloyed devotional service by chanting and hearing about Me.

units.sanskrit: यमादिभिर्योगपथैरभ्यसञ्छ्रद्धयाऽन्वितः। मयि भावेन सत्येन मत्कथाश्रवणेन च॥ ३/२८/७॥
units.english: [Text 7] In executing devotion, one has to see every living being equally, without enmity towards anyone yet without intimate connections with anyone. One has to observe celibacy, be grave and execute his eternal activities, offering the results to the Lord.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 7] In executing devotional service, one has to see every living entity equally, without enmity towards anyone yet without intimate connections with anyone. One has to observe celibacy, be grave and execute his eternal activities, offering the results to the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

units.sanskrit: सर्वभूतसमत्वेन निर्वैरेणाप्रसङ्गतः। ब्रह्मचर्येण मौनेन स्वधर्मेण महीयसा॥ ३/२८/८॥
units.english: [Text 8] For his income a devotee should be satisfied with what he earns without great difficulty. He should not eat more than what is necessary. He should live in a secluded place and always be thoughtful, peaceful, friendly, compassionate and self-realized.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 8] For his income a devotee should be satisfied with what he earns without great difficulty. He should not eat more than what is necessary. He should live in a secluded place and always be thoughtful, peaceful, friendly, compassionate and self-realized.

units.sanskrit: यदृच्छयोपलब्धेन सन्तुष्टो मितभुङ् मुनिः। विविक्तशरणः शान्तो मैत्रः करुण आत्मवान्॥ ३/२८/९॥
units.english: [Text 9] One’s seeing power should be increased through knowledge of spirit and matter, and one should not unnecessarily identify himself with the body and thus become attracted by bodily relationships.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 9] One’s seeing power should be increased through knowledge of spirit and matter, and one should not unnecessarily identify himself with the body and thus become attracted by bodily relationships.

units.sanskrit: सानुबन्धे च देहेऽस्मिन्नकुर्वन्नसदाग्रहम्। ज्ञानेन दृष्टतत्त्वेन प्रकृतेः पुरुषस्य च॥ ३/२८/१०॥
units.english: [Text 10] One should be situated in the transcendental position, beyond the stages of material consciousness, and should be aloof from all other conceptions of life. Thus realizing freedom from false ego, one should see his own self just as he sees the sun in the sky.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 10] One should be situated in the transcendental position, beyond the stages of material consciousness, and should be aloof from all other conceptions of life. Thus realizing freedom from false ego, one should see his own self just as he sees the sun in the sky.

units.sanskrit: निवृत्तबुद्ध्यवाक्स्थानो दूरीभूतान्यदर्शनः। उपलभ्यात्मनाऽऽत्मानं चक्षुषेवार्कमेकदृक्॥ ३/२८/११॥
units.english: [Text 11] A liberated soul realizes the Lord, who is transcendental and who is manifest as a reflection even in the false ego. He is the support of the material cause and He enters into everything. He is absolute, one without a second, and He is the eyes of the illusory energy.

parts.sanskrit: निवृत्तबुद्ध्यवाक्स्थानो दूरीभूतान्यदर्शनः। उपलभ्यात्मनाऽऽत्मानं चक्षुषेवार्कमेकदृक्॥ ३/२८/११॥
बुद्धेरवस्थानं निद्रादि॥ ११॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 11] A liberated soul realizes the Absolute Personality of Godhead, who is transcendental and who is manifest as a reflection even in the false ego. He is the support of the material cause and He enters into everything. He is absolute, one without a second, and He is the eyes of the illusory energy.

units.sanskrit: मुक्तलिङ्गः सदाभासमसति प्रतिपद्यते। सतो बन्धुं समं चक्षुः सर्वानुस्यूतमद्वयम्॥३/२८/१२॥
units.english: [Text 12] The presence of the Supreme Lord can be realized just as the sun is realized first as a reflection on water, and again as a second reflection on the wall of a room, although the sun itself is situated in the sky.

parts.sanskrit: मुक्तलिङ्गः सदाभासमसति प्रतिपद्यते। सतो बन्धुं समं चक्षुः सर्वानुस्यूतमद्वयम्॥३/२८/१२॥

असति प्रलये।
“शेषस्य प्रतिबिम्बास्तु देवाः शेषस्तु ब्रह्मणः।
स परब्रह्मणश्चैव ते स्वबिम्बप्रदर्शकाः।
ततः स्वबिम्बद्वारेण परमात्मप्रदर्शनम्॥”
इति ब्रह्मतर्के॥ १२॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 12] The presence of the Supreme Lord can be realized just as the sun is realized first as a reflection on water, and again as a second reflection on the wall of a room, although the sun itself is situated in the sky.

units.sanskrit: यथा जलस्थ आभासः स्थलस्थेनाथ दृश्यते। स्वाभासेन यथा सूर्यो जलस्थेन दिवि स्थितः॥ ३/२८/१३॥
units.english: [Text 13] The self-realized soul is thus reflected first in the threefold ego and then in the body, senses and mind.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 13] The self-realized soul is thus reflected first in the threefold ego and then in the body, senses and mind.

units.sanskrit: एवं त्रिवृदहङ्कारो भूतेन्द्रियमनोगुणैः। स्वाभासैर्लक्षितोऽनेन सदाभासेन सत्यदृक्॥ ३/२८/१४॥
units.english: [Text 14] Although a devotee appears to be merged in the five material elements, the objects of material enjoyment, the material senses and material mind and intelligence, he is understood to be awake and to be freed from the false ego.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 14] Although a devotee appears to be merged in the five material elements, the objects of material enjoyment, the material senses and material mind and intelligence, he is understood to be awake and to be freed from the false ego.

units.sanskrit: भूतसूक्ष्मेन्द्रियमनोबुद्ध्यादिष्विह निद्रया। लीनेषु सत्सु यस्तत्र विनिद्रो निरहङ्क्रियः॥ ३/२८/१५॥
units.english: [Text 15] The living being can vividly feel his existence as the seer, but because of the disappearance of the ego during the state of deep sleep, he falsely takes himself to be lost, like a man who has lost his fortune and feels distressed, thinking himself to be lost.

parts.sanskrit: भूतसूक्ष्मेन्द्रियमनोबुद्ध्यादिष्विह निद्रया। लीनेषु सत्सु यस्तत्र विनिद्रो निरहङ्क्रियः॥ ३/२८/१५॥
यो विनिद्रः स सत्यदृक्॥१४-१५॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 15] The living entity can vividly feel his existence as the seer, but because of the disappearance of the ego during the state of deep sleep, he falsely takes himself to be lost, like a man who has lost his fortune and feels distressed, thinking himself to be lost.

units.sanskrit: मन्यमानस्तदाऽऽत्मानमनष्टो नष्टवन्मृषा। नष्टेऽहङ्करणे द्रष्टा नष्टवित्त इवातुरः॥ ३/२८/१६॥
units.english: [Text 16] When, by mature understanding, one can realize his individuality, then the situation he accepts under false ego becomes manifest to him.

parts.sanskrit: मन्यमानस्तदाऽऽत्मानमनष्टो नष्टवन्मृषा। नष्टेऽहङ्करणे द्रष्टा नष्टवित्त इवातुरः॥ ३/२८/१६॥
योऽनष्टो नष्टवन्नाज्ञासिषमिति मन्यमानः स आतुरो द्रष्टा जीवः॥१६॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 16] When, by mature understanding, one can realize his individuality, then the situation he accepts under false ego becomes manifest to him.

units.sanskrit: एवं प्रत्यवमृश्यासावात्मानं प्रतिपद्यते। साहङ्कारस्य द्रव्यस्य योऽवस्थानमनुग्रहः॥ ३/२८/१७॥
units.english: [Text 17] Devahūti inquired: My dear brāhmaṇa, does material nature ever give release to the spirit soul? Since one is attracted to the other eternally, how is their separation possible?

parts.sanskrit: एवं प्रत्यवमृश्यासावात्मानं प्रतिपद्यते। साहङ्कारस्य द्रव्यस्य योऽवस्थानमनुग्रहः॥ ३/२८/१७॥

साहङ्कारं द्रव्यं जीवः तस्यावस्थानमनुग्राहकश्च परमात्मा।
“नित्यदृक् परमात्माऽसौ मृतवद् यो न किञ्चन।
जानाति जीवः स ज्ञेयः परमात्मा तदाश्रयः॥”
इति हरिवंशेषु॥ १७॥

english_edits.rule: honorific Śrī before a name removed

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 17] Śrī Devahūti inquired: My dear brāhmaṇa, does material nature ever give release to the spirit soul? Since one is attracted to the other eternally, how is their separation possible?

units.sanskrit:
देवहूतिरुवाच-
पुरुषं प्रकृतिर्ब्रह्मन् न विमुञ्चति कर्हिचित्। अन्योन्यापाश्रयत्वाच्च नित्यत्वादनयोः प्रभो॥ ३/२८/१८॥
units.english: [Text 18] As there is no separate existence of the earth and its aroma or of water and its taste, there cannot be any separate existence of intelligence and consciousness.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 18] As there is no separate existence of the earth and its aroma or of water and its taste, there cannot be any separate existence of intelligence and consciousness.

units.sanskrit: यथा गन्धस्य भूमेश्च न भावो व्यतिरेकतः। अपां रसस्य च यथा तथा बुद्धेः परस्य च॥ ३/२८/१९॥
units.english: [Text 19] Hence even though he is the passive performer of all activities, how can there be freedom for the soul as long as material nature acts on him and binds him?

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 19] Hence even though he is the passive performer of all activities, how can there be freedom for the soul as long as material nature acts on him and binds him?

units.sanskrit: अकर्तुः कर्मबन्धोऽयं पुरुषस्य यदाश्रयः। गुणेषु सत्सु प्रकृतेः कैवल्यं तेष्वतः कथम्॥ ३/२८/२०॥
units.english: [Text 20] Even if the great fear of bondage is avoided by mental speculation and inquiry into the fundamental principles, it may still appear again, since its cause has not ceased.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 20] Even if the great fear of bondage is avoided by mental speculation and inquiry into the fundamental principles, it may still appear again, since its cause has not ceased.

units.sanskrit: सकृत् तत्त्वावमर्शेन निवृत्तं भयमुद्बणम्। अनिवृत्तनिमित्तत्त्वात् पुनः प्रत्यवतिष्ठते॥ ३/२८/२१॥
units.english: [Text 21] The Lord said: One can get liberation by seriously discharging devotion unto Me and thereby hearing for a long time about Me or from Me. By thus executing one’s prescribed duties, there will be no reaction, and one will be freed from the contamination of matter.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 21] The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: One can get liberation by seriously discharging devotional service unto Me and thereby hearing for a long time about Me or from Me. By thus executing one’s prescribed duties, there will be no reaction, and one will be freed from the contamination of matter.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच-
अनिमित्तप्रवृत्तेन स्वधर्मेणामलात्मना। तीव्रया मयि भक्त्या च श्रुतिसम्भृतया चिरम्॥ ३/२८/२२॥
units.english: [Text 22] This devotion has to be performed strongly in perfect knowledge and with transcendental vision. One must be strongly renounced and must engage in austerity and perform mystic yoga in order to be firmly fixed in self-absorption.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 22] This devotional service has to be performed strongly in perfect knowledge and with transcendental vision. One must be strongly renounced and must engage in austerity and perform mystic yoga in order to be firmly fixed in self-absorption.

units.sanskrit: दृष्टतत्त्वेन ज्ञानेन वैराग्येण बलीयसा। तपोयुक्तेन योगेन तीव्रेणात्मसमाधिना॥ ३/२८/२३॥
units.english: [Text 23] The influence of material nature has covered the living being, and thus it is as if the living being were always in a blazing fire. But by the process of seriously discharging devotion, this influence can be removed, just as wooden sticks which cause a fire are themselves consumed by it.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 23] The influence of material nature has covered the living entity, and thus it is as if the living entity were always in a blazing fire. But by the process of seriously discharging devotional service, this influence can be removed, just as wooden sticks which cause a fire are themselves consumed by it.

units.sanskrit: प्रकृतिः पुरुषस्यैवं दह्यमाना त्वहर्निशम्। तिरोभवित्री शनकैरग्नेर्योनिरिवारणिः॥ ३/२८/२४॥
units.english: [Text 24] By discovering the faultiness of his desiring to lord it over material nature and by therefore giving it up, the living being becomes independent and stands in his own glory.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 24] By discovering the faultiness of his desiring to lord it over material nature and by therefore giving it up, the living entity becomes independent and stands in his own glory.

units.sanskrit: भुक्तभोगा परित्यक्ता दृष्टदोषा च नित्यशः। नेश्वरस्याशुभं धत्ते स्वे महिम्नि स्थितस्य च॥ ३/२८/२५॥
units.english: [Text 25] In the dreaming state one’s consciousness is almost covered, and one sees many inauspicious things, but when he is awakened and fully conscious, such inauspicious things cannot bewilder him.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 25] In the dreaming state one’s consciousness is almost covered, and one sees many inauspicious things, but when he is awakened and fully conscious, such inauspicious things cannot bewilder him.

units.sanskrit: यथा ह्यप्रतिबुद्धस्य प्रस्वापो बह्वनर्थकृत्। स एव प्रतिबुद्धस्य न वै मोहाय कल्पते॥ ३/२८/२६॥
units.english: [Text 26] The influence of material nature cannot harm an enlightened soul, even though he engages in material activities, because he knows the truth of the Absolute, and his mind is fixed on the Lord.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 26] The influence of material nature cannot harm an enlightened soul, even though he engages in material activities, because he knows the truth of the Absolute, and his mind is fixed on the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

units.sanskrit: एवं विदिततत्त्वस्य प्रकृतिर्मयि मानसम्। युञ्जतो नापकुरुते आत्मारामस्य कर्हिचित्॥ ३/२८/२७॥
units.english: [Text 27] When a person thus engages in devotion and self-realization for many, many years and births, he becomes completely reluctant to enjoy any one of the material planets, even up to the highest planet, which is known as Brahmaloka; he becomes fully developed in consciousness.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 27] When a person thus engages in devotional service and self-realization for many, many years and births, he becomes completely reluctant to enjoy any one of the material planets, even up to the highest planet, which is known as Brahmaloka; he becomes fully developed in consciousness.

units.sanskrit:
यदैवमध्यात्मरतः कालेन बहुजन्मना। सर्वत्र जातवैराग्य आब्रह्मभवनान्मुनिः॥ ३/२८/२८॥
मद्भक्तः प्रतिबुद्धार्थो मत्प्रसादेन भूयसा। निःश्रेयसं स्वसंस्थानं कैवल्याख्यं मदाश्रयम्॥ ३/२८/२९॥
units.english: [Text 28-29] My devotee actually becomes self-realized by My unlimited causeless mercy, and thus, when freed from all doubts, he steadily progresses towards his destined abode, which is directly under the protection of My spiritual energy of unadulterated bliss. That is the ultimate perfectional goal of the living being. After giving up the present material body, the mystic devotee goes to that transcendental abode and never comes back.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 28-29] My devotee actually becomes self-realized by My unlimited causeless mercy, and thus, when freed from all doubts, he steadily progresses towards his destined abode, which is directly under the protection of My spiritual energy of unadulterated bliss. That is the ultimate perfectional goal of the living entity. After giving up the present material body, the mystic devotee goes to that transcendental abode and never comes back.

units.sanskrit: प्राप्नोतीहाञ्जसा धीरः स्वदृशा च्छिन्नसंशयः। यद् गत्वा न निवर्तेत योगी लिङ्गविनिर्गमे॥ ३/२८/३०॥
units.english: [Text 30] When a perfect yogī’s attention is no longer attracted to the by-products of mystic powers, which are manifestations of the external energy, his progress towards Me becomes unlimited, and thus the power of death cannot overcome him.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 30] When a perfect yogī’s attention is no longer attracted to the by-products of mystic powers, which are manifestations of the external energy, his progress towards Me becomes unlimited, and thus the power of death cannot overcome him.

units.sanskrit: यदा न योगोपचितासु चेतो मायासु सिद्धस्य विषज्जते च। अनन्यहेतुष्वथ मे गतिः स्यादात्यन्तिका यत्र न मृत्युहासः॥ ३/२८/३१॥

श्रीभगवानुवाच-
योगस्य लक्षणं वक्ष्ये सबीजस्य नृपात्मजे। मनो येनैव विधिना प्रसन्नं याति सत्पथम्॥ ३/२९/१॥
units.english: [Text 1] The Lord said: My dear mother, O daughter of the King, now I shall explain to you the system of yoga, the object of which is to concentrate the mind. By practicing this system one can become joyful and progressively advance towards the path of the Absolute Truth.

parts.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच-
योगस्य लक्षणं वक्ष्ये सबीजस्य नृपात्मजे। मनो येनैव विधिना प्रसन्नं याति सत्पथम्॥ ३/२९/१॥

“सबीजो वैष्णवो योगो निर्बीजस्त्वन्यदैवतः।
बीजं विष्णुर्हि जगतः शाखाद्याश्चान्यदेवताः॥”
इति कौर्मे॥ १॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 1] The Personality of Godhead said: My dear mother, O daughter of the King, now I shall explain to you the system of yoga, the object of which is to concentrate the mind. By practicing this system one can become joyful and progressively advance towards the path of the Absolute Truth.

units.sanskrit: स्वधर्माचरणं शक्त्या विधर्माच्च निवर्तनम्। दैवलब्धेन सन्तोष आत्मविच्चरणार्चनम्॥ ३/२९/२॥
units.english: [Text 2] One should execute his prescribed duties to the best of his ability and avoid performing duties not allotted to him. One should be satisfied with as much gain as he achieves by the grace of the Lord, and one should worship the lotus feet of a teacher.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 2] One should execute his prescribed duties to the best of his ability and avoid performing duties not allotted to him. One should be satisfied with as much gain as he achieves by the grace of the Lord, and one should worship the lotus feet of a spiritual master.

units.sanskrit: ग्राम्यधर्मनिवृत्तिश्च मोक्षधर्मरतिस्तथा। मितमेध्यादनं शश्वद् विविक्तक्षेत्रसेवनम्॥ ३/२९/३॥
units.english: [Text 3] One should cease performing conventional religious practices and should be attracted to those which lead to salvation. One should eat very frugally and should always remain secluded so that he can achieve the highest perfection of life.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 3] One should cease performing conventional religious practices and should be attracted to those which lead to salvation. One should eat very frugally and should always remain secluded so that he can achieve the highest perfection of life.

units.sanskrit: अहिंसा सत्यमस्तेयं यावदर्थपरिग्रहः। ब्रह्मचर्यं तपः शौचं स्वाध्यायः पुरुषार्चनम्॥ ३/२९/४॥
units.english: [Text 4] One should practice nonviolence and truthfulness, should avoid thieving and be satisfied with possessing as much as he needs for his maintenance. He should abstain from sex life, perform austerity, be clean, study the Vedas and worship the supreme form of the Lord.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 4] One should practice nonviolence and truthfulness, should avoid thieving and be satisfied with possessing as much as he needs for his maintenance. He should abstain from sex life, perform austerity, be clean, study the Vedas and worship the supreme form of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

units.sanskrit: सदासनजयः स्थैर्यं धैर्यं प्राणजयः शनैः। प्रत्याहारश्चेन्द्रियाणां विषयान्मनसा हृदि॥ ३/२९/५॥
units.english: [Text 5] One must observe silence, acquire steadiness by practicing different yogic postures, control the breathing of the vital air, withdraw the senses from sense objects and thus concentrate the mind on the heart.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 5] One must observe silence, acquire steadiness by practicing different yogic postures, control the breathing of the vital air, withdraw the senses from sense objects and thus concentrate the mind on the heart.

units.sanskrit: स्वधिष्ण्यानामेकदेशे मनसा प्राणधारणम्। वैकुण्ठलीलाभिध्यानं समाधानं तथाऽऽत्मनः॥ ३/२९/६॥
units.english: [Text 6] Fixing the vital air and the mind in one of the six circles of vital air circulation within the body, thus concentrating one’s mind on the transcendental pastimes of the Lord, is called samādhi, or samādhāna, of the mind.

parts.sanskrit: स्वधिष्ण्यानामेकदेशे मनसा प्राणधारणम्। वैकुण्ठलीलाभिध्यानं समाधानं तथाऽऽत्मनः॥ ३/२९/६॥

“समाधिरप्रयत्नेन मनसः संस्थितिर्भवेत्”
इति च॥ ६॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 6] Fixing the vital air and the mind in one of the six circles of vital air circulation within the body, thus concentrating one’s mind on the transcendental pastimes of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is called samādhi, or samādhāna, of the mind.

units.sanskrit: एतैरन्यैश्च विधिभिर्मनो दुष्टमसत्पथम्। बुद्ध्या युञ्जीत शनकैर्जितप्राणो ह्यतन्द्रितः॥ ३/२९/७॥
units.english: [Text 7] By these processes, or any other true process, one must control the contaminated, unbridled mind, which is always attracted by material enjoyment, and thus fix himself in thought of the Lord.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 7] By these processes, or any other true process, one must control the contaminated, unbridled mind, which is always attracted by material enjoyment, and thus fix himself in thought of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

units.sanskrit: शुचौ देशे प्रतिष्ठाप्य विजितासन आसनम्। तस्मिन् स्वस्तिक आसीन ऋजुकायः समभ्यसेत्॥ ३/२९/८॥
units.english: [Text 8] After controlling one’s mind and sitting postures, one should spread a seat in a secluded and sanctified place, sit there in an easy posture, keeping the body erect, and practice breath control.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 8] After controlling one’s mind and sitting postures, one should spread a seat in a secluded and sanctified place, sit there in an easy posture, keeping the body erect, and practice breath control.

units.sanskrit: प्राणस्य शोधयेन्मार्गं पूरकुम्भकरेचकैः। प्रतिकूलेन वा चित्तं यथा स्थिरमचञ्चलम्॥ ३/२९/९॥
units.english: [Text 9] The yogī should clear the passage of vital air by breathing in the following manner: first he should inhale very deeply, then hold the breath in, and finally exhale. Or, reversing the process, the yogi can first exhale, then hold the breath outside, and finally inhale. This is done so that the mind may become steady and free from external disturbances.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 9] The yogī should clear the passage of vital air by breathing in the following manner: first he should inhale very deeply, then hold the breath in, and finally exhale. Or, reversing the process, the yogi can first exhale, then hold the breath outside, and finally inhale. This is done so that the mind may become steady and free from external disturbances.

units.sanskrit: मनोऽचिरात् स्याद् विरजं जितश्वासस्य योगिनः। वाय्वग्निभ्यां यथा लोहं ध्मातं त्यजति वै मलम्॥ ३/२९/१०॥
units.english: [Text 10] The yogīs who practice such breathing exercises are very soon freed from all mental disturbances, just as gold, when put into fire and fanned with air, becomes free from all impurities.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 10] The yogīs who practice such breathing exercises are very soon freed from all mental disturbances, just as gold, when put into fire and fanned with air, becomes free from all impurities.

units.sanskrit: प्राणायामैर्दहेद् दोषान् धारणाभिश्च किल्बिषान्। प्रत्याहारेण संसर्गान् ध्यानेनानीश्वरान् गुणान्॥ ३/२९/११॥
units.english: [Text 11] By practicing the process of prāṇāyāma, one can eradicate the contamination of his physiological condition, and by concentrating the mind one can become free from all sinful activities. By restraining the senses one can free himself from material association, and by meditating on the Lord one can become free from the three modes of material attachment.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 11] By practicing the process of prāṇāyāma, one can eradicate the contamination of his physiological condition, and by concentrating the mind one can become free from all sinful activities. By restraining the senses one can free himself from material association, and by meditating on the Supreme Personality of Godhead one can become free from the three modes of material attachment.

units.sanskrit: यदा मनः स्वं विरजं योगेन सुसमाहितम्। काष्ठां भगवतो ध्यायेत् स्वनासाग्रावलोकनः॥ ३/२९/१२॥
units.english: [Text 12] When the mind is perfectly purified by this practice of yoga, one should concentrate on the tip of the nose with half-closed eyes and see the form of the Lord.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 12] When the mind is perfectly purified by this practice of yoga, one should concentrate on the tip of the nose with half-closed eyes and see the form of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

units.sanskrit: प्रसन्नवदनाम्भोजं पद्मगर्भारुणेक्षणम्। नीलोत्पलदळश्यामं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम्॥ ३/२९/१३॥
units.english: [Text 13] The Lord has a cheerful, lotuslike countenance with ruddy eyes like the interior of a lotus, and a swarthy body like the petals of a blue lotus. He bears a conch, discus and mace in three of His hands.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 13] The Supreme Personality of Godhead has a cheerful, lotuslike countenance with ruddy eyes like the interior of a lotus, and a swarthy body like the petals of a blue lotus. He bears a conch, discus and mace in three of His hands.

units.sanskrit: लसत्पङ्कजकिञ्जल्कपीतकौशेयवाससम्। श्रीवत्सवक्षसं भ्राजत्कौस्तुभामुक्तकन्धरम्॥ ३/२९/१४॥
units.english: [Text 14] His loins are covered by a shining cloth, yellowish like the filaments of a lotus. On His breast He bears the mark of Śrīvatsa, a curl of white hair. The brilliant Kaustubha gem is suspended from His neck.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 14] His loins are covered by a shining cloth, yellowish like the filaments of a lotus. On His breast He bears the mark of Śrīvatsa, a curl of white hair. The brilliant Kaustubha gem is suspended from His neck.

units.sanskrit: मत्तद्विरेफाकुलया परीतं वनमालया। परार्ध्यहारवलयकिरीटाङ्गदनूपुरम्॥ ३/२९/१५॥
units.english: [Text 15] He also wears around His neck a garland of attractive sylvan flowers, and a swarm of bees, intoxicated by its delicious fragrance, hums about the garland. He is further superbly adorned with a pearl necklace, a crown and pairs of armlets, bracelets and anklets.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 15] He also wears around His neck a garland of attractive sylvan flowers, and a swarm of bees, intoxicated by its delicious fragrance, hums about the garland. He is further superbly adorned with a pearl necklace, a crown and pairs of armlets, bracelets and anklets.

units.sanskrit: काञ्चीगुणोल्लसच्छ्रोणिं हृदयाम्भोजविष्टरम्। दर्शनीयतमं शान्तं मनोनयननन्दनम्॥ ३/२९/१६॥
units.english: [Text 16] His loins and hips encircled by a girdle, He stands on the lotus of His devotee’s heart. He is most charming to look at, and His serene aspect gladdens the eyes and souls of the devotees who behold Him.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 16] His loins and hips encircled by a girdle, He stands on the lotus of His devotee’s heart. He is most charming to look at, and His serene aspect gladdens the eyes and souls of the devotees who behold Him.

units.sanskrit: आवीच्यदर्शनं शश्वत् सर्वलोकनमस्कृतम्। सन्तं वयसि कैशोरे भृत्यानुग्रहकातरम्॥ ३/२९/१७॥
units.english: [Text 17] The Lord is eternally very beautiful, and He is worshipable by all the inhabitants of every planet. He is ever youthful and always eager to bestow His blessing upon His devotees.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 17] The Lord is eternally very beautiful, and He is worshipable by all the inhabitants of every planet. He is ever youthful and always eager to bestow His blessing upon His devotees.

units.sanskrit: कीर्तन्यतीर्थयशसं पुण्यश्लोकयशस्करम्। ध्यायेद् देवं समग्राङ्गं यावन्न च्यवते मनः॥ ३/२९/१८॥
units.english: [Text 18] The glory of the Lord is always worth singing, for His glories enhance the glories of His devotees. One should therefore meditate upon the Lord and upon His devotees. One should meditate on the eternal form of the Lord until the mind becomes fixed.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

units.sanskrit: स्थितं व्रजन्तमासीनं शयानं वा गुहाशयम्। प्रेक्षणीयेहितं ध्यायेच्छुद्धभावेन चेतसा॥ ३/२९/१९॥
units.english: [Text 19] Thus always merged in devotion, the yogī visualizes the Lord standing, moving, lying down or sitting within him, for the pastimes of the Supreme Lord are always beautiful and attractive.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 19] Thus always merged in devotional service, the yogī visualizes the Lord standing, moving, lying down or sitting within him, for the pastimes of the Supreme Lord are always beautiful and attractive.

units.sanskrit: तस्मिन् लब्धपदं चित्तं सर्वावयवसंस्थितम्। विलोक्यैकत्र संयुज्यादङ्गे भगवतो मुनिः॥ ३/२९/२०॥
units.english: [Text 20] In fixing his mind on the eternal form of the Lord, the yogī should not take a collective view of all His limbs, but should fix the mind on each individual limb of the Lord.

parts.sanskrit: तस्मिन् लब्धपदं चित्तं सर्वावयवसंस्थितम्। विलोक्यैकत्र संयुज्यादङ्गे भगवतो मुनिः॥ ३/२९/२०॥

सर्वस्मरणाशक्तावेकाङ्गे।
“यावन्न च्यवते मनः”
इत्युक्तत्वात्।
“सर्वं स्मर्तुमशक्तः सन्नेकाङ्गं चिन्तयेद् बुधः”
इति च॥ १८-२०॥

units.sanskrit: सञ्चिन्तयेद् भगवतश्चरणारविन्दं वज्राङ्कुशध्वजसरोरुहलाञ्छनाढ्यम्। उत्तुङ्गरक्तविलसन्नखचक्रवाळ- ज्योत्स्नाभिराहतमहद्धृदयान्धकारम्॥ ३/२९/२१॥
units.english: [Text 21] The devotee should first concentrate his mind on the Lord’s lotus feet, which are adorned with the marks of a thunderbolt, a goad, a banner and a lotus. The splendor of their beautiful ruby nails resembles the orb of the moon and dispels the thick gloom of one’s heart.

units.sanskrit: यच्छौचनिःसृतसरित्प्रवरोदकेन तीर्थेन मूध्र्न्यधिधृतेन शिवः शिवोऽभूत्। ध्यातुर्मनःशमलशैलनिसृष्टवज्रं ध्यायेच्चिरं भगवतश्चरणारविन्दम्॥ ३/२९/२२॥
units.english: [Text 22] The blessed Lord Śiva becomes all the more blessed by bearing on his head the holy waters of the Ganges, which has its source in the water that washed the Lord’s lotus feet. The Lord’s feet act like thunderbolts hurled to shatter the mountain of sin stored in the mind of the meditating devotee. One should therefore meditate on the lotus feet of the Lord for a long time.

units.sanskrit: ऊरू सुपर्णभुजयोरधिशोभमानावोजोनिधी स्वतसिकाकुसुमावभासौ। व्यालम्बिपीतवरवाससि वर्तमानकाञ्चीकलापपरिरम्भिनितम्बमम्ब॥ ३/२९/२३॥
units.english: [Text 23] The yogī should fix in his heart the activities of Lakṣmī, the goddess of fortune, who is worshiped by all gods and is the mother of the supreme person, Brahmā. She can always be found massaging the legs and thighs of the transcendental Lord, very carefully serving Him in this way.

She can always be found massaging the legs and thighs of the transcendental Lord, very carefully serving Him in this way.

units.sanskrit: नाभिह्वदं भुवनकोशगुहोदरस्थं यत्रात्मयोनिधिषणाखिललोकपद्मम्। व्यूढं हरिन्मणिमुषः स्तनयोरमुष्य ध्यायेद् द्वयं विततहारमयूखगौरम्॥ ३/२९/२४॥
units.english: [Text 24] Next, the yogi should fix his mind in meditation on the Lord’s thighs, the storehouse of all energy. The Lord’s thighs are whitish blue, like the luster of the linseed flower, and appear most graceful when the Lord is carried on the shoulders of Garuḍa. Also the yogī should contemplate His rounded hips, which are encircled by a girdle that rests on the exquisite yellow silk cloth that extends down to His ankles.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

units.sanskrit: वक्षोऽधिवासमृषभस्य महाविभूतेः पुंसां मनोनयननिर्वृतिमादधानम्। कण्ठं च कौस्तुभमणेरधिभूषणार्थं कुर्यान्मनस्यखिललोकनमस्कृतस्य॥ ३/२९/२५॥
units.english: [Text 25] The yogī should then meditate on His moonlike navel in the center of His abdomen. From His navel, which is the foundation of the entire universe, sprang the lotus stem containing all the different planetary systems. The lotus is the residence of Brahmā, the first created being. In the same way, the yogī should concentrate his mind on the Lord’s nipples, which resemble a pair of most exquisite emeralds and which appear whitish because of the rays of the milk-white pearl necklaces adorning His chest.

units.sanskrit: बाहूंश्च मन्दरगिरेः परिवर्तनेन निर्णिक्तबाहुवलयानधिलोकपालान्। सञ्चिन्तयेद् दशशतारमसह्यतेजः शङ्खं च तत्करसरोरुहराजहंसम्॥ ३/२९/२६॥
units.english: [Text 26] The yogī should then meditate on the chest of the Lord, the abode of goddess Mahā-Lakṣmī. The Lord’s chest is the source of all transcendental pleasure for the mind and full satisfaction for the eyes. The yogī should then imprint on his mind the neck of the Lord, who is adored by the entire universe. The neck of the Lord serves to enhance the beauty of the Kaustubha gem, which hangs on His chest.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

units.sanskrit: कौमोदकां भगवतो दयितां स्मरेत दिग्धामरातिभटशोणितकर्दमेन। मालां मधुव्रतवरूथगिरोपघुष्टां चैत्त्यस्य तत्त्वममलं मणिमस्य कण्ठे॥ ३/२९/२७॥
units.english: [Text 27] The yogī should further meditate upon the Lord’s four arms, which are the source of all the powers of the gods who control the various functions of material nature. Then the yogi should concentrate on the polished ornaments, which were burnished by Mount Mandara as it revolved. He should also duly contemplate the Lord’s discus, the Sudarśana cakra, which contains one thousand spokes and a dazzling luster, as well as the conch, which looks like a swan in His lotuslike palm.

parts.sanskrit: कौमोदकां भगवतो दयितां स्मरेत दिग्धामरातिभटशोणितकर्दमेन। मालां मधुव्रतवरूथगिरोपघुष्टां चैत्त्यस्य तत्त्वममलं मणिमस्य कण्ठे॥ ३/२९/२७॥

स च ब्रह्मा हरेः कण्ठे कौस्तुभत्वेन भासते॥”
इति भागवततन्त्रे॥ २७॥

units.sanskrit: भृत्यानुकम्पितधियेह गृहीतमूर्तेः सञ्चिन्तयेद् भगवतो वदनारविन्दम्। यद् विष्फुरन्मकरकुण्डलवल्गितेन विद्योतितामलकपोलमुदारहासम्॥ ३/२९/२८॥
units.english: [Text 28] The yogī should meditate upon His club, which is named Kaumodakī and is very dear to Him. This club smashes the demons, who are always inimical soldiers, and is smeared with their blood. One should also concentrate on the nice garland on the neck of the Lord, which is always surrounded by bumblebees, with their nice buzzing sound, and one should meditate upon the pearl necklace on the Lord’s neck, which is considered to represent the pure living beings who are always engaged in His service.

units.sanskrit: यच्छ्रीनिकेतमिळभिः परिसेव्यमानं भूत्या स्वया कुटिलकुन्तळवृन्दजुष्टम्। मीनद्वयश्रियमधिक्षिपदब्जनेत्रं ध्यायेन्मनोमयमतन्द्रित उल्लसद्भ्रु॥ ३/२९/२९॥
units.english: [Text 29] The yogī should then meditate on the lotuslike countenance of the Lord, who presents His different forms in this world out of compassion for the anxious devotees. His nose is prominent, and His crystal-clear cheeks are illuminated by the oscillation of His glittering alligator-shaped earrings.

units.sanskrit: तस्यावलोकमधिकं कृपयाऽतिघोर- तापत्रयोपशमनाय निसृष्टमक्ष्णोः। स्निग्धस्मितानुगुणितं विपुलप्रसादं ध्यायेच्चिरं विततभावनया गुहायाम्॥ ३/२९/३०॥
units.english: [Text 30] The yogi then meditates upon the beautiful face of the Lord, which is adorned with curly hair and decorated by lotuslike eyes and dancing eyebrows. A lotus surrounded by swarming bees and a pair of swimming fish would be put to shame by its elegance.

units.sanskrit: हासं हरेरवनताखिललोकतीव्रशोकाश्रुसागरविशोषणमत्युदारम्। सम्मोहनाय रचितं निजमाययाऽस्य भ्रूमण्डलं मनुसुते मकरध्वजस्य॥ ३/२९/३१॥
units.english: [Text 31] The yogīs should contemplate with full devotion the compassionate glances frequently cast by the Lord’s eyes, for they soothe the most fearful threefold agonies of His devotees. His glances, accompanied by loving smiles, are full of abundant grace.

units.sanskrit: ध्यानायनं रहसि तद् बहळाधरोष्ठ- भासाऽरुणायिततनुद्विजकुन्दपङ्क्ति। ध्यायेत् स्वहृत्कुहरकेऽवसितस्य विष्णो- र्भक्त्याऽऽर्द्रयाऽर्पितमना न पृथग् दिदृक्षेत्॥ ३/२९/३२॥
units.english: [Text 32] A yogī should similarly meditate on the most benevolent smile of Lord Hari, a smile which, for all those who bow to Him, dries away the ocean of tears caused by intense grief. The yogī should also meditate on the Lord’s arched eyebrows, which are manifested by His internal potency in order to charm the sex-god for the good of the sages.

units.sanskrit: एवं हरौ भगवति प्रतिलब्धभावो भक्त्या द्रवद्धृदय उत्पुळकप्रमोदः। औत्कण्ठ्यबाष्पकळया मुहुरर्द्यमानस्तच्चापि चित्तबिळशं शनकैर्वियुङ्क्ते॥ ३/२९/३३॥
units.english: [Text 33] With devotion steeped in love and affection, the yogī should meditate within the core of his heart upon the laughter of Lord Viṣṇu. The laughter of Viṣṇu is so captivating that it can be easily meditated upon. When the Supreme Lord is laughing, one can see His small teeth, which resemble jasmine buds rendered rosy by the splendor of His lips. Once devoting his mind to this, the yogī should no longer desire to see anything else.

units.sanskrit: मुक्ताश्रयं यर्हि निर्विषयं स्वचित्तं निर्वाणमृच्छति मनः सहसा यथाऽर्चिः। आत्मानमत्र पुरुषोऽव्यवधानमेक- मन्वीक्षते प्रतिनिवृत्तगुणप्रवाहः॥ ३/२९/३४॥
units.english: [Text 34] By following this course, the yogī gradually develops pure love for the Lord, Hari. In the course of his progress in devotion, the hairs on his body stand erect through excessive joy, and he is constantly bathed in a stream of tears occasioned by intense love. Gradually, even the mind, which he used as a means to attract the Lord, as one attracts a fish to a hook, withdraws from material activity.
