units.sanskrit: सोऽप्येतया चरमया मनसो निवृत्त्या तस्मिन् महिम्न्यवसितः सुखदुःखबाह्ये। हेतुत्वमप्यसति कर्तरि दुःखयोर्न स्वात्मन् विधत्त उपलब्धपरात्मकाष्ठः॥ ३/२९/३५॥
units.english: [Text 35] When the mind is thus completely freed from all material contamination and detached from material objectives, it is just like the flame of a lamp. At that time the mind is actually dovetailed with that of the Supreme Lord and is experienced as one with Him because it is freed from the interactive flow of the material qualities.

parts.sanskrit: सोऽप्येतया चरमया मनसो निवृत्त्या तस्मिन् महिम्न्यवसितः सुखदुःखबाह्ये। हेतुत्वमप्यसति कर्तरि दुःखयोर्न स्वात्मन् विधत्त उपलब्धपरात्मकाष्ठः॥ ३/२९/३५॥

“असत्कर्ता तु जीवः स्यात् सत्कर्ता परमेश्वरः”
इति शब्दनिर्णये।
“दुर्दुःखमिति विज्ञेयं खं सुखं च तयोर्यतः।
प्रदाता परमो विष्णुस्तस्माद् दुःखादिनामवान्॥”
इति हरिवंशेषु॥ ३५॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 35] When the mind is thus completely freed from all material contamination and detached from material objectives, it is just like the flame of a lamp. At that time the mind is actually dovetailed with that of the Supreme Lord and is experienced as one with Him because it is freed from the interactive flow of the material qualities.

units.sanskrit: देहं तु तं न चरमं स्थितमुज्झितं वा सिद्धो विपश्यति यतोऽध्यगमत् स्वरूपम्। दैवादुपेतमथ दैववशादपेतं वासो यथा परिकृतं मदिरामदान्धः॥ ३/२९/३६॥
units.english: [Text 36] Thus situated in the highest transcendental stage, the mind ceases from all material reaction and becomes situated in its own glory, transcendental to all material conceptions of happiness and distress. At that time the yogī realizes the truth of his relationship with the Lord. He discovers that pleasure and pain as well as their interactions, which he attributed to his own self, are actually due to the false ego, which is a product of ignorance.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 36] Thus situated in the highest transcendental stage, the mind ceases from all material reaction and becomes situated in its own glory, transcendental to all material conceptions of happiness and distress. At that time the yogī realizes the truth of his relationship with the Supreme Personality of Godhead. He discovers that pleasure and pain as well as their interactions, which he attributed to his own self, are actually due to the false ego, which is a product of ignorance.

units.sanskrit: देहोऽपि दैववशगः खलु कर्म यावत् स्वारम्भकं प्रतिसमीक्षत एव सासुः। तं सप्रपञ्चमधिरूढसमाधियोगः स्वाप्नं पुनर्न भजते प्रतिबुद्धवत् सः॥ ३/२९/३७॥
units.english: [Text 37] Because he has achieved his real identity, the perfectly realized soul has no conception of how the material body is moving or acting, just as an intoxicated person cannot understand whether or not he has clothing on his body.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 37] Because he has achieved his real identity, the perfectly realized soul has no conception of how the material body is moving or acting, just as an intoxicated person cannot understand whether or not he has clothing on his body.

units.sanskrit: यथा पुत्राच्च वित्ताच्च पृथङ् मर्त्यः प्रतीयते। अप्यात्मत्वेनाभिमताद् देहादेः पुरुषस्तथा॥ ३/२९/३८॥
units.english: [Text 38] The body of such a liberated yogī, along with the senses, is taken charge of by the Lord, and it functions until its destined activities are finished. The liberated devotee, being awake to his constitutional position and thus situated in samādhi, the highest perfectional stage of yoga, does not accept the by-products of the material body as his own. Thus he considers his bodily activities to be like the activities of a body in a dream.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 38] The body of such a liberated yogī, along with the senses, is taken charge of by the Supreme Personality of Godhead, and it functions until its destined activities are finished. The liberated devotee, being awake to his constitutional position and thus situated in samādhi, the highest perfectional stage of yoga, does not accept the by-products of the material body as his own. Thus he considers his bodily activities to be like the activities of a body in a dream.

units.sanskrit: यथोल्मुकाद् विष्फुलिङ्गाद् धूमाद् वाऽपि स्वसम्भवात्। अप्यात्मत्वेनामिमताद् दाहकोऽग्निः पृथङ् मतः॥ ३/२९/३९॥
units.english: [Text 39] Because of great affection for family and wealth, one accepts a son and some money as his own, and due to affection for the material body, one thinks that it is his. But actually, as one can understand that his family and wealth are different from him, the liberated soul can understand that he and his body are not the same.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 39] Because of great affection for family and wealth, one accepts a son and some money as his own, and due to affection for the material body, one thinks that it is his. But actually, as one can understand that his family and wealth are different from him, the liberated soul can understand that he and his body are not the same.

units.sanskrit: भूतेन्द्रियान्तःकरणात् प्रधानाज्जीवसाञ्ज्ञतात्। आत्मा तथा पृथग् द्रष्टा भगवान् ब्रह्मसाञ्ज्ञतः॥ ३/२९/४०॥
units.english: [Text 40] The blazing fire is different from the flames, from the sparks and from the smoke, although all are intimately connected because they are born from the same blazing wood.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 40] The blazing fire is different from the flames, from the sparks and from the smoke, although all are intimately connected because they are born from the same blazing wood.

units.sanskrit: सर्वभूतेषु चात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि। ईक्षेतानन्यभावेन भूतेष्वपि तदात्मताम्॥ ३/२९/४१॥
units.english: [Text 41] The Lord, who is known as Parambrahma, is the seer. He is different from the jīva soul, or individual living being, who is combined with the senses, the five elements and consciousness.

parts.sanskrit: सर्वभूतेषु चात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि। ईक्षेतानन्यभावेन भूतेष्वपि तदात्मताम्॥ ३/२९/४१॥
अनन्यभावेन तद्रूपाणामभेदेन। तदात्मतां तस्यादानादिकर्तृत्वं च भूतविषये॥ ४१॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 41] The Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is known as Parambrahma, is the seer. He is different from the jīva soul, or individual living entity, who is combined with the senses, the five elements and consciousness.

units.sanskrit: स्वयोनिषु यथा ज्योतिरेकं नाना प्रतीयते। योनीनां गुणवैषम्यात् तथाऽऽत्मा प्रकृतौ स्थितः॥ ३/२९/४२॥
units.english: [Text 42] A yogi should see the same soul in all manifestations, for all that exists is a manifestation of different energies of the Supreme. In this way the devotee should see all living beings without distinction. That is realization of the Supreme Soul.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 42] A yogi should see the same soul in all manifestations, for all that exists is a manifestation of different energies of the Supreme. In this way the devotee should see all living entities without distinction. That is realization of the Supreme Soul.

units.sanskrit: तस्मादिमां स्वां प्रकृतिं देवीं सदसदात्मिकाम्। दुर्विभाव्यां पराभाव्य स्वरूपेणावतिष्ठते॥ ३/२९/४३॥
units.english: [Text 43] As fire is exhibited in different forms of wood, so, under different conditions of the modes of material nature, the pure spirit soul manifests itself in different bodies.

parts.sanskrit: तस्मादिमां स्वां प्रकृतिं देवीं सदसदात्मिकाम्। दुर्विभाव्यां पराभाव्य स्वरूपेणावतिष्ठते॥ ३/२९/४३॥

प्रकृतिं पराभाव्य तदुत्तमत्वेनैव सदाऽवतिष्ठते परः।
“सर्वभूतस्थमीशेशं जेतारं प्रकृतेरपि।
अविशेषं सदैवैकं चिन्तयन् विप्रमुच्यते॥”
इति च॥ ४३॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 43] As fire is exhibited in different forms of wood, so, under different conditions of the modes of material nature, the pure spirit soul manifests itself in different bodies.

units.sanskrit: अन्वयव्यतिरेकाच्च साक्ष्यात्मा व्यभिचारिणः। वैतथ्यं व्यभिचारं च निद्रान्तेऽस्यानुचिन्तयेत्॥ ३/२९/४४॥
units.english: [Text 44] Thus the yogī can be in the self-realized position after conquering the insurmountable spell of māyā, who presents herself as both the cause and effect of this material manifestation and is therefore very difficult to understand.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 44] Thus the yogī can be in the self-realized position after conquering the insurmountable spell of māyā, who presents herself as both the cause and effect of this material manifestation and is therefore very difficult to understand.

units.sanskrit:
देवहूतिरुवाच-
लक्षणं महदादीनां प्रकृतेः पुरुषस्य च। स्वरूपं लक्ष्यतेऽमीषां येन तत् पारमार्थिकम्॥ ३/३०/१॥
यथा साङ्ख्येषु कथितं यन्मूलं तत् प्रचक्षते। भक्तियोगस्य मे मार्गं ब्रूहि विस्तरशः प्रभो॥ ३/३०/२॥
units.english: [Text 1-2] Devahūti inquired: My dear Lord, You have already very scientifically described the symptoms of the total material nature and the characteristics of the spirit according to the Sāṅkhya system of philosophy. Now I shall request You to explain the path of devotion, which is the ultimate end of all philosophical systems.

parts.sanskrit:
देवहूतिरुवाच-
लक्षणं महदादीनां प्रकृतेः पुरुषस्य च। स्वरूपं लक्ष्यतेऽमीषां येन तत् पारमार्थिकम्॥ ३/३०/१॥
यथा साङ्ख्येषु कथितं यन्मूलं तत् प्रचक्षते। भक्तियोगस्य मे मार्गं ब्रूहि विस्तरशः प्रभो॥ ३/३०/२॥
यथा साङ्ख्येषूक्तं तथा कथितम्। यत्साङ्ख्यमूलं तल्लक्षणं प्रचक्षते॥ २॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 1-2] Devahūti inquired: My dear Lord, You have already very scientifically described the symptoms of the total material nature and the characteristics of the spirit according to the Sāṅkhya system of philosophy. Now I shall request You to explain the path of devotional service, which is the ultimate end of all philosophical systems.

units.sanskrit: विरागो येन पुरुषो भगवन् सर्वतो भवेत्। आचक्ष्व जीवलोकस्य विविधाः कर्मसंसृतीः॥ ३/३०/३॥
units.english: [Text 3] Devahūti continued: My dear Lord, please also describe in detail, both for me and for people in general, the continual process of birth and death, for by hearing of such calamities we may become detached from the activities of this material world.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 3] Devahūti continued: My dear Lord, please also describe in detail, both for me and for people in general, the continual process of birth and death, for by hearing of such calamities we may become detached from the activities of this material world.

units.sanskrit: कालस्येश्वररूपस्य परेषां च परस्य ते। स्वरूपं बत कुर्वन्ति यद्धेतोः कुशलं जनाः॥ ३/३०/४॥
units.english: [Text 4] Please also describe eternal time, which is a representation of Your form and by whose influence people in general engage in the performance of pious activities.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 4] Please also describe eternal time, which is a representation of Your form and by whose influence people in general engage in the performance of pious activities.

units.sanskrit: लोकस्य मिथ्याभिमतेरचक्षुषश्चिरं प्रसुप्तस्य तमस्यनाश्रये। श्रान्तस्य कर्मण्यनुविद्धया धिया त्वमाविरासीः किल योगभास्करः॥ ३/३०/५॥
units.english: [Text 5] My dear Lord, You are just like the sun, for You illuminate the darkness of the conditional life of the living beings. Because their eyes of knowledge are not open, they are sleeping eternally in that darkness without Your shelter, and therefore they are falsely engaged by the actions and reactions of their material activities, and they appear to be very fatigued.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 5] My dear Lord, You are just like the sun, for You illuminate the darkness of the conditional life of the living entities. Because their eyes of knowledge are not open, they are sleeping eternally in that darkness without Your shelter, and therefore they are falsely engaged by the actions and reactions of their material activities, and they appear to be very fatigued.

units.sanskrit:
मैत्रेय उवाच-
इति मातुर्वचः श्लक्ष्णं प्रतिनन्द्य महामुनिः। आबभाषे कुरुश्रेष्ठ प्रीतस्तां करुणार्दितः॥ ३/३०/६॥
units.english: [Text 6] Maitreya said: O best amongst the Kurus, the great sage Kapila, moved by great compassion and pleased by the words of His glorious mother, spoke as follows.

english_edits.rule: honorific Śrī before a name removed

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 6] Śrī Maitreya said: O best amongst the Kurus, the great sage Kapila, moved by great compassion and pleased by the words of His glorious mother, spoke as follows.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच-
भक्तियोगो बहुविधो मार्गैर्भामिनि भाव्यते। स्वभावगुणमार्गेण पुंसां भावो विभिद्यते॥ ३/३०/७॥
units.english: [Text 7] Lord Kapila, the Lord, replied: O noble lady, there are multifarious paths of devotion in terms of the different qualities of the executor.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 7] Lord Kapila, the Personality of Godhead, replied: O noble lady, there are multifarious paths of devotional service in terms of the different qualities of the executor.

units.sanskrit: अभिसन्धाय यो हिंसां डम्भं मात्सर्यमेव वा। संरम्भी भिन्नदृग् भावं मयि कुर्यात् स तामसः॥ ३/३०/८॥
units.english: [Text 8] Devotional service executed by a person who is envious, proud, violent and angry, and who is a separatist, is considered to be in the mode of darkness.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 8] Devotional service executed by a person who is envious, proud, violent and angry, and who is a separatist, is considered to be in the mode of darkness.

units.sanskrit: विषयानभिसन्धाय यश ऐश्वर्यमेव वा। अर्चादावर्चयेद् यो मां पृथग्भावः स राजसः॥ ३/३०/९॥
units.english: [Text 9] The worship of Deities in the temple by a separatist, with a motive for material enjoyment, fame and opulence, is devotion in the mode of passion.

parts.sanskrit: विषयानभिसन्धाय यश ऐश्वर्यमेव वा। अर्चादावर्चयेद् यो मां पृथग्भावः स राजसः॥ ३/३०/९॥
तद्रूपाणां पृथग्भावः॥ ९॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 9] The worship of Deities in the temple by a separatist, with a motive for material enjoyment, fame and opulence, is devotion in the mode of passion.

units.sanskrit: कर्मनिर्हारमुद्दिश्य परस्मिन् वा तदर्पणम्। यजेद् यष्टव्यमिति वाऽपृथग्भावः स सात्त्विकः॥ ३/३०/१०॥
units.english: [Text 10] When a devotee worships the Lord and offers the results of his activities in order to free himself from the inebrieties of actions aimed at results, his devotion is in the mode of goodness.

parts.sanskrit: कर्मनिर्हारमुद्दिश्य परस्मिन् वा तदर्पणम्। यजेद् यष्टव्यमिति वाऽपृथग्भावः स सात्त्विकः॥ ३/३०/१०॥
अपृथग्भावः सात्त्विकः॥१०॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord
fruitive activities -> actions aimed at results

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 10] When a devotee worships the Supreme Personality of Godhead and offers the results of his activities in order to free himself from the inebrieties of fruitive activities, his devotion is in the mode of goodness.

units.sanskrit:
मद्गुणश्रुतमात्रेण मयि सर्वगुणाश्रये। मनोगतिरविच्छिन्ना यथा गङ्गाम्भसोऽम्बुधौ॥ ३/३०/११॥
लक्षणं भक्तियोगस्य निर्गुणस्य ह्युदाहृतम्। अहैतुक्यव्यवहिता या भक्तिः पुरुषोत्तमे॥ ३/३०/१२॥
units.english: [Text 11-12] The manifestation of unadulterated devotion is exhibited when one’s mind is at once attracted to hearing the transcendental name and qualities of the Lord, who is residing in everyone’s heart. Just as the water of the Ganges flows naturally down towards the ocean, such devotional ecstasy, uninterrupted by any material condition, flows towards the Supreme Lord.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 11-12] The manifestation of unadulterated devotional service is exhibited when one’s mind is at once attracted to hearing the transcendental name and qualities of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is residing in everyone’s heart. Just as the water of the Ganges flows naturally down towards the ocean, such devotional ecstasy, uninterrupted by any material condition, flows towards the Supreme Lord.

units.sanskrit: सालोक्यसार्ष्टिसामीप्यसारूप्यैकत्वमित्युत। दीयमानं न गृह्णन्ति विना मत्सेवनं जनाः॥ ३/३०/१३॥
units.english: [Text 13] A devotee does not accept any kind of liberation — sālokya, sārṣṭi, sāmīpya, sārūpya or ekatva — even though they are offered by the Lord.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 13] A pure devotee does not accept any kind of liberation — sālokya, sārṣṭi, sāmīpya, sārūpya or ekatva — even though they are offered by the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

units.sanskrit: स एव भक्तियोगाख्य आत्यन्तिक उदाहृतः। येनातिव्रज्य त्रिगुणान् मद्भावायोपपद्यते॥ ३/३०/१४॥
units.english: [Text 14] By attaining the highest platform of devotion, as I have explained, one can overcome the influence of the three modes of material nature and be situated in the transcendental stage, as is the Lord.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 14] By attaining the highest platform of devotional service, as I have explained, one can overcome the influence of the three modes of material nature and be situated in the transcendental stage, as is the Lord.

units.sanskrit: निषेवितेनानिमित्तेन स्वधर्मेण महीयसा। क्रियायोगेन शक्तेन नातिहिंस्रेण नित्यशः॥ ३/३०/१५॥
units.english: [Text 15] A devotee must execute his prescribed duties, which are glorious, without material profit. Without excessive violence, one should regularly perform one’s devotional activities.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 15] A devotee must execute his prescribed duties, which are glorious, without material profit. Without excessive violence, one should regularly perform one’s devotional activities.

units.sanskrit: मद्धिष्ण्यदर्शनस्पर्शपूजास्तुत्यभिवन्दनैः। भूतेषु मद्भावनया सत्येनासङ्गमेन च॥ ३/३०/१६॥
units.english: [Text 16] The devotee should regularly see My statues in the temple, touch My lotus feet and offer worshipable paraphernalia and prayer. He should see in the spirit of renunciation, from the mode of goodness, and see every living being as spiritual.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 16] The devotee should regularly see My statues in the temple, touch My lotus feet and offer worshipable paraphernalia and prayer. He should see in the spirit of renunciation, from the mode of goodness, and see every living entity as spiritual.

units.sanskrit: महतां बहुमानेन हीनानामनुकम्पया। मैत्र्या चैवात्मतुल्येषु यमेन नियमेन च॥ ३/३०/१७॥
units.english: [Text 17] The devotee should execute devotion by giving the greatest respect to the teacher and the ācāryas. He should be compassionate to the poor and make friendship with persons who are his equals, but all his activities should be executed under regulation and with control of the senses.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 17] The pure devotee should execute devotional service by giving the greatest respect to the spiritual master and the ācāryas. He should be compassionate to the poor and make friendship with persons who are his equals, but all his activities should be executed under regulation and with control of the senses.

units.sanskrit: आध्यात्मिकानुश्रवणान्नामसङ्कीर्तनाच्च मे। आर्जवेनार्यसङ्गेन निरहङ्क्रियया तथा॥ ३/३०/१८॥
units.english: [Text 18] A devotee should always try to hear about spiritual matters and should always utilize his time in chanting the holy name of the Lord. His behavior should always be straightforward and simple, and although he is not envious but friendly to everyone, he should avoid the company of persons who are not spiritually advanced.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 18] A devotee should always try to hear about spiritual matters and should always utilize his time in chanting the holy name of the Lord. His behavior should always be straightforward and simple, and although he is not envious but friendly to everyone, he should avoid the company of persons who are not spiritually advanced.

units.sanskrit: मद्धर्मेण च यर्ह्येतैः परिसंशुद्ध आशयः। पुरुषस्याञ्जसाऽभ्येति श्रुतमात्रगुणं हि माम्॥ ३/३०/१९॥
units.english: [Text 19] When one is fully qualified with all these transcendental attributes and his consciousness is thus completely purified, he is immediately attracted simply by hearing My name or hearing of My transcendental quality.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 19] When one is fully qualified with all these transcendental attributes and his consciousness is thus completely purified, he is immediately attracted simply by hearing My name or hearing of My transcendental quality.

units.sanskrit: यथा वातरथो घ्राणमावृङ्क्ते गन्ध आशयात्। एवं योगरतं चेत आत्मानमविकारि यत्॥ ३/३०/२०॥
units.english: [Text 20] As the chariot of air carries an aroma from its source and immediately catches the sense of smell, similarly, one who constantly engages in devotion, in Kṛṣṇa consciousness, can catch the Supreme Soul, who is equally present everywhere.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 20] As the chariot of air carries an aroma from its source and immediately catches the sense of smell, similarly, one who constantly engages in devotional service, in Kṛṣṇa consciousness, can catch the Supreme Soul, who is equally present everywhere.

units.sanskrit: अहं सर्वेषु भूतेषु भूतात्माऽवस्थितः सदा। तमवज्ञाय मां मर्त्यः कुरुतेऽर्चाविडम्बनम्॥ ३/३०/२१॥
units.english: [Text 21] I am present in every living being as the Supreme Self. If someone neglects or disregards that the Supreme Self everywhere and engages himself in the worship of the Deity in the temple, that is simply imitation.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 21] I am present in every living entity as the Supersoul. If someone neglects or disregards that Supersoul everywhere and engages himself in the worship of the Deity in the temple, that is simply imitation.

units.sanskrit: यो मां सर्वेषु भूतेषु सन्तमात्मानमीश्वरम्। हित्वाऽर्चां भजते मौढ्याद् भस्मन्येव जुहोति सः॥ ३/३०/२२॥
units.english: [Text 22] One who worships the Deity of Godhead in the temples but does not know that the Supreme Lord, as Paramātmā, is situated in every living being’s heart, must be in ignorance and is compared to one who offers oblations into ashes.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 22] One who worships the Deity of Godhead in the temples but does not know that the Supreme Lord, as Paramātmā, is situated in every living entity’s heart, must be in ignorance and is compared to one who offers oblations into ashes.

units.sanskrit: द्विषतः परकाये मां मानिनो भिन्नदर्शिनः। भूतेषु बद्धवैरस्य न मनः शान्तिमृच्छति॥ ३/३०/२३॥
units.english: [Text 23] One who offers Me respect but is envious of the bodies of others and is therefore a separatist never attains peace of mind, because of his inimical behavior towards other living beings.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 23] One who offers Me respect but is envious of the bodies of others and is therefore a separatist never attains peace of mind, because of his inimical behavior towards other living entities.

units.sanskrit: अहमुच्चावचैर्द्रव्यैः क्रिययोत्पन्नयाऽनघे। नैव तुष्येऽर्चितोऽर्चायां भूतग्रामावमानिनः॥ ३/३०/२४॥
units.english: [Text 24] My dear mother, even if he worships with proper rituals and paraphernalia, a person who is ignorant of My presence in all living beings never pleases Me by the worship of My Deities in the temple.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 24] My dear mother, even if he worships with proper rituals and paraphernalia, a person who is ignorant of My presence in all living entities never pleases Me by the worship of My Deities in the temple.

units.sanskrit: अर्चादावर्चयेत् तावदीश्वरं मां स्वकर्मकृत्। यावन्न वेद स्वहृदि सर्वभूतेष्ववस्थितम्॥ ३/३०/२५॥
units.english: [Text 25] Performing his prescribed duties, one should worship the Deity of the Lord until one realizes My presence in his own heart and in the hearts of other living beings as well.

parts.sanskrit: अर्चादावर्चयेत् तावदीश्वरं मां स्वकर्मकृत्। यावन्न वेद स्वहृदि सर्वभूतेष्ववस्थितम्॥ ३/३०/२५॥

“अज्ञोऽर्चयेदेवार्चायामन्यथा दोषवान् भवेत्।
ज्ञस्त्वर्चयन् स गुणवानन्यथा दोषवान्नतु॥”
इति कापिलेये॥२५॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 25] Performing his prescribed duties, one should worship the Deity of the Supreme Personality of Godhead until one realizes My presence in his own heart and in the hearts of other living entities as well.

units.sanskrit: आत्मनश्च परस्यापि यः करोत्यन्तरोदरम्। तस्य भिन्नदृशो मृत्युर्विधत्ते भयमुद्बणम्॥ ३/३०/२६॥
units.english: [Text 26] As the blazing fire of death, I cause great fear to whoever makes the least discrimination between himself and other living beings because of a differential outlook.

parts.sanskrit: आत्मनश्च परस्यापि यः करोत्यन्तरोदरम्। तस्य भिन्नदृशो मृत्युर्विधत्ते भयमुद्बणम्॥ ३/३०/२६॥
अन्तरोदरं भिन्नं ब्रह्म। आत्मस्थमन्यस्थं च ब्रह्म यो भेदेन पश्यति। “उदरं ब्रह्म” इति श्रुतेः॥ २६॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 26] As the blazing fire of death, I cause great fear to whoever makes the least discrimination between himself and other living entities because of a differential outlook.

units.sanskrit: अथ मां सर्वभूतेषु भूतात्मानं कृतालयम्। अर्हयेद् दानमानाभ्यां मैत्र्या भिन्नेन चक्षुषा॥ ३/३०/२७॥
units.english: [Text 27] Therefore, through charitable gifts and attention, as well as through friendly behavior and by viewing all to be alike, one should propitiate Me, who abide in all creatures as their very Self.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 27] Therefore, through charitable gifts and attention, as well as through friendly behavior and by viewing all to be alike, one should propitiate Me, who abide in all creatures as their very Self.

units.sanskrit: जीवाः श्रेष्ठा ह्यजीवानां ततः प्राणभृतः शुभे। ततः सचित्ताः प्रवरास्ततश्चेन्द्रियवृत्तयः॥ ३/३०/२८॥
units.english: [Text 28] Living entities are superior to inanimate objects, O blessed mother, and among them, living beings who display life symptoms are better. Animals with developed consciousness are better than them, and better still are those who have developed sense perception.

parts.sanskrit: जीवाः श्रेष्ठा ह्यजीवानां ततः प्राणभृतः शुभे। ततः सचित्ताः प्रवरास्ततश्चेन्द्रियवृत्तयः॥ ३/३०/२८॥
प्राणभृतश्चलनयुक्ताः॥ २८॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 28] Living entities are superior to inanimate objects, O blessed mother, and among them, living entities who display life symptoms are better. Animals with developed consciousness are better than them, and better still are those who have developed sense perception.

units.sanskrit: अत्रापि स्पर्शवेदिभ्यः प्रवरा रसवेदिनः। तेभ्यो गन्धविदः श्रेष्ठास्ततः शब्दविदो वराः॥ ३/३०/२९॥
units.english: [Text 29] Among the living beings who have developed sense perception, those who have developed the sense of taste are better than those who have developed only the sense of touch. Better than them are those who have developed the sense of smell, and better still are those who have developed the sense of hearing.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 29] Among the living entities who have developed sense perception, those who have developed the sense of taste are better than those who have developed only the sense of touch. Better than them are those who have developed the sense of smell, and better still are those who have developed the sense of hearing.

units.sanskrit: रूपभेदविदस्तत्र ततश्चोभयतोदतः। तेषां बहुपदः श्रेष्ठाश्चतुष्पादस्ततो द्विपात्॥ ३/३०/३०॥
units.english: [Text 30] Better than those living beings who can perceive sound are those who can distinguish between one form and another. Better than them are those who have developed upper and lower sets of teeth, and better still are those who have many legs. Better than them are the quadrupeds, and better still are the human beings.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 30] Better than those living entities who can perceive sound are those who can distinguish between one form and another. Better than them are those who have developed upper and lower sets of teeth, and better still are those who have many legs. Better than them are the quadrupeds, and better still are the human beings.

units.sanskrit: ततो वर्णाश्च चत्वारस्तेषां ब्राह्मण उत्तमः। ब्राह्मणेष्वपि वेदज्ञो ह्यर्थज्ञोऽभ्यधिकस्ततः॥ ३/३०/३१॥
units.english: [Text 31] Among human beings, the society which is divided according to quality and work is best, and in that society, the intelligent men, who are designated as brāhmaṇas, are best. Among the brāhmaṇas, one who has studied the Vedas is the best, and among the brāhmaṇas who have studied the Vedas, one who knows the actual purport of Veda is the best.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 31] Among human beings, the society which is divided according to quality and work is best, and in that society, the intelligent men, who are designated as brāhmaṇas, are best. Among the brāhmaṇas, one who has studied the Vedas is the best, and among the brāhmaṇas who have studied the Vedas, one who knows the actual purport of Veda is the best.

units.sanskrit: अर्थज्ञात् संशयच्छेत्ता ततः श्रेयान् स्वधर्मकृत्। मुक्तसङ्गस्ततो भूयान् न दोग्धा धर्ममात्मनः॥ ३/३०/३२॥
units.english: [Text 32] Better than the brāhmaṇa who knows the purpose of the Vedas is he who can dissipate all doubts, and better than him is one who strictly follows the brahminical principles. Better than him is one who is liberated from all material contamination, and better than him is a devotee, who executes devotion without expectation of reward.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 32] Better than the brāhmaṇa who knows the purpose of the Vedas is he who can dissipate all doubts, and better than him is one who strictly follows the brahminical principles. Better than him is one who is liberated from all material contamination, and better than him is a pure devotee, who executes devotional service without expectation of reward.

units.sanskrit: तस्मान्मय्यर्पिताशेषक्रियार्थात्मरतिर्नरः। मय्यर्पितात्मनः पुंसो मयि सन्न्यस्तकर्मणः। न पश्यामि परं भूतमकर्तुः समदर्शिनः॥ ३/३०/३३॥
units.english: [Text 33] Therefore I do not find a greater person than he who has no interest outside of Mine and who therefore engages and dedicates all his activities and all his life — everything — unto Me without cessation.

parts.sanskrit: तस्मान्मय्यर्पिताशेषक्रियार्थात्मरतिर्नरः। मय्यर्पितात्मनः पुंसो मयि सन्न्यस्तकर्मणः। न पश्यामि परं भूतमकर्तुः समदर्शिनः॥ ३/३०/३३॥

“पशुवृक्षादिभेदेन जीवा एव स्वतः स्थिताः।
संसृतौ व्यत्ययस्तेषां मुक्तौ तत्तत्स्वरूपता।
तत्र स्थावरमुक्तेभ्यो वरा जङ्गममुक्तकाः।
तेभ्यो मानुषमुक्ताश्च विप्रमुक्तास्ततोऽधिकाः।
तत्रोपदेशमात्रेण मुक्तेभ्यो वेदवेदिनः।
अर्थज्ञा ऋषयस्तेभ्योऽतो देवाः संशयच्छिदः।
पूर्णधर्मा ततस्त्विन्द्रो निःसङ्गो गरुडस्ततः।
भक्तिपूर्णो हरेर्ब्रह्मा तस्मान्नान्योऽधिकस्ततः।
मुक्तौ वा संसृतौ वापि सम्यगेषु हि ते गुणाः॥”
इति कापिलेये॥ ३१-३३॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 33] Therefore I do not find a greater person than he who has no interest outside of Mine and who therefore engages and dedicates all his activities and all his life — everything — unto Me without cessation.

units.sanskrit: मनसैतानि भूतानि प्रणमेद् बहुमानयन्। ईश्वरो जीवकलया प्रविष्टो भगवानिति॥ ३/३०/३४॥
units.english: [Text 34] Such a perfect devotee offers respects to every living being because he is under the firm conviction that the Lord has entered the body of every living being as the Supreme Self, or controller.

parts.sanskrit: मनसैतानि भूतानि प्रणमेद् बहुमानयन्। ईश्वरो जीवकलया प्रविष्टो भगवानिति॥ ३/३०/३४॥
जीवकलया सह भूतानि बहुमानयंस्तदालयत्वेनेश्वरं प्रणमेत्॥ ३४॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 34] Such a perfect devotee offers respects to every living entity because he is under the firm conviction that the Supreme Personality of Godhead has entered the body of every living entity as the Supersoul, or controller.

units.sanskrit: भक्तियोगश्च योगश्च मया मानव्युदाहृतः। ययोरेकतरेणैव पुरुषः पुरुषं व्रजेत्॥ ३/३०/३५॥
units.english: [Text 35] My dear mother, O daughter of Manu, a devotee who applies the science of devotion and mystic yoga in this way can achieve the abode of the Supreme Person simply by that devotion.

parts.sanskrit: भक्तियोगश्च योगश्च मया मानव्युदाहृतः। ययोरेकतरेणैव पुरुषः पुरुषं व्रजेत्॥ ३/३०/३५॥
एकतरभावेऽन्यतरस्य नियतत्वादेकतरेणैव॥ ३५॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 35] My dear mother, O daughter of Manu, a devotee who applies the science of devotional service and mystic yoga in this way can achieve the abode of the Supreme Person simply by that devotional service.

units.sanskrit: यत् तद् भगवतो रूपं ब्रह्मणः परमात्मनः। परं प्रधानात् पुरुषाद् दैवं कर्मविचेष्टितम्॥ ३/३०/३६॥
units.english: [Text 36] This puruṣa whom the individual soul must approach is the eternal form of the Lord, who is known as Brahman and Paramātmā. He is the transcendental chief personality, and His activities are all spiritual.

parts.sanskrit: यत् तद् भगवतो रूपं ब्रह्मणः परमात्मनः। परं प्रधानात् पुरुषाद् दैवं कर्मविचेष्टितम्॥ ३/३०/३६॥
सर्वकर्माणि यस्य विचेष्टानिमित्तानि तत् कर्मविचेष्टितम्॥ ३६॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 36] This puruṣa whom the individual soul must approach is the eternal form of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is known as Brahman and Paramātmā. He is the transcendental chief personality, and His activities are all spiritual.

units.sanskrit: रूपभेदास्पदं दिव्यं काल इत्यभिधीयते। भूतानां महदादीनां यतो भिन्नदृशां भयम्॥ ३/३०/३७॥
units.english: [Text 37] The time factor, who causes the transformation of the various material manifestations, is another feature of the Lord. Anyone who does not know that time is the same Supreme Personality is afraid of the time factor.

parts.sanskrit: रूपभेदास्पदं दिव्यं काल इत्यभिधीयते। भूतानां महदादीनां यतो भिन्नदृशां भयम्॥ ३/३०/३७॥

भिन्नदृशां ईश्वरापेक्षयाऽल्पदृशाम्।
“भिन्नमल्पं विजानीयादभिन्नं पूर्णमिष्यते”
इति शब्दनिर्णये॥ ३७॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 37] The time factor, who causes the transformation of the various material manifestations, is another feature of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Anyone who does not know that time is the same Supreme Personality is afraid of the time factor.

units.sanskrit: योऽन्तः प्रविश्य भूतानि भूतैरत्त्यखिलाश्रयः। स विष्ण्वाख्यो धिया ज्ञेयः कालः कलयतां प्रभुः॥ ३/३०/३८॥
units.english: [Text 38] Lord Viṣṇu, the Lord, who is the enjoyer of all sacrifices, is the time factor and the master of all masters. He enters everyone’s heart, He is the support of everyone, and He causes every being to be annihilated by another.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 38] Lord Viṣṇu, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is the enjoyer of all sacrifices, is the time factor and the master of all masters. He enters everyone’s heart, He is the support of everyone, and He causes every being to be annihilated by another.

units.sanskrit: न चास्य कश्चिद् दयितो न द्वेष्यो न च बान्धवः। आविशत्यप्रमत्तोऽसौ प्रमत्तं जनमन्तकृत्॥ ३/३०/३९॥
units.english: [Text 39] No one is dear to the Lord, nor is anyone His enemy or friend. But He gives inspiration to those who have not forgotten Him and destroys those who have.

parts.sanskrit: न चास्य कश्चिद् दयितो न द्वेष्यो न च बान्धवः। आविशत्यप्रमत्तोऽसौ प्रमत्तं जनमन्तकृत्॥ ३/३०/३९॥

“यथायोग्यातिरेकेण न द्वेष्यश्च प्रियो हरेः”
इति कापिलेये॥ ३९॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 39] No one is dear to the Supreme Personality of Godhead, nor is anyone His enemy or friend. But He gives inspiration to those who have not forgotten Him and destroys those who have.

units.sanskrit: यद्भयाद् वाति वातोऽयं सूर्यस्तपति यद्भयात्। यद्भयाद् वर्षते देवो भगणो भाति यद्भयात्॥ ३/३०/४०॥
units.english: [Text 40] Out of fear of the Lord the wind blows, out of fear of Him the sun shines, out of fear of Him the rain pours forth showers, and out of fear of Him the host of heavenly bodies shed their luster.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 40] Out of fear of the Supreme Personality of Godhead the wind blows, out of fear of Him the sun shines, out of fear of Him the rain pours forth showers, and out of fear of Him the host of heavenly bodies shed their luster.

units.sanskrit: यद् वनस्पतयो भीता लताश्चौषधिभिः सह। स्वेस्वे काले हि गृह्णन्ति पुष्पाणि च फलानि च॥ ३/३०/४१॥
units.english: [Text 41] Out of fear of the Lord the trees, creepers, herbs and seasonal plants and flowers blossom and fructify, each in its own season.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 41] Out of fear of the Supreme Personality of Godhead the trees, creepers, herbs and seasonal plants and flowers blossom and fructify, each in its own season.

units.sanskrit: स्रवन्ति सरितो भीता नोत्सर्पत्युदधिर्यतः। अग्निरिन्धे सगिरिभिर्भूर्न मज्जति यद्भयात्॥ ३/३०/४२॥
units.english: [Text 42] Out of fear of the Lord the rivers flow, and the ocean never overflows. Out of fear of Him only does fire burn and does the earth, with its mountains, not sink in the water of the universe.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 42] Out of fear of the Supreme Personality of Godhead the rivers flow, and the ocean never overflows. Out of fear of Him only does fire burn and does the earth, with its mountains, not sink in the water of the universe.

units.sanskrit: नभो ददाति श्वसतां मार्गं यन्नियमाददः। लोकस्य देहं तनुते महान् सप्तभिरावृतः॥ ३/३०/४३॥
units.english: [Text 43] Subject to the control of the Lord, the sky allows outer space to accommodate all the various planets, which hold innumerable living beings. The total universal body expands with its seven coverings under His supreme control.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 43] Subject to the control of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the sky allows outer space to accommodate all the various planets, which hold innumerable living entities. The total universal body expands with its seven coverings under His supreme control.

units.sanskrit: गुणाभिमानिनो देवाः सर्गादिष्वस्य यद्भयात्। वर्तन्तेऽनुयुगं येषां वश एतच्चराचरम्॥ ३/३०/४४॥
units.english: [Text 44] Out of fear of the Lord, the directing gods in charge of the modes of material nature carry out the functions of creation, maintenance and destruction; everything animate and inanimate within this material world is under their control.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 44] Out of fear of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the directing demigods in charge of the modes of material nature carry out the functions of creation, maintenance and destruction; everything animate and inanimate within this material world is under their control.

units.sanskrit: सोऽनन्तोऽन्तकरः कालोऽनादिरादिकृदव्ययः। जनं जनेन जनयन् मारयन् मृत्युनाऽऽत्मना॥ ३/३०/४५॥
units.english: [Text 45] The eternal time factor has no beginning and no end. It is the representative of the Lord, the maker of the criminal world. It brings about the end of the phenomenal world, it carries on the work of creation by bringing one individual into existence from another, and likewise it dissolves the universe by destroying even the lord of death, Yamarāja.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 45] The eternal time factor has no beginning and no end. It is the representative of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the maker of the criminal world. It brings about the end of the phenomenal world, it carries on the work of creation by bringing one individual into existence from another, and likewise it dissolves the universe by destroying even the lord of death, Yamarāja.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच-
तस्यैतस्य जनो नूनं नायं वेदोरुविक्रमम्। काल्यमानोऽपि बलिना वायोरिव घनाविळः॥ ३/३१/१॥
units.english: [Text 1] The Lord said: As a mass of clouds does not know the powerful influence of the wind, a person engaged in material consciousness does not know the powerful strength of the time factor, by which he is being carried.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 1] The Personality of Godhead said: As a mass of clouds does not know the powerful influence of the wind, a person engaged in material consciousness does not know the powerful strength of the time factor, by which he is being carried.

units.sanskrit: यंयमर्थमुपादत्ते दुःखेन सुखहेतवे। तंतं धुनोति भगवान् पुमाञ्छोचति यत्कृते॥ ३/३१/२॥
units.english: [Text 2] Whatever is produced by the materialist with great pain and labor for so-called happiness, the Supreme Personality, as the time factor, destroys, and for this reason the conditioned soul laments.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 2] Whatever is produced by the materialist with great pain and labor for so-called happiness, the Supreme Personality, as the time factor, destroys, and for this reason the conditioned soul laments.

units.sanskrit: यदध्रुवस्य देहस्य सानुबन्धस्य दुर्मतिः। ध्रुवाणि मन्यते मोहाद् गृहक्षेत्रवसूनि च॥ ३/३१/३॥
units.english: [Text 3] The misguided materialist does not know that his very body is impermanent and that the attractions of home, land and wealth, which are in relationship to that body, are also temporary. Out of ignorance only, he thinks that everything is permanent.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 3] The misguided materialist does not know that his very body is impermanent and that the attractions of home, land and wealth, which are in relationship to that body, are also temporary. Out of ignorance only, he thinks that everything is permanent.

units.sanskrit: जन्तुर्वै भव एतस्मिन् यांयां योनिमुपव्रजेत्। तस्यां तस्यां स लभते निर्वृतिं न विरज्यते॥ ३/३१/४॥
units.english: [Text 4] The living being, in whatever species of life he appears, finds a particular type of satisfaction in that species, and he is never averse to being situated in such a condition.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 4] The living entity, in whatever species of life he appears, finds a particular type of satisfaction in that species, and he is never averse to being situated in such a condition.

units.sanskrit: नरकस्थोऽपि देहं वै न पुमांस्त्यक्तुमिच्छति। नारक्यां निर्वृतौ सत्यां देवमायाविमोहितः॥ ३/३१/५॥
units.english: [Text 5] The conditioned living being is satisfied in his own particular species of life; while deluded by the covering influence of the illusory energy, he feels little inclined to cast off his body, even when in hell, for he takes delight in hellish enjoyment.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 5] The conditioned living entity is satisfied in his own particular species of life; while deluded by the covering influence of the illusory energy, he feels little inclined to cast off his body, even when in hell, for he takes delight in hellish enjoyment.

units.sanskrit: आत्मजायासुतागारपशुद्रविणबन्धुषु। निरूढमूलहृदय आत्मानं बहुमन्यते॥ ३/३१/६॥
units.english: [Text 6] Such satisfaction with one’s standard of living is due to deep-rooted attraction for body, wife, home, children, animals, wealth and friends. In such association, the conditioned soul thinks himself quite perfect.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 6] Such satisfaction with one’s standard of living is due to deep-rooted attraction for body, wife, home, children, animals, wealth and friends. In such association, the conditioned soul thinks himself quite perfect.

units.sanskrit: सन्दह्यमानसर्वाङ्ग एषामुद्वहनाधिना। करोत्यविरतं मूढो दुरितानि दुराशयः॥ ३/३१/७॥
units.english: [Text 7] Although he is always burning with anxiety, such a fool always performs all kinds of mischievous activities, with a hope which is never to be fulfilled, in order to maintain his so-called family and society.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 7] Although he is always burning with anxiety, such a fool always performs all kinds of mischievous activities, with a hope which is never to be fulfilled, in order to maintain his so-called family and society.

units.sanskrit: आक्षिप्तात्मेन्द्रियः स्त्रीणामसतीनां च मायया। रहोरचितसल्लापैः शिशूनां कळभाषणैः॥ ३/३१/८॥
units.english: [Text 8] He gives heart and senses to a woman, who falsely charms him with māyā. He enjoys solitary embraces and talking with her, and he is enchanted by the sweet words of the small children.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 8] He gives heart and senses to a woman, who falsely charms him with māyā. He enjoys solitary embraces and talking with her, and he is enchanted by the sweet words of the small children.

units.sanskrit: गृहेषु कूटधर्मेषु दुःखतन्त्रेष्वतन्द्रितः। कुर्वन् दुःखप्रतीकारं सुखवन्मन्यते गृही॥ ३/३१/९॥
units.english: [Text 9] The attached householder remains in his family life, which is full of diplomacy and politics. Always spreading miseries and controlled by acts of sense enjoyment, he acts just to counteract the reactions of all his miseries, and if he can successfully counteract such miseries, he thinks that he is happy.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 9] The attached householder remains in his family life, which is full of diplomacy and politics. Always spreading miseries and controlled by acts of sense gratification, he acts just to counteract the reactions of all his miseries, and if he can successfully counteract such miseries, he thinks that he is happy.

units.sanskrit: अर्थैरापादितैर्गुर्व्या हिंसयेतस्ततश्च तान्। पुष्णाति येषां पोषेण शेषभुग् यात्यधः स्वयम्॥ ३/३१/१०॥
units.english: [Text 10] He secures money by committing violence here and there, and although he employs it in the service of his family, he himself eats only a little portion of the food thus purchased, and he goes to hell for those for whom he earned the money in such an irregular way.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 10] He secures money by committing violence here and there, and although he employs it in the service of his family, he himself eats only a little portion of the food thus purchased, and he goes to hell for those for whom he earned the money in such an irregular way.

units.sanskrit: वार्तायां लुप्यमानायामारब्धायां पुनःपुनः। लोभाभिभूतो निःसत्वः परार्थे कुरुते स्पृहाम्॥ ३/३१/११॥
units.english: [Text 11] When he suffers reverses in his occupation, he tries again and again to improve himself, but when he is baffled in all attempts and is ruined, he accepts money from others because of excessive greed.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 11] When he suffers reverses in his occupation, he tries again and again to improve himself, but when he is baffled in all attempts and is ruined, he accepts money from others because of excessive greed.

units.sanskrit: कुडुम्बभरणाकल्यो मन्दभाग्यो वृथोद्यमः। श्रिया विहीनः कृपणो ध्यायञ्छ्वसति मूढधीः॥ ३/३१/१२॥
units.english: [Text 12] Thus the unfortunate man, unsuccessful in maintaining his family members, is bereft of all beauty. He always thinks of his failure, grieving very deeply.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 12] Thus the unfortunate man, unsuccessful in maintaining his family members, is bereft of all beauty. He always thinks of his failure, grieving very deeply.

units.sanskrit: एवं स्वभरणाकल्यं तत्कळत्रादयस्तदा। नाद्रियन्ते यथापूर्वं कानाश इव गोजरम्॥ ३/३१/१३॥
units.english: [Text 13] Seeing him unable to support them, his wife and others do not treat him with the same respect as before, even as miserly farmers do not accord the same treatment to their old and worn-out oxen.

parts.sanskrit: एवं स्वभरणाकल्यं तत्कळत्रादयस्तदा। नाद्रियन्ते यथापूर्वं कानाश इव गोजरम्॥ ३/३१/१३॥
कीनाशः कर्षको मतः॥ १३॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 13] Seeing him unable to support them, his wife and others do not treat him with the same respect as before, even as miserly farmers do not accord the same treatment to their old and worn-out oxen.

units.sanskrit: तत्राप्यजातनिर्वेदो भ्रियमाणः स्वयं भृतैः। जरयोपात्तवैरूप्यो मरणाभिमुखो गृहे॥ ३/३१/१४॥
units.english: [Text 14] The foolish family man does not become averse to family life although he is maintained by those whom he once maintained. Deformed by the influence of old age, he prepares himself to meet ultimate death.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 14] The foolish family man does not become averse to family life although he is maintained by those whom he once maintained. Deformed by the influence of old age, he prepares himself to meet ultimate death.

units.sanskrit: आस्तेऽवमत्याऽपत्याद्यैर्गृहपाल इवाहरन्। आमयेनाप्रदीप्ताग्निरल्पाहारोऽल्पचेष्टितः॥ ३/३१/१५॥
units.english: [Text 15] Thus he remains at home just like a pet dog and eats whatever is so negligently given to him. Afflicted with many illnesses, such as dyspepsia and loss of appetite, he eats only very small morsels of food, and he becomes an invalid who cannot work any more.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 15] Thus he remains at home just like a pet dog and eats whatever is so negligently given to him. Afflicted with many illnesses, such as dyspepsia and loss of appetite, he eats only very small morsels of food, and he becomes an invalid who cannot work any more.

units.sanskrit: वायुनोत्क्रमतोत्तारकफसंरुद्धनासिकः। कासश्वासकृतायासः कण्ठो घुरुघुरायते॥ ३/३१/१६॥
units.english: [Text 16] In that diseased condition, one’s eyes bulge due to the pressure of air from within, and his glands become congested with mucus. He has difficulty breathing, and upon exhaling and inhaling he produces a sound like ghura-ghura, a rattling within the throat.

parts.sanskrit: वायुनोत्क्रमतोत्तारकफसंरुद्धनासिकः। कासश्वासकृतायासः कण्ठो घुरुघुरायते॥ ३/३१/१६॥
उत्तारमुद्गतिं विन्द्यात्॥ १६॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 16] In that diseased condition, one’s eyes bulge due to the pressure of air from within, and his glands become congested with mucus. He has difficulty breathing, and upon exhaling and inhaling he produces a sound like ghura-ghura, a rattling within the throat.

units.sanskrit: शयानः परिशोचद्भिः परिवीतः स्वबन्धुभिः। वाच्यमानोऽपि न ब्रूते कालपाशवशं गतः॥ ३/३१/१७॥
units.english: [Text 17] In this way he comes under the clutches of death and lies down, surrounded by lamenting friends and relatives, and although he wants to speak with them, he no longer can because he is under the control of time.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 17] In this way he comes under the clutches of death and lies down, surrounded by lamenting friends and relatives, and although he wants to speak with them, he no longer can because he is under the control of time.

units.sanskrit: एवं कुडुम्बभरणे व्यापृतात्माऽजितेन्द्रियः। म्रियते क्रन्दतां स्वानामुरुवेदनयाऽस्तधीः॥ ३/३१/१८॥
units.english: [Text 18] Thus the man, who engaged with uncontrolled senses in maintaining a family, dies in great grief, seeing his relatives crying. He dies most pathetically, in great pain and without consciousness.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 18] Thus the man, who engaged with uncontrolled senses in maintaining a family, dies in great grief, seeing his relatives crying. He dies most pathetically, in great pain and without consciousness.

units.sanskrit: यमदूतौ तदा प्राप्तौ भीमौ सरभसेक्षणौ। स दृष्ट्वा त्रस्तहृदयः शकृन्मूत्रं विमुञ्चति॥ ३/३१/१९॥
units.english: [Text 19] At death, he sees the messengers of the lord of death come before him, their eyes full of wrath, and in great fear he passes stool and urine.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 19] At death, he sees the messengers of the lord of death come before him, their eyes full of wrath, and in great fear he passes stool and urine.

units.sanskrit: यातनादेह आवृत्य पाशैर्बद्ध्वा गळे बलात्। नयतो दीर्घमध्वानं दण्ड्यं राजभटा यथा॥ ३/३१/२०॥
units.english: [Text 20] As a criminal is arrested for punishment by the constables of the state, a person engaged in criminal sense enjoyment is similarly arrested by the Yamadūtas, who bind him by the neck with strong rope and cover his subtle body so that he may undergo severe punishment.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 20] As a criminal is arrested for punishment by the constables of the state, a person engaged in criminal sense gratification is similarly arrested by the Yamadūtas, who bind him by the neck with strong rope and cover his subtle body so that he may undergo severe punishment.

units.sanskrit: तयोर्निर्भिण्णहृदयस्तर्जनैर्जातवेपथुः। पथि श्वभिर्भक्ष्यमाण आर्तोऽघं स्वमनुस्मरन्॥ ३/३१/२१॥
units.english: [Text 21] While carried by the constables of Yamarāja, he is overwhelmed and trembles in their hands. While passing on the road he is bitten by dogs, and he can remember the sinful activities of his life. He is thus terribly distressed.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 21] While carried by the constables of Yamarāja, he is overwhelmed and trembles in their hands. While passing on the road he is bitten by dogs, and he can remember the sinful activities of his life. He is thus terribly distressed.

units.sanskrit: क्षुत्तृट्परीतोऽर्कदवानलानिलैः सन्तप्यमानः पथि तप्तवालुके। कृच्छ्रेण पृष्ठे कशया च ताडितश्चलत्यशक्तोऽपि निराश्रयोदके॥ ३/३१/२२॥
units.english: [Text 22] Under the scorching sun, the criminal has to pass through roads of hot sand with forest fires on both sides. He is whipped on the back by the constables because of his inability to walk, and he is afflicted by hunger and thirst, but unfortunately there is no drinking water, no shelter and no place for rest on the road.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 22] Under the scorching sun, the criminal has to pass through roads of hot sand with forest fires on both sides. He is whipped on the back by the constables because of his inability to walk, and he is afflicted by hunger and thirst, but unfortunately there is no drinking water, no shelter and no place for rest on the road.

units.sanskrit: तत्र तत्र पतञ्छ्रांतो मूर्च्छितः पुनरुत्थितः। पथा पापीयसा नीतस्तमसा यमसादनम्॥ ३/३१/२३॥
units.english: [Text 23] While passing on that road to the abode of Yamarāja, he falls down in fatigue, and sometimes he becomes unconscious, but he is forced to rise again. In this way he is very quickly brought to the presence of Yamarāja.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 23] While passing on that road to the abode of Yamarāja, he falls down in fatigue, and sometimes he becomes unconscious, but he is forced to rise again. In this way he is very quickly brought to the presence of Yamarāja.

units.sanskrit: योजनानां सहस्राणि नवतिर्नव चाध्वनः। त्रिभिर्मुहूर्तैर्द्वाभ्यां वा नीतः प्राप्नोति यातनाम्॥ ३/३१/२४॥
units.english: [Text 24] Thus he has to pass ninety-nine thousand yojanas within two or three moments, and then he is at once engaged in the torturous punishment which he is destined to suffer.

parts.sanskrit: योजनानां सहस्राणि नवतिर्नव चाध्वनः। त्रिभिर्मुहूर्तैर्द्वाभ्यां वा नीतः प्राप्नोति यातनाम्॥ ३/३१/२४॥

“त्रिभिर्मुहूर्तैर्द्वाभ्यां वा दिनैर्दशभिरेव वा।
पक्षान्मासेन वा याति यमलोकमितो मृतः॥”
इति नारदीये॥ २४॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 24] Thus he has to pass ninety-nine thousand yojanas within two or three moments, and then he is at once engaged in the torturous punishment which he is destined to suffer.

units.sanskrit: आदीपनं स्वगात्राणां वेष्टयित्वोल्मुकादिभिः। आत्ममांसादनं क्वापि स्वकृतं परतोऽपि वा॥ ३/३१/२५॥
units.english: [Text 25] He is placed in the midst of burning pieces of wood, and his limbs are set on fire. In some cases he is made to eat his own flesh or have it eaten by others.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 25] He is placed in the midst of burning pieces of wood, and his limbs are set on fire. In some cases he is made to eat his own flesh or have it eaten by others.

units.sanskrit: जीवतश्चान्त्राभ्युद्धारः श्वगृध्रैर्यमसादने। सर्पवृश्चिकदंशाद्यैः स्मरद्भिश्चात्मवैशसम्॥ ३/३१/२६॥
units.english: [Text 26] His entrails are pulled out by the hounds and vultures of hell, even though he is still alive to see it, and he is subjected to torment by serpents, scorpions, gnats and other creatures that bite him.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 26] His entrails are pulled out by the hounds and vultures of hell, even though he is still alive to see it, and he is subjected to torment by serpents, scorpions, gnats and other creatures that bite him.

units.sanskrit: कृन्तनं चावयवशो गजादिभ्योऽभिधावनम्। पातनं गिरिशृङ्गेभ्यो रोधनं बन्धगर्तयोः॥ ३/३१/२७॥
units.english: [Text 27] Next his limbs are lopped off and torn asunder by elephants. He is hurled down from hilltops, and he is also held captive either in water or in a cave.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 27] Next his limbs are lopped off and torn asunder by elephants. He is hurled down from hilltops, and he is also held captive either in water or in a cave.

units.sanskrit: यास्तामिस्रान्धतामिस्ररौरवाद्याश्च यातनाः। भुङ्क्ते नरो वा नारी वा मिथः सङ्गेन निर्मिताः॥ ३/३१/२८॥
units.english: [Text 28] Men and women whose lives were built upon indulgence in illicit sex life are put into many kinds of miserable conditions in the hells known as Tāmisra, Andha-tāmisra and Raurava.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 28] Men and women whose lives were built upon indulgence in illicit sex life are put into many kinds of miserable conditions in the hells known as Tāmisra, Andha-tāmisra and Raurava.

units.sanskrit: अत्रैव नरकः स्वर्ग इति मातः प्रचक्षते। या यातना वै नारक्यस्ता इहाप्युपलक्षिताः॥ ३/३१/२९॥
units.english: [Text 29] Lord Kapila continued: My dear mother, it is sometimes said that we experience hell or heaven on this planet, for hellish punishments are sometimes visible on this planet also.

parts.sanskrit: अत्रैव नरकः स्वर्ग इति मातः प्रचक्षते। या यातना वै नारक्यस्ता इहाप्युपलक्षिताः॥ ३/३१/२९॥
अत्रैवेत्येवशब्दः सामीप्यार्थे। “सामीप्ये च प्रधाने च एवशब्दोऽवधारणे” इति शब्दनिर्णये। अत्राप्यस्तीत्यर्थः॥ २९॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 29] Lord Kapila continued: My dear mother, it is sometimes said that we experience hell or heaven on this planet, for hellish punishments are sometimes visible on this planet also.

units.sanskrit: एवं कुडुम्बं बिभ्राण उदरम्भर एव वा। विसृज्येहोभयं प्रेत्य भुङ्क्ते तत्फलमीदृशम्॥ ३/३१/३०॥
units.english: [Text 30] After leaving this body, the man who maintained himself and his family members by sinful activities suffers a hellish life, and his relatives suffer also.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 30] After leaving this body, the man who maintained himself and his family members by sinful activities suffers a hellish life, and his relatives suffer also.

units.sanskrit: एकः प्रपद्यतेऽध्वानं हित्वेह स्वकळेबरम्। कुशलेतरपाथेयो भूतद्रोहेण यद् भृतम्॥ ३/३१/३१॥
units.english: [Text 31] He goes alone to the darkest regions of hell after quitting the present body, and the money he acquired by envying other living beings is the passage money with which he leaves this world.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 31] He goes alone to the darkest regions of hell after quitting the present body, and the money he acquired by envying other living entities is the passage money with which he leaves this world.

units.sanskrit: दैवेनासादितं तस्य शमलं निरये पुमान्। भुङ्क्ते कुडुम्बपोषस्य हृतचित्त इवातुरः॥ ३/३१/३२॥
units.english: [Text 32] Thus, by the arrangement of the Lord, the maintainer of kinsmen is put into a hellish condition to suffer for his sinful activities, like a man who has lost his wealth.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 32] Thus, by the arrangement of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the maintainer of kinsmen is put into a hellish condition to suffer for his sinful activities, like a man who has lost his wealth.

units.sanskrit: केवलेन ह्यधर्मेण कुडुम्बभरणोन्मुखः। याति जीवोऽन्धतामिस्रं चरमं तमसः पदम्॥ ३/३१/३३॥
units.english: [Text 33] Therefore a person who is very eager to maintain his family and kinsmen simply by black methods certainly goes to the darkest region of hell, which is known as Andha-tāmisra.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 33] Therefore a person who is very eager to maintain his family and kinsmen simply by black methods certainly goes to the darkest region of hell, which is known as Andha-tāmisra.

units.sanskrit: अधस्तान्नरलोकस्य यावतीर्यातनास्तु ताः। क्रमशः समनुक्रम्य पुनरत्राव्रजेच्छुचिः॥ ३/३१/३४॥
units.english: [Text 34] Having gone through all the miserable, hellish conditions and having passed in a regular order through the lowest forms of animal life prior to human birth, and having thus been purged of his sins, one is reborn again as a human being on this earth.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 34] Having gone through all the miserable, hellish conditions and having passed in a regular order through the lowest forms of animal life prior to human birth, and having thus been purged of his sins, one is reborn again as a human being on this earth.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच-
कर्मणा दैवतन्त्रेण जन्तुर्देहोपपत्तये। स्त्रियाः प्रविष्ट उदरं पुंसो रेतःकणाश्रयः॥ ३/३२/१॥
units.english: [Text 1] The Lord said: Under the supervision of the Supreme Lord and according to the result of his work, the living being, the soul, is made to enter into the womb of a woman through the particle of male semen to assume a particular type of body.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 1] The Personality of Godhead said: Under the supervision of the Supreme Lord and according to the result of his work, the living entity, the soul, is made to enter into the womb of a woman through the particle of male semen to assume a particular type of body.

units.sanskrit: कलिलं त्वेकरात्रेण पञ्चरात्रेण बुद्बुदम्। दशाहेन तु कर्कन्धुः पेश्यण्डं वा ततः परम्॥ ३/३२/२॥
units.english: [Text 2] On the first night, the sperm and ovum mix, and on the fifth night the mixture ferments into a bubble. On the tenth night it develops into a form like a plum, and after that, it gradually turns into a lump of flesh or an egg, as the case may be.

parts.sanskrit: कलिलं त्वेकरात्रेण पञ्चरात्रेण बुद्बुदम्। दशाहेन तु कर्कन्धुः पेश्यण्डं वा ततः परम्॥ ३/३२/२॥

“नानाविधा गर्भवृद्धिः कर्मभेदाद् भविष्यति।
अतो नानाविधं ग्रन्थे गर्भसंस्थानमुच्यते॥”
इति षाड्गुण्ये॥ २॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 2] On the first night, the sperm and ovum mix, and on the fifth night the mixture ferments into a bubble. On the tenth night it develops into a form like a plum, and after that, it gradually turns into a lump of flesh or an egg, as the case may be.

units.sanskrit: मासेन तु शिरो द्वाभ्यां बाह्ङ्घ्रव्याद्यङ्गविग्रहः। नखलोमास्थिचर्माणि लिङ्गच्छिद्रोद्भवस्त्रिभिः॥ ३/३२/३॥
units.english: [Text 3] In the course of a month, a head is formed, and at the end of two months the hands, feet and other limbs take shape. By the end of three months, the nails, fingers, toes, body hair, bones and skin appear, as do the organ of generation and the other apertures in the body, namely the eyes, nostrils, ears, mouth and anus.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 3] In the course of a month, a head is formed, and at the end of two months the hands, feet and other limbs take shape. By the end of three months, the nails, fingers, toes, body hair, bones and skin appear, as do the organ of generation and the other apertures in the body, namely the eyes, nostrils, ears, mouth and anus.

units.sanskrit: चतुर्भिर्धातवः सप्त पञ्चभिः क्षुत्तृडुद्भवः। षड्भिर्जरायुणा वीतः कुक्षौ भ्राम्यति दक्षिणे॥ ३/३२/४॥
units.english: [Text 4] Within four months from the date of conception, the seven essential ingredients of the body, namely chyle, blood, flesh, fat, bone, marrow and semen, come into existence. At the end of five months, hunger and thirst make themselves felt, and at the end of six months, the fetus, enclosed by the amnion, begins to move on the right side of the abdomen.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 4] Within four months from the date of conception, the seven essential ingredients of the body, namely chyle, blood, flesh, fat, bone, marrow and semen, come into existence. At the end of five months, hunger and thirst make themselves felt, and at the end of six months, the fetus, enclosed by the amnion, begins to move on the right side of the abdomen.

units.sanskrit: सप्तमे जन्मकर्माणि गतानि स्मरते ऋषिः। जगत्यां यानि देवस्य मायया बन्धमात्मनः॥ ३/३२/५॥
units.english: [Text 5] Deriving its nutrition from the food and drink taken by the mother, the fetus grows and remains in that abominable residence of stools and urine, which is the breeding place of all kinds of worms.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 5] Deriving its nutrition from the food and drink taken by the mother, the fetus grows and remains in that abominable residence of stools and urine, which is the breeding place of all kinds of worms.

units.sanskrit: मातुर्जग्धान्नपानाद्यैरेधत्यातुरसम्मतः। आस्ते विण्मूत्रयोर्गर्ते सजन्तुर्जन्तुसम्भवे॥ ३/३२/६॥
units.english: [Text 6] Bitten again and again all over the body by the hungry worms in the abdomen itself, the child suffers terrible agony because of his tenderness. He thus becomes unconscious moment after moment because of the terrible condition.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 6] Bitten again and again all over the body by the hungry worms in the abdomen itself, the child suffers terrible agony because of his tenderness. He thus becomes unconscious moment after moment because of the terrible condition.

units.sanskrit: कृमिभिः क्षतकण्ड्वङ्गः सौकुमार्यात् प्रतिक्षणम्। मूर्च्छामाप्नोत्युरुक्लेशस्तत्रत्यैः क्षुधितैर्मुहुः॥ ३/३२/७॥
units.english: [Text 7] Owing to the mother’s eating bitter, pungent foodstuffs, or food which is too salty or too sour, the body of the child incessantly suffers pains which are almost intolerable.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 7] Owing to the mother’s eating bitter, pungent foodstuffs, or food which is too salty or too sour, the body of the child incessantly suffers pains which are almost intolerable.

units.sanskrit: कटुतीक्ष्णोष्णलवणक्षाराम्लादिभिरुद्बणैः। मातृभुक्तैरुपस्पृष्टः सर्वाङ्गोत्थितवेदनः॥ ३/३२/८॥
units.english: [Text 8] Placed within the amnion and covered outside by the intestines, the child remains lying on one side of the abdomen, his head turned towards his belly and his back and neck arched like a bow.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 8] Placed within the amnion and covered outside by the intestines, the child remains lying on one side of the abdomen, his head turned towards his belly and his back and neck arched like a bow.

units.sanskrit: उल्बेन संवृतस्तस्मिन्नान्त्रैश्च बहिरावृतः। आस्ते कृत्वा शिरः कुक्षौ भुग्नपृष्ठशिरोधरः॥ ३/३२/९॥
units.english: [Text 9] The child thus remains just like a bird in a cage, without freedom of movement. At that time, if the child is fortunate, he can remember all the troubles of his past one hundred births, and he grieves wretchedly. What is the possibility of peace of mind in that condition?

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 9] The child thus remains just like a bird in a cage, without freedom of movement. At that time, if the child is fortunate, he can remember all the troubles of his past one hundred births, and he grieves wretchedly. What is the possibility of peace of mind in that condition?

units.sanskrit: अकल्यः स्वाङ्गचेष्टायां शकुन्त इव पञ्जरे। तत्र लब्धस्मृतिर्दैवात् कर्म जन्मशतोद्भवम्। स्मरन् दीर्घमनुच्छ्वासं गर्भे किं नाम विन्दते॥ ३/३२/१०॥
units.english: [Text 10] Thus endowed with the development of consciousness from the seventh month after his conception, the child is tossed downward by the airs that press the embryo during the weeks preceding delivery. Like the worms born of the same filthy abdominal cavity, he cannot remain in one place.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 10] Thus endowed with the development of consciousness from the seventh month after his conception, the child is tossed downward by the airs that press the embryo during the weeks preceding delivery. Like the worms born of the same filthy abdominal cavity, he cannot remain in one place.

units.sanskrit: आरभ्य सप्तमान्मासाल्लब्धबोधोऽतिवेपितः। नैकत्रास्ते सूतिवातैर्विष्ठाभूरिव सोदरः॥ ३/३२/११॥
units.english: [Text 11] The living being in this frightful condition of life, bound by seven layers of material ingredients, prays with folded hands, appealing to the Lord, who has put him in that condition.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 11] The living entity in this frightful condition of life, bound by seven layers of material ingredients, prays with folded hands, appealing to the Lord, who has put him in that condition.

units.sanskrit: नाथमानो ऋषिर्भीतः सप्तवध्रिः कृताञ्जलिः। स्तवीति तं विक्ल्बया वाचा येनोदरेऽर्पितः॥ ३/३२/१२॥
units.english: [Text 12] The human soul says: I take shelter of the lotus feet of the Lord, who appears in His various eternal forms and walks on the surface of the world. I take shelter of Him only, because He can give me relief from all fear and from Him I have received this condition of life, which is just befitting my impious activities.

parts.sanskrit: नाथमानो ऋषिर्भीतः सप्तवध्रिः कृताञ्जलिः। स्तवीति तं विक्ल्बया वाचा येनोदरेऽर्पितः॥ ३/३२/१२॥
“वध्रयस्त्विन्द्रियाण्याहुर्हृषीकाणीति चाप्युत” इति शब्दनिर्णये॥ १२॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

I take shelter of Him only, because He can give me relief from all fear and from Him I have received this condition of life, which is just befitting my impious activities.

units.sanskrit:
जीव उवाच-
तस्योपसन्नमवितुर्जगदिच्छयाऽऽत्त- लीलातनोर्भुवि लसच्चरणारविन्दम्। सोऽहं व्रजामि शरणं नकुतोभयं मे येनेदृशी गतिरदर्श्यसतोऽनुरूपा॥ ३/३२/१३॥
units.english: [Text 13] I, the pure soul, appearing now bound by my activities, am lying in the womb of my mother by the arrangement of māyā. I offer my respectful obeisances unto Him who is also here with me but who is unaffected and changeless. He is unlimited, but He is perceived in the repentant heart. To Him I offer my respectful obeisances.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 13] I, the pure soul, appearing now bound by my activities, am lying in the womb of my mother by the arrangement of māyā. I offer my respectful obeisances unto Him who is also here with me but who is unaffected and changeless. He is unlimited, but He is perceived in the repentant heart. To Him I offer my respectful obeisances.

units.sanskrit: यस्त्वत्र बद्ध इव कर्मभिरावृतात्मा भूतेन्द्रियाशयमयीमवलम्ब्य मायाम्। आस्ते विशुद्धमविकारमखण्डबोध- मातप्यमानहृदयेऽवसितं तमेमि॥ ३/३२/१४॥
units.english: [Text 14] I am separated from the Supreme Lord because of my being in this material body, which is made of five elements, and therefore my qualities and senses are being misused, although I am essentially spiritual. Because the Lord is transcendental to material nature and the living beings, because He is devoid of such a material body, and because He is always glorious in His spiritual qualities, I offer my obeisances unto Him.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 14] I am separated from the Supreme Lord because of my being in this material body, which is made of five elements, and therefore my qualities and senses are being misused, although I am essentially spiritual. units.sanskrit: यः पञ्चभूतरचिते रहितः शरीरे छन्नो यथेन्द्रियगुणार्थविदात्मकोऽहम्। तेनाविकुण्ठमहिमानमृषिं तमेनं वन्दे परं प्रकृतिपूरुषयोः पुमांसम्॥ ३/३२/१५॥
units.english: [Text 15] The human soul further prays: The living being is put under the influence of material nature and continues a hard struggle for existence on the path of repeated birth and death. This conditional life is due to his forgetfulness of his relationship with the Lord. Therefore, without the Lord’s mercy, how can he again engage in the transcendental loving service of the Lord?

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 15] The human soul further prays: The living entity is put under the influence of material nature and continues a hard struggle for existence on the path of repeated birth and death. units.sanskrit: यन्माययोरुगुणकर्मनिबन्धनेऽस्मिन् सांसारिके पथि चरंस्तदतिश्रमेण। नष्टस्मृतिः पुनरयं प्रवृणीत लोको युक्त्या कया महदनुग्रहमन्तरेण॥ ३/३२/१६॥
units.english: [Text 16] No one other than the Lord, as the localized Paramātmā, the partial representation of the Lord, is directing all inanimate and animate objects. He is present in the three phases of time — past, present and future. Therefore, the conditioned soul is engaged in different activities by His direction, and in order to get free from the threefold miseries of this conditional life, we have to surrender unto Him only.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

units.sanskrit: ज्ञानं यदेतददधात् कतमः स देवस्त्रैकालिकं स्थिरचरेष्वनुवर्तितांशः। तं जीवकर्मपदवीमनुवर्तमाना- स्तापत्रयोपशमनाय वयं भजेम॥ ३/३२/१७॥
units.english: [Text 17] Fallen into a pool of blood, stool and urine within the abdomen of his mother, his own body scorched by the mother’s gastric fire, the embodied soul, anxious to get out, counts his months and prays, “O my Lord, when shall I, a wretched soul, be released from this confinement?”

parts.sanskrit: ज्ञानं यदेतददधात् कतमः स देवस्त्रैकालिकं स्थिरचरेष्वनुवर्तितांशः। तं जीवकर्मपदवीमनुवर्तमाना- स्तापत्रयोपशमनाय वयं भजेम॥ ३/३२/१७॥
कतमः सुखतमः॥ १७॥

units.sanskrit: देह्यन्यदेहविवरे जठराग्निनाऽसृ- ग्विण्मूत्रकूपपतितो भृशतप्तदेहः। इच्छन्नितो विवसितुं गणयन् स्वमासान् निर्वास्यते कृपणधीर्भवता कदा नु॥ ३/३२/१८॥
units.english: [Text 18] My dear Lord, by Your causeless mercy I am awakened to consciousness, although I am only ten months old. For this causeless mercy of the Lord, the friend of all fallen souls, there is no way to express my gratitude but to pray with folded hands.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 18] My dear Lord, by Your causeless mercy I am awakened to consciousness, although I am only ten months old.
