units.sanskrit: येनेदृशीं मतिमसौ दशमास्य ईश सङ्ग्राहितः पुरुदयेन भवादृशेन। स्वेनैव तुष्यतु कृतेन स दीननाथः को नाम तत्प्रति विनाऽञ्जलिमस्य कुर्यात्॥ ३/३२/१९॥
units.english: [Text 19] The living being in another type of body sees only by instinct; he knows only the agreeable and disagreeable sense perceptions of that particular body. But I have a body in which I can control my senses and can understand my destination; therefore, I offer my respectful obeisances to the Lord, by whom I have been blessed with this body and by whose grace I can see Him within and without.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 19] The living entity in another type of body sees only by instinct; he knows only the agreeable and disagreeable sense perceptions of that particular body. But I have a body in which I can control my senses and can understand my destination; therefore, I offer my respectful obeisances to the Supreme Personality of Godhead, by whom I have been blessed with this body and by whose grace I can see Him within and without.

units.sanskrit: पश्यत्ययं धिषणया ननु सप्तवघ्रिः शारीरभेदमशरीरवदस्य देहे। यद्दत्तया स तमहं पुरुषं पुराणं पश्ये बहिर्हृदि च चैत्त्यमिव प्रतीतम्॥ ३/३२/२०॥
units.english: [Text 20] Therefore, my Lord, although I am living in a terrible condition, I do not wish to depart from my mother’s abdomen to fall again into the blind well of materialistic life. Your external energy, called deva-māyā, at once captures the newly born child, and immediately false identification, which is the beginning of the cycle of continual birth and death, begins.

parts.sanskrit: पश्यत्ययं धिषणया ननु सप्तवघ्रिः शारीरभेदमशरीरवदस्य देहे। यद्दत्तया स तमहं पुरुषं पुराणं पश्ये बहिर्हृदि च चैत्त्यमिव प्रतीतम्॥ ३/३२/२०॥

अशरीरवत् परमात्मवत्। परमात्मन एव देहोऽपि तद्वशत्वात्।
“तत्त्वज्ञानं तु देवानां गर्भस्थानां भविष्यति।
उत्तमानामृषीणां वाऽप्यन्येषां बहुजन्मगम्॥”
इति स्कान्दे॥ २०॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 20] Therefore, my Lord, although I am living in a terrible condition, I do not wish to depart from my mother’s abdomen to fall again into the blind well of materialistic life. Your external energy, called deva-māyā, at once captures the newly born child, and immediately false identification, which is the beginning of the cycle of continual birth and death, begins.

units.sanskrit: सोऽहं वसन्नपि विभो बहुदुःखवासं गर्भान्न निर्जिगमिषे बहिरन्धकूपे। यत्रोपयातमुपसर्पति देवमाया मिथ्यामतिर्यदनु संसृतिचक्रमेतत्॥ ३/३२/२१॥
units.english: [Text 21] Therefore, without being agitated any more, I shall deliver myself from the darkness of nescience with the help of my friend, clear consciousness. Simply by keeping the lotus feet of Lord Viṣṇu in my mind, I shall be saved from entering into the wombs of many mothers for repeated birth and death.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 21] Therefore, without being agitated any more, I shall deliver myself from the darkness of nescience with the help of my friend, clear consciousness. Simply by keeping the lotus feet of Lord Viṣṇu in my mind, I shall be saved from entering into the wombs of many mothers for repeated birth and death.

units.sanskrit: तस्मादहं विगतविक्ल्ब उद्धरिष्य आत्मानमाशु तमसः सुहृदात्मनैव। भूयो यथा व्यसनमेतदनेकरन्ध्रं मा मे भविष्यदुपसादितविष्णुपादः॥ ३/३२/२२॥
units.english: [Text 22] Lord Kapila continued: The ten-month-old living being has these desires even while in the womb. But while he thus extols the Lord, the wind that helps parturition propels him forth with his face turned downward so that he may be born.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 22] Lord Kapila continued: The ten-month-old living entity has these desires even while in the womb. But while he thus extols the Lord, the wind that helps parturition propels him forth with his face turned downward so that he may be born.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच-
एवं कृतमतिं गर्भे दशमास्यं सपद्यृषिम्। सद्यः क्षिपत्यवाचीनं प्रसूत्यै सूतिमारुतः॥ ३/३२/२३॥
units.english: [Text 23] Pushed downward all of a sudden by the wind, the child comes out with great trouble, head downward, breathless and deprived of memory due to severe agony.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 23] Pushed downward all of a sudden by the wind, the child comes out with great trouble, head downward, breathless and deprived of memory due to severe agony.

units.sanskrit: तेनोपसृष्टः सहसा कृत्वाऽवाक्शिर आतुरः। विनिष्क्रामति कृच्छ्रेण निरुच्छ्वासो गतस्मृतिः॥ ३/३२/२४॥
units.english: [Text 24] The child thus falls on the ground, smeared with stool and blood, and plays just like a worm germinated from the stool. He loses his superior knowledge and cries under the spell of māyā.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 24] The child thus falls on the ground, smeared with stool and blood, and plays just like a worm germinated from the stool. He loses his superior knowledge and cries under the spell of māyā.

units.sanskrit: पतितो भुव्यसृङ्मूत्रे विष्ठाभूरिव चेष्टते। रोरूयति गतज्ञानो विपरीतां गतिं गतः॥ ३/३२/२५॥
units.english: [Text 25] After coming out of the abdomen, the child is given to the care of persons who are unable to understand what he wants, and thus he is nursed by such persons. Unable to refuse whatever is given to him, he falls into undesirable circumstances.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 25] After coming out of the abdomen, the child is given to the care of persons who are unable to understand what he wants, and thus he is nursed by such persons. Unable to refuse whatever is given to him, he falls into undesirable circumstances.

units.sanskrit: परच्छन्दं नविदुषा पुष्यमाणो जनेन सः। अनभिप्रेतमापन्नः प्रत्याख्यातुमनीश्वरः॥ ३/३२/२६॥
units.english: [Text 26] Laid down on a foul bed infested with sweat and germs, the poor child is incapable of scratching his body to get relief from his itching sensation, to say nothing of sitting up, standing or even moving.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 26] Laid down on a foul bed infested with sweat and germs, the poor child is incapable of scratching his body to get relief from his itching sensation, to say nothing of sitting up, standing or even moving.

units.sanskrit: शायितोऽशुचिपर्यङ्के जन्तुः स्वेदजदूषिते। नेशः कण्डूयनेऽङ्गानामासनोत्थानचेष्टने॥ ३/३२/२७॥
units.english: [Text 27] In his helpless condition, gnats, mosquitoes, bugs and other germs bite the baby, whose skin is tender, just as smaller worms bite a big worm. The child, deprived of his wisdom, cries bitterly.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 27] In his helpless condition, gnats, mosquitoes, bugs and other germs bite the baby, whose skin is tender, just as smaller worms bite a big worm. The child, deprived of his wisdom, cries bitterly.

units.sanskrit: तुदन्त्यामत्वचं दंशा मशका मत्कुणादयः। रुदन्तं विगतज्ञानं कृमयः कृमिकं यथा॥ ३/३२/२८॥
units.english: [Text 28] In this way, the child passes through his childhood, suffering different kinds of distress, and attains boyhood. In boyhood also he suffers pain over desires to get things he can never achieve. And thus, due to ignorance, he becomes angry and sorry.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 28] In this way, the child passes through his childhood, suffering different kinds of distress, and attains boyhood. In boyhood also he suffers pain over desires to get things he can never achieve. And thus, due to ignorance, he becomes angry and sorry.

units.sanskrit: इत्येवं शैशवं भुक्त्वा दुःखं पौगण्डमेव च। अलब्धाभीप्सितोऽज्ञानादिद्धमन्युः शुचाऽर्पितः॥ ३/३२/२९॥
units.english: [Text 29] With the growth of the body, the living being, in order to vanquish his soul, increases his false prestige and anger and thereby creates enmity towards similarly lusty people.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 29] With the growth of the body, the living entity, in order to vanquish his soul, increases his false prestige and anger and thereby creates enmity towards similarly lusty people.

units.sanskrit: सह देहेन मानेन वर्धमानेन मन्युना। करोति विग्रहं कामी कामिष्वन्ताय चात्मनः॥ ३/३२/३०॥
units.english: [Text 30] By such ignorance the living being accepts the material body, which is made of five elements, as himself. With this misunderstanding, he accepts nonpermanent things as his own and increases his ignorance in the darkest region.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 30] By such ignorance the living entity accepts the material body, which is made of five elements, as himself. With this misunderstanding, he accepts nonpermanent things as his own and increases his ignorance in the darkest region.

units.sanskrit: भूतैः पञ्चभिरारब्धे देहे देह्यबुधोऽसकृत्। अहम्ममेत्यसद्ग्राहां करोति कुमतिर्मतिम्॥ ३/३२/३१॥
units.english: [Text 31] For the sake of the body, which is a source of constant trouble to him and which follows him because he is bound by ties of ignorance and actions aimed at results, he performs various actions which cause him to be subjected to repeated birth and death.

english_edits.rule: fruitive activities -> actions aimed at results

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 31] For the sake of the body, which is a source of constant trouble to him and which follows him because he is bound by ties of ignorance and fruitive activities, he performs various actions which cause him to be subjected to repeated birth and death.

units.sanskrit: तदर्थं कुरुते कर्म यद्बद्धो याति संसृतिम्। तमो विशति यद्बद्धो येनासौ मर्त्यजन्मनि॥ ३/३२/३२॥
units.english: [Text 32] If, therefore, the living being again associates with the path of unrighteousness, influenced by sensually minded people engaged in the pursuit of sexual enjoyment and the gratification of the palate, he again goes to hell as before.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 32] If, therefore, the living entity again associates with the path of unrighteousness, influenced by sensually minded people engaged in the pursuit of sexual enjoyment and the gratification of the palate, he again goes to hell as before.

units.sanskrit: येन यातीदृशं क्लेशमविद्याकर्मबन्धनम्॥ ३/३२/३३॥
units.english: [Text 33] He becomes devoid of truthfulness, cleanliness, mercy, gravity, spiritual intelligence, shyness, austerity, fame, forgiveness, control of the mind, control of the senses, fortune and all such opportunities.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 33] He becomes devoid of truthfulness, cleanliness, mercy, gravity, spiritual intelligence, shyness, austerity, fame, forgiveness, control of the mind, control of the senses, fortune and all such opportunities.

units.sanskrit: यद्यसद्भिः पथि पुनः शिश्नोदरकृतोद्यमैः। आस्थितो रमते जन्तुस्तमो विशति पूर्ववत्॥ ३/३२/३४॥
units.english: [Text 34] One should not associate with a coarse fool who is bereft of the knowledge of self-realization and who is no more than a dancing dog in the hands of a woman.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 34] One should not associate with a coarse fool who is bereft of the knowledge of self-realization and who is no more than a dancing dog in the hands of a woman.

units.sanskrit: सत्यं शौचं दया मौनं बुद्धिः श्रीर्ह्वीर्यशः क्षमा। शमो दमो भगश्चेति यत्सङ्गाद् याति सङ्क्ष्यम्॥ ३/३२/३५॥
units.english: [Text 35] The infatuation and bondage which accrue to a man from attachment to any other object is not as complete as that resulting from attachment to a woman or to the fellowship of men who are fond of women.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 35] The infatuation and bondage which accrue to a man from attachment to any other object is not as complete as that resulting from attachment to a woman or to the fellowship of men who are fond of women.

units.sanskrit: तेष्वशान्तेषु मूढेषु खण्डितात्मावसायिषु। सङ्गं न कुर्याच्छोच्येषु योषित्क्रीडामृगेषु च॥ ३/३२/३६॥
units.english: [Text 36] At the sight of his own daughter, Brahmā was bewildered by her charms and shamelessly ran up to her in the form of a stag when she took the form of a hind.

parts.sanskrit: तेष्वशान्तेषु मूढेषु खण्डितात्मावसायिषु। सङ्गं न कुर्याच्छोच्येषु योषित्क्रीडामृगेषु च॥ ३/३२/३६॥
खण्डितात्मावसायिषु जीवमात्रज्ञानिषु॥ ३६॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 36] At the sight of his own daughter, Brahmā was bewildered by her charms and shamelessly ran up to her in the form of a stag when she took the form of a hind.

units.sanskrit: न तथाऽस्य भवेन्मोहो बन्धश्चान्यप्रसङ्गतः। योषित्सङ्गाद् यथा पुंसां यथा तत्सङ्गिसङ्गतः॥ ३/३२/३७॥
units.english: [Text 37] Amongst all kinds of living beings begotten by Brahmā, namely men, gods and animals, none but the sage Nārāyaṇa is immune to the attraction of māyā in the form of woman.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 37] Amongst all kinds of living entities begotten by Brahmā, namely men, demigods and animals, none but the sage Nārāyaṇa is immune to the attraction of māyā in the form of woman.

units.sanskrit: प्रजापतिः स्वां दुहितरं दृष्ट्वा तद्रूपधर्षितः। रोहिद्भूतां सोऽन्वधावद् ऋष्यरूपी हतत्रपः॥ ३/३२/३८॥
units.english: [Text 38] Just try to understand the mighty strength of My māyā in the shape of woman, who by the mere movement of her eyebrows can keep even the greatest conquerors of the world under her grip.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 38] Just try to understand the mighty strength of My māyā in the shape of woman, who by the mere movement of her eyebrows can keep even the greatest conquerors of the world under her grip.

units.sanskrit: तत्सृष्टिसृष्टसृष्टेषु कोन्वखण्डितधीः पुमान्। ऋषिं नारायणमृते योषिन्मय्येह मायया॥ ३/३२/३९॥
units.english: [Text 39] One who aspires to reach the culmination of yoga and has realized his self by rendering service unto Me should never associate with an attractive woman, for such a woman is declared in the scripture to be the gateway to hell for the advancing devotee.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 39] One who aspires to reach the culmination of yoga and has realized his self by rendering service unto Me should never associate with an attractive woman, for such a woman is declared in the scripture to be the gateway to hell for the advancing devotee.

units.sanskrit: बलं मे पश्य मायायाः स्त्रीमय्या जयिनो दिशाम्। या करोति निजायत्तान् भ्रूविजृम्भेण केवलम्॥ ३/३२/४०॥
units.english: [Text 40] The woman, created by the Lord, is the representation of māyā, and one who associates with such māyā by accepting services must certainly know that this is the way of death, just like a blind well covered with grass.

parts.sanskrit: बलं मे पश्य मायायाः स्त्रीमय्या जयिनो दिशाम्। या करोति निजायत्तान् भ्रूविजृम्भेण केवलम्॥ ३/३२/४०॥

“मयः प्रधान उद्दिष्टो माया तद्वश उच्यते”
इति षाड्गुण्ये॥ ४०॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 40] The woman, created by the Lord, is the representation of māyā, and one who associates with such māyā by accepting services must certainly know that this is the way of death, just like a blind well covered with grass.

units.sanskrit: सङ्गं न कुर्यात् प्रमदासु जातु योगस्य पारं परमारुरुक्षुः। मत्सेवया प्रतिलब्धात्मलाभो वदन्ति यां निरयद्वारमस्य॥ ३/३२/४१॥
units.english: [Text 41] A living being who, as a result of attachment to a woman in his previous life, has been endowed with the form of a woman, foolishly looks upon māyā in the form of a man, her husband, as the bestower of wealth, progeny, house and other material assets.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 41] A living entity who, as a result of attachment to a woman in his previous life, has been endowed with the form of a woman, foolishly looks upon māyā in the form of a man, her husband, as the bestower of wealth, progeny, house and other material assets.

units.sanskrit: योपयाति शनैर्माया योषिद् देवविनिर्मिता। तामीक्षेतात्मनो मृत्युं तृणैः कूपमिवावृतम्॥ ३/३२/४२॥
units.english: [Text 42] A woman, therefore, should consider her husband, her house and her children to be the arrangement of the external energy of the Lord for her death, just as the sweet singing of the hunter is death for the deer.

parts.sanskrit: योपयाति शनैर्माया योषिद् देवविनिर्मिता। तामीक्षेतात्मनो मृत्युं तृणैः कूपमिवावृतम्॥ ३/३२/४२॥

“सत्पुंसु च तथा स्त्रीषु न सङ्गो दोषमावहेत्।
यथायोग्यं गुणायैव दोषकृद् दुष्टजन्तुषु॥”
इति वाराहे॥ ४१-४२॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 42] A woman, therefore, should consider her husband, her house and her children to be the arrangement of the external energy of the Lord for her death, just as the sweet singing of the hunter is death for the deer.

units.sanskrit: यां मन्यते पतिर्मोहान्मन्मायामृषभायतीम्। स्त्रीत्वं स्त्रीसङ्गतः प्राप्तां वित्तापत्यगृहप्रदाम्॥ ३/३२/४३॥
units.english: [Text 43] Due to his particular type of body, the materialistic living being wanders from one planet to another, following actions aimed at results. In this way, he involves himself in actions aimed at results and enjoys the result incessantly.

english_edits.rule: fruitive activities -> actions aimed at results

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 43] Due to his particular type of body, the materialistic living entity wanders from one planet to another, following fruitive activities. In this way, he involves himself in fruitive activities and enjoys the result incessantly.

units.sanskrit: तामात्मनो विजानीयाद् भृत्यापत्यगृहात्मकम्। दैवोपसादितं मृत्युं मृगयोर्गायनं यथा॥ ३/३२/४४॥
units.english: [Text 44] In this way the living being gets a suitable body with a material mind and senses, according to his actions aimed at results. When the reaction of his particular activity comes to an end, that end is called death, and when a particular type of reaction begins, that beginning is called birth.

english_edits.rule: fruitive activities -> actions aimed at results

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 44] In this way the living entity gets a suitable body with a material mind and senses, according to his fruitive activities. When the reaction of his particular activity comes to an end, that end is called death, and when a particular type of reaction begins, that beginning is called birth.

units.sanskrit:
देहेन जीवभूतेन लोकाल्लोकमनुव्रजन्। भुञ्जान एव कर्माणि करोत्यविरतं पुमान्॥ ३/३२/४५॥
जीवो यस्यानुगो देहो भूतेन्द्रियमनोमयः। तन्निरोधोऽस्य मरणमाविर्भावस्तु सम्भवः॥ ३/३२/४६॥
units.english: [Text 45-46] When the eyes lose their power to see color or form due to morbid affliction of the optic nerve, the sense of sight becomes deadened. The living being, who is the seer of both the eyes and the sight, loses his power of vision. In the same way, when the physical body, the place where perception of objects occurs, is rendered incapable of perceiving, that is known as death. When one begins to view the physical body as one’s very self, that is called birth.

units.sanskrit: द्रव्योपलब्धिस्थानस्य द्रव्येक्षाऽयोग्यता यदा। तत् पञ्चत्वमहम्मानादुत्पत्तिर्द्रव्यदर्शनम्॥ ३/३२/४७॥
units.english: [Text 47] Therefore, one should not view death with horror, nor have recourse to defining the body as soul, nor give way to exaggeration in enjoying the bodily necessities of life. Realizing the true nature of the living being, one should move about in the world free from attachment and steadfast in purpose.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 47] Therefore, one should not view death with horror, nor have recourse to defining the body as soul, nor give way to exaggeration in enjoying the bodily necessities of life. Realizing the true nature of the living entity, one should move about in the world free from attachment and steadfast in purpose.

units.sanskrit: यथाऽक्ष्णोर्द्रव्यावयवदर्शनायोग्यता यदा। तदैव चक्षुषो द्रष्टुर्द्रष्टृत्वं योग्यताऽनयोः॥ ३/३२/४८॥
units.english: [Text 48] Endowed with right vision and strengthened by devotion and a pessimistic attitude towards material identity, one should relegate his body to this illusory world through his reason. Thus one can be unconcerned with this material world.

parts.sanskrit: यथाऽक्ष्णोर्द्रव्यावयवदर्शनायोग्यता यदा। तदैव चक्षुषो द्रष्टुर्द्रष्टृत्वं योग्यताऽनयोः॥ ३/३२/४८॥
चक्षुःसकाशाद् द्रष्टुर्द्रष्टृत्वम् अक्ष्णोर्योग्यता॥ ४८॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 48] Endowed with right vision and strengthened by devotional service and a pessimistic attitude towards material identity, one should relegate his body to this illusory world through his reason. Thus one can be unconcerned with this material world.

units.sanskrit: पुंसो यथैवेन्द्रियाणि विन्दन्ति स्वगतं परम्। सुखं दुःखं नान्यगतं तथेशांशाः पृथक्कलाः॥ ३/३२/४९॥
आत्मनः केवलं ज्ञानमर्थो देहाद्यसङ्गिनः। सुखदुःखादयो भावा न देहस्य न चात्मनः॥ ३/३२/५०॥
तस्मान्न कार्यः सन्त्रासो न कार्पण्यं न सम्भ्रमः। बुद्ध्वा जीवगतिं धीरो मुक्तसङ्गश्चरेदिह॥ ३/३२/५१॥

parts.sanskrit: तस्मान्न कार्यः सन्त्रासो न कार्पण्यं न सम्भ्रमः। बुद्ध्वा जीवगतिं धीरो मुक्तसङ्गश्चरेदिह॥ ३/३२/५१॥
केवलं ज्ञानं पुरुषार्थः। देहादिष्वसङ्गिनो जीवस्य तन्निमित्तसुखदुःखादयो न सन्ति। किमुत देहस्य, अचेतनत्वात्॥ ५०॥

units.sanskrit: सम्यग्दर्शनया बुद्ध्या योगवैराग्ययुक्तया। मायाविरचिते लोके चरेद् यस्य कळेबरम्॥ ३/३२/५२॥

श्रीभगवानुवाच-
अथ यो गृहमेधीयान् धर्मानेवावसन् गृहे। धर्ममर्थं च कामं च दोग्धि भूयः पिपर्ति तान्॥ ३/३३/१॥
units.english: [Text 1] The Lord said: The person who lives in the center of household life derives material benefits by performing religious rituals, and thereby he fulfills his desire for economic development and sense enjoyment. Again and again he acts the same way.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 1] The Personality of Godhead said: The person who lives in the center of household life derives material benefits by performing religious rituals, and thereby he fulfills his desire for economic development and sense gratification. Again and again he acts the same way.

units.sanskrit: स चापि भगवद्धर्मात् काममूढः पराङ्मुखः। यजते क्रतुभिर्देवान् पितॄंश्च श्रद्धयाऽन्वितः॥ ३/३३/२॥
units.english: [Text 2] Such persons are ever bereft of devotion due to being too attached to sense enjoyment, and therefore, although they perform various kinds of sacrifices and take great vows to satisfy the gods and forefathers, they are not interested in Kṛṣṇa consciousness, devotion.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 2] Such persons are ever bereft of devotional service due to being too attached to sense gratification, and therefore, although they perform various kinds of sacrifices and take great vows to satisfy the demigods and forefathers, they are not interested in Kṛṣṇa consciousness, devotional service.

units.sanskrit: तच्छ्रद्धयाऽऽक्रान्तमतिः पितृदेवव्रतः पुमान्। गत्वा चान्द्रमसं लोकं सोमपाः पुनरेष्यति॥ ३/३३/३॥
units.english: [Text 3] Such materialistic persons, attracted by sense enjoyment and devoted to the forefathers and gods, can be elevated to the moon, where they drink an extract of the soma plant. They again return to this planet.

parts.sanskrit: तच्छ्रद्धयाऽऽक्रान्तमतिः पितृदेवव्रतः पुमान्। गत्वा चान्द्रमसं लोकं सोमपाः पुनरेष्यति॥ ३/३३/३॥

“ईषद्भक्तो भगवति सुकर्मा स्वर्गमेष्यति।
अभक्तो निरयं याति सुकर्माऽपि न संशयः॥”
इति वामने॥ ३॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 3] Such materialistic persons, attracted by sense gratification and devoted to the forefathers and demigods, can be elevated to the moon, where they drink an extract of the soma plant. They again return to this planet.

units.sanskrit: यदा चाहीन्द्रशय्यायां शेतेऽनन्तासनो हरिः। तदा लोका लयं यान्ति त एते गृहमेधिनाम्॥ ३/३३/४॥
units.english: [Text 4] All the planets of the materialistic persons, including all the heavenly planets, such as the moon, are vanquished when the Lord, Hari, goes to His bed of serpents, which is known as Ananta Śeṣa.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 4] All the planets of the materialistic persons, including all the heavenly planets, such as the moon, are vanquished when the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Hari, goes to His bed of serpents, which is known as Ananta Śeṣa.

units.sanskrit: ये च धर्मं न दुह्यन्ति धीराः कामार्थहेतवे। निस्सङ्गा न्यस्तकर्माणः प्रशान्ताः शुद्धचेतसः॥ ३/३३/५॥
units.english: [Text 5] Those who are intelligent and are of purified consciousness are completely satisfied in Kṛṣṇa consciousness. Freed from the modes of material nature, they do not act for sense enjoyment; rather, since they are situated in their own occupational duties, they act as one is expected to act.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 5] Those who are intelligent and are of purified consciousness are completely satisfied in Kṛṣṇa consciousness. Freed from the modes of material nature, they do not act for sense gratification; rather, since they are situated in their own occupational duties, they act as one is expected to act.

units.sanskrit: निवृत्तिधर्मनिरता निर्ममा निरहङ्कृताः। स्वधर्माख्येन सत्त्वेन परिशुद्धेन चेतसा॥ ३/३३/६॥
units.english: [Text 6] By executing one’s occupational duties, acting with detachment and without a sense of proprietorship or false egoism, one is posted in one’s constitutional position by dint of complete purification of consciousness, and by thus executing so-called material duties he can easily enter into the kingdom of God.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 6] By executing one’s occupational duties, acting with detachment and without a sense of proprietorship or false egoism, one is posted in one’s constitutional position by dint of complete purification of consciousness, and by thus executing so-called material duties he can easily enter into the kingdom of God.

units.sanskrit: सूर्यद्वारेण ते यान्ति पुरुषं विश्वतोमुखम्। परावरेशं प्रकृतिमस्योत्पत्त्यन्तभावनम्॥ ३/३३/७॥
units.english: [Text 7] Through the path of illumination, such liberated persons approach the complete the Lord, who is the proprietor of the material and spiritual worlds and is the supreme cause of their manifestation and dissolution.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 7] Through the path of illumination, such liberated persons approach the complete Personality of Godhead, who is the proprietor of the material and spiritual worlds and is the supreme cause of their manifestation and dissolution.

units.sanskrit: द्विपरार्धावसाने यः प्रळयो ब्रह्मणस्तु ते। तावदध्यासते लोके परस्य परिचिन्तकाः॥ ३/३३/८॥
units.english: [Text 8] Worshipers of the Hiraṇyagarbha expansion of the Lord remain within this material world until the end of two parārdhas, when Lord Brahmā also dies.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 8] Worshipers of the Hiraṇyagarbha expansion of the Personality of Godhead remain within this material world until the end of two parārdhas, when Lord Brahmā also dies.

units.sanskrit: क्ष्माम्भोनलानिलवियन्मनैन्द्रियार्थ- भूतादिभिः परिवृतः प्रतिसञ्जिधृक्षुः। अव्याकृतं विशति यर्हि गुणत्रयात्मा कालं परं स्वमनुभूय परः स्वयम्भूः॥ ३/३३/९॥
units.english: [Text 9] After experiencing the inhabitable time of the three modes of material nature, known as two parārdhas, Lord Brahmā closes the material universe, which is covered by layers of earth, water, air, fire, ether, mind, ego, etc., and goes back to Godhead.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 9] After experiencing the inhabitable time of the three modes of material nature, known as two parārdhas, Lord Brahmā closes the material universe, which is covered by layers of earth, water, air, fire, ether, mind, ego, etc., and goes back to Godhead.

units.sanskrit: एवं परेत्य भगवन्तमनुप्रविष्टा ये योगिनो जितमरुन्मनसो विरागाः। तेनैव साकममृतं पुरुषं पुराणं ब्रह्म प्रधानमुपयान्त्यगताभिमानाः॥ ३/३३/१०॥
units.english: [Text 10] The yogīs who become detached from the material world by practice of breathing exercises and control of the mind reach the planet of Brahmā, which is far, far away. After giving up their bodies, they enter into the body of Lord Brahmā, and therefore when Brahmā is liberated and goes to the Lord, who is the Supreme Brahman, such yogīs can also enter into the kingdom of God.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 10] The yogīs who become detached from the material world by practice of breathing exercises and control of the mind reach the planet of Brahmā, which is far, far away. units.sanskrit: आद्यः स्थिरचराणां यो वेदगर्भः सहर्षिभिः। योगेश्वरैः कुमाराद्यैः सिद्धैर्योगप्रवर्तकैः॥ ३/३३/११॥
units.english: [Text 11] Therefore, My dear mother, by devotion take direct shelter of the Lord, who is seated in everyone’s heart.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 11] Therefore, My dear mother, by devotional service take direct shelter of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is seated in everyone’s heart.

units.sanskrit:
भेददृष्ट्याऽभिमानेन निःसङ्गेनापि कर्मणा। कर्तृत्वात् सगुणं ब्रह्म पुरुषं पुरुषर्षभम्॥ ३/३३/१२॥
स सङ्गत्य पुनः काले कालेनेश्वरमूर्तिना। जातेऽगुणव्यतिकरे यथापूर्वं प्रजायते॥ ३/३३/१३॥
ऐश्वर्यं पारमेष्ठ्यं यत् तेऽपि धर्मविनिर्मितम्। निषेव्य पुनरायान्ति गुणव्यतिकरेऽसति॥ ३/३३/१४॥
अथ तं सर्वभूतानां हृत्पदमेषु कृतालयम्। श्रुतानुभावं शरणं व्रज भावेन भामिनि॥ ३/३३/१५॥
units.english: [Text 12-15] My dear mother, someone may worship the Lord with a special self-interest, but even gods such as Lord Brahmā, great sages such as Sanat-kumāra and great munis such as Marīci have to come back to the material world again at the time of creation. When the interaction of the three modes of material nature begins, Brahmā, who is the creator of this cosmic manifestation and who is full of Vedic knowledge, and the great sages, who are the authors of the spiritual path and the yoga system, come back under the influence of the time factor. They are liberated by their nonfruitive activities and attain the first incarnation of the puruṣa, but at the time of creation they come back in exactly the same forms and positions they previously had.

अभिमानेन पूर्णज्ञानेन॥ १२॥
सङ्गत्य लये परमेश्वरं प्रविश्य।
यथापूर्वं प्रजायते उच्चनीचादिभावेन जायते। अगुणव्यतिकरे बहिः श्वेतद्वीपे निर्गच्छति।

गुणव्यतिकरे असति।
प्रलये प्राप्ते पुनः परमेश्वरमायान्ति।
“ब्रह्मा देवैः परिवृतः प्रलये परमेश्वरम्।
प्रविश्य सर्गे तु पुनः श्वेतद्वीपे प्रमोदते।
ज्ञानधर्मफलांस्तत्र भोगान् भुक्त्वा लये पुनः।
नारायणं समाविश्य ज्ञानव्यक्तं निजं सुखम्।
भुञ्जते त्वेवमेवैषां काले संसर्गनिर्गमौ।
नित्यौ नित्यसुखं चैव सृष्टौ भोगास्तथोत्तमाः।
गुणव्यतिकराभावेप्युच्चनीचादि पूर्ववत्।
विष्णोश्चैव विमुक्तानां न कदाचन गच्छति॥”
इति गारुडे।
“यथापूर्वं हरेः सर्वगुणैर्नीचोच्चता तथा।
ब्रह्मणश्च तथाऽन्येषामन्येषां च यथापदम्॥”
इति स्कान्दे॥ १३-१४॥

units.sanskrit: ये त्विहासक्तमनसः कर्मसु श्रद्धयाऽन्विताः। कुर्वन्त्यप्रतिषिद्धानि नित्यान्यपि च कृत्स्नशः॥ ३/३३/१६॥
units.english: [Text 16] Persons who are too addicted to this material world execute their prescribed duties very nicely and with great faith. They daily perform all such prescribed duties with attachment to the fruitive result.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 16] Persons who are too addicted to this material world execute their prescribed duties very nicely and with great faith. They daily perform all such prescribed duties with attachment to the fruitive result.

units.sanskrit: रजसा कुण्ठमनसः कामात्मनोऽजितेन्द्रियाः। पितॄन् यजन्त्यनुदिनं गृहेष्वभिरताशयाः॥ ३/३३/१७॥
units.english: [Text 17] Such persons, impelled by the mode of passion, are full of anxieties and always aspire for sense enjoyment due to uncontrolled senses. They worship the forefathers and are busy day and night improving the economic condition of their family, social or national life.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 17] Such persons, impelled by the mode of passion, are full of anxieties and always aspire for sense gratification due to uncontrolled senses. They worship the forefathers and are busy day and night improving the economic condition of their family, social or national life.

units.sanskrit: त्रैवर्गिकास्ते पुरुषा विमुखा हरिमेधसः। कथायां कथनीयोरुविक्रमस्य मधुद्विषः॥ ३/३३/१८॥
units.english: [Text 18] Such persons are called trai-vargika because they are interested in the three elevating processes. They are averse to the Lord, who can give relief to the conditioned soul. They are not interested in the Supreme Personality’s pastimes, which are worth hearing because of His transcendental prowess.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 18] Such persons are called trai-vargika because they are interested in the three elevating processes. units.sanskrit: नूनं दैवेन विहता येत्वच्युतकथासुधाम्। हित्वा शृण्वन्त्यसद्गाथाः पुरीषमिव विड्भुजः॥ ३/३३/१९॥
units.english: [Text 19] Such persons are condemned by the supreme order of the Lord. Because they are averse to the nectar of the activities of the Lord, they are compared to stool-eating hogs. They give up hearing the transcendental activities of the Lord and indulge in hearing of the abominable activities of materialistic persons.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 19] Such persons are condemned by the supreme order of the Lord. units.sanskrit: दक्षिणेन पथाऽर्यम्णः पितृलोकं व्रजन्ति ते। प्रजायां तु प्रजायन्ते श्मशानान्तक्रियाकृतः॥ ३/३३/२०॥
units.english: [Text 20] Such materialistic persons are allowed to go to the planet called Pitṛloka by the southern course of the sun, but they again come back to this planet and take birth in their own families, beginning again the same actions aimed at results from birth to the end of life.

english_edits.rule: fruitive activities -> actions aimed at results

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 20] Such materialistic persons are allowed to go to the planet called Pitṛloka by the southern course of the sun, but they again come back to this planet and take birth in their own families, beginning again the same fruitive activities from birth to the end of life.

units.sanskrit: ततस्ते क्षीणसुकृताः पुनर्लोकमिमं सति। पतन्ति विवशा देवैः सद्यो विभ्रंशितोदयाः॥ ३/३३/२१॥
units.english: [Text 21] When the results of their pious activities are exhausted, they fall down by higher arrangement and again come back to this planet, just as any person raised to a high position sometimes all of a sudden falls.

parts.sanskrit: ततस्ते क्षीणसुकृताः पुनर्लोकमिमं सति। पतन्ति विवशा देवैः सद्यो विभ्रंशितोदयाः॥ ३/३३/२१॥

“अत्यल्पभक्ता विष्णौ च सदा श्राद्धादिकारिणः।
पितृलोकं समाविश्य स्वसन्ताने पुनःपुनः।
क्षिप्रमेव प्रजायन्ते ये तु भक्तिविवर्जिताः।
अन्यसामान्यवेत्तारस्तदन्योत्तमवेदिनः।
तद्भक्तनिन्दकाश्चैव यान्त्येव निरयं ध्रुवम्।
अपि धर्मैकनियमा नात्र कार्या विचारणा॥”
इति च।
“मुक्तियोग्यास्तु देवाद्या मानुषा यज्ञभोगिनः।
मनुष्यभेदाः श्राद्धादिकृतो विद्वेषिणोऽसुराः॥”
इति च॥ १६-२१॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 21] When the results of their pious activities are exhausted, they fall down by higher arrangement and again come back to this planet, just as any person raised to a high position sometimes all of a sudden falls.

units.sanskrit: तस्मात् त्वं सर्वभावेन भजस्व परमेष्ठिनम्। तद्गुणाश्रयया भक्त्या भजनीयपदाम्बुजम्॥ ३/३३/२२॥
units.english: [Text 22] My dear mother, I therefore advise that you take shelter of the Lord, for His lotus feet are worth worshiping. Accept this with all devotion and love, for thus you can be situated in transcendental devotion.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 22] My dear mother, I therefore advise that you take shelter of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, for His lotus feet are worth worshiping. Accept this with all devotion and love, for thus you can be situated in transcendental devotional service.

units.sanskrit: वासुदेवे भगवति भक्तियोगः प्रचोदितः। जनयत्याशु वैराग्यं ज्ञानं यद् ब्रह्मदर्शनम्॥ ३/३३/२३॥
units.english: [Text 23] Engagement in Kṛṣṇa consciousness and application of devotion unto Kṛṣṇa make it possible to advance in knowledge and detachment, as well as in self-realization.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 23] Engagement in Kṛṣṇa consciousness and application of devotional service unto Kṛṣṇa make it possible to advance in knowledge and detachment, as well as in self-realization.

units.sanskrit: यदाऽस्य चित्तमर्थेषु समेष्विन्द्रियवृत्तिभिः। न विगृह्णन्ति वैषम्यं प्रियमप्रियमप्युत॥ ३/३३/२४॥
units.english: [Text 24] The exalted devotee’s mind becomes equipoised in sensory activities, and he is transcendental to that which is agreeable and not agreeable.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 24] The exalted devotee’s mind becomes equipoised in sensory activities, and he is transcendental to that which is agreeable and not agreeable.

units.sanskrit: स तदैवात्मनाऽऽत्मानं निःसङ्गं समदर्शिनम्। हेयोपादेयरहितमारूढपदमीक्षते॥ ३/३३/२५॥
units.english: [Text 25] Because of his transcendental intelligence, the devotee is equipoised in his vision and sees himself to be uncontaminated by matter. He does not see anything as superior or inferior, and he feels himself elevated to the transcendental platform of being equal in qualities with the Supreme Person.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 25] Because of his transcendental intelligence, the pure devotee is equipoised in his vision and sees himself to be uncontaminated by matter. He does not see anything as superior or inferior, and he feels himself elevated to the transcendental platform of being equal in qualities with the Supreme Person.

units.sanskrit: ज्ञानमात्रं परम्ब्रह्म परमात्मेश्वरः पुमान्। दृश्यादिभिः पृथग्भावैर्भगवानेक ईयते॥ ३/३३/२६॥
units.english: [Text 26] The Lord alone is complete transcendental knowledge, but according to the different processes of understanding He appears differently, either as impersonal Brahman, as Paramātmā, as the Lord or as the puruṣa-avatāra.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 26] The Supreme Personality of Godhead alone is complete transcendental knowledge, but according to the different processes of understanding He appears differently, either as impersonal Brahman, as Paramātmā, as the Supreme Personality of Godhead or as the puruṣa-avatāra.

units.sanskrit: एतावानेव योगेन समग्रेणेह योगिनः। युज्यतेऽभिमतो ह्यर्थो यदसङ्गस्तु कृत्स्नशः॥ ३/३३/२७॥
units.english: [Text 27] The greatest common understanding for all yogīs is complete detachment from matter, which can be achieved by different kinds of yoga.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 27] The greatest common understanding for all yogīs is complete detachment from matter, which can be achieved by different kinds of yoga.

units.sanskrit: ज्ञानमेकं पराचीनैरिन्द्रियैर्ब्रह्म निर्गुणम्। अवभात्यर्थरूपेण भ्रान्त्या शब्दादिधर्मिणाम्॥ ३/३३/२८॥
units.english: [Text 28] Those who are averse to the Transcendence realize the Supreme Absolute Truth differently through speculative sense perception, and therefore, because of mistaken speculation, everything appears to them to be relative.

parts.sanskrit: ज्ञानमेकं पराचीनैरिन्द्रियैर्ब्रह्म निर्गुणम्। अवभात्यर्थरूपेण भ्रान्त्या शब्दादिधर्मिणाम्॥ ३/३३/२८॥

“मत्स्यकूर्मादिरूपं च विष्णोर्ज्ञानैकमात्रकम्।
तन्मन्यन्ते भौतिकं तु ये गच्छन्त्यधरं तमः॥”
इति ब्राह्मे॥ २८॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 28] Those who are averse to the Transcendence realize the Supreme Absolute Truth differently through speculative sense perception, and therefore, because of mistaken speculation, everything appears to them to be relative.

units.sanskrit: यथा महानहङ्कारस्त्रिवृत् पञ्चविधः स्वराट्। एकादशविधस्तस्य वपुरण्डं जगद् यतः॥ ३/३३/२९॥
units.english: [Text 29] From the total energy, the mahat-tattva, I have manifested the false ego, the three modes of material nature, the five material elements, the individual consciousness, the eleven senses and the material body. Similarly, the entire universe has come from the Lord.

parts.sanskrit: यथा महानहङ्कारस्त्रिवृत् पञ्चविधः स्वराट्। एकादशविधस्तस्य वपुरण्डं जगद् यतः॥ ३/३३/२९॥

“एकादशेन्द्रियात्मा च पञ्चभूतात्मकस्तथा।
सर्वाभिमानी भगवान् स्वराडिन्द्रः पुरन्दरः।
इदमण्डं जगत् सर्वं शक्रदेहं विदुर्बुधाः।
तत्पतिस्त्रिगुणो रुद्रस्तस्य ब्रह्मा ततो हरिः॥”
इति वामने।
यथैतान् पश्यन्ति तद्वदेव ज्ञानात्मकं मत्स्यादिरूपं पश्यन्त्यज्ञाः॥ २९॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 29] From the total energy, the mahat-tattva, I have manifested the false ego, the three modes of material nature, the five material elements, the individual consciousness, the eleven senses and the material body. Similarly, the entire universe has come from the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

units.sanskrit: एतद् वै श्रद्धया भक्त्या योगाभ्यासेन नित्यशः। समाहितात्मा निःसङ्गो विरक्तः परिपश्यति॥ ३/३३/३०॥
units.english: [Text 30] This perfect knowledge can be achieved by a person who is already engaged in devotion with faith, steadiness and full detachment, and who is always absorbed in thought of the Supreme. He is aloof from material association.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 30] This perfect knowledge can be achieved by a person who is already engaged in devotional service with faith, steadiness and full detachment, and who is always absorbed in thought of the Supreme. He is aloof from material association.

units.sanskrit: इत्येतत् कथितं गुह्यं ज्ञानं ते ब्रह्मदर्शनम्। येनैव बुध्यते तत्त्वं प्रकृतेः पुरुषस्य च॥ ३/३३/३१॥
units.english: [Text 31] My dear respectful mother, I have already described the path of understanding the Absolute Truth, by which one can come to understand the real truth of matter and spirit and their relationship.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 31] My dear respectful mother, I have already described the path of understanding the Absolute Truth, by which one can come to understand the real truth of matter and spirit and their relationship.

units.sanskrit: ज्ञानं योगश्च मन्निष्ठो नैर्गुण्यो भक्तिलक्षणः। द्वयोरप्येक एवार्थो भगवच्छब्दलक्षणः॥ ३/३३/३२॥
units.english: [Text 32] Philosophical research culminates in understanding the Lord. After achieving this understanding, when one becomes free from the material modes of nature, he attains the stage of devotion. Either by devotion directly or by philosophical research, one has to find the same destination, which is the Lord.

parts.sanskrit: ज्ञानं योगश्च मन्निष्ठो नैर्गुण्यो भक्तिलक्षणः। द्वयोरप्येक एवार्थो भगवच्छब्दलक्षणः॥ ३/३३/३२॥

“ज्ञानभक्ती विना नैव मुक्तिः कस्यापि विद्यते।
तयोरेकतरेणापि विष्णुगेनोभयं विना।
एवमप्येतयोरेकभावेऽन्यनियतेर्ध्रुवम्।
एकेनापि भवेन्मुक्तिस्तदर्थं त्वन्यसाधनम्॥”
इति हरिवंशेषु॥ ३२॥

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 32] Philosophical research culminates in understanding the Supreme Personality of Godhead. After achieving this understanding, when one becomes free from the material modes of nature, he attains the stage of devotional service. Either by devotional service directly or by philosophical research, one has to find the same destination, which is the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

units.sanskrit: यथेन्द्रियैः पृथग्द्वारैरर्थो बहुगुणाश्रयः। एको नानेयते तद्वद् भगवाञ्छास्त्रवर्त्मभिः॥ ३/३३/३३॥
units.english: [Text 33] A single object is appreciated differently by different senses due to its having different qualities. Similarly, the Lord is one, but according to different scriptural injunctions He appears to be different.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 33] A single object is appreciated differently by different senses due to its having different qualities. Similarly, the Supreme Personality of Godhead is one, but according to different scriptural injunctions He appears to be different.

units.sanskrit:
क्रियया क्रतुभिर्दानैस्तपःस्वाध्यायदर्शनैः। आत्मेन्द्रियजयेनापि सन्न्यासेन च कर्मणाम्॥ ३/३३/३४॥
योगेन विविधांशेन भक्तियोगेन चैव हि। धर्मेणोभयचिह्नेन यः प्रवृत्तिनिवृत्तिमान्॥ ३/३३/३५॥
आत्मतत्त्वावबोधेन वैराग्येण दृढेन च। ईयते भगवानेभिः सगुणो निर्गुणः स्वदृक्॥ ३/३३/३६॥
units.english: [Text 34-36] By performing actions aimed at results and sacrifices, by distributing charity, by performing austerities, by studying various literatures, by conducting philosophical research, by controlling the mind, by subduing the senses, by accepting the renounced order of life, by performing the prescribed duties of one’s social order, by performing the different divisions of yoga practice, by performing devotion, by exhibiting the process of devotion containing the symptoms of both attachment and detachment, by understanding the science of self-realization, and by developing a strong sense of detachment, one who is expert in understanding the different processes of self-realization realizes the Lord as He is represented in the material world as well as in transcendence.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord
fruitive activities -> actions aimed at results

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 34-36] By performing fruitive activities and sacrifices, by distributing charity, by performing austerities, by studying various literatures, by conducting philosophical research, by controlling the mind, by subduing the senses, by accepting the renounced order of life, by performing the prescribed duties of one’s social order, by performing the different divisions of yoga practice, by performing devotional service, by exhibiting the process of devotional service containing the symptoms of both attachment and detachment, by understanding the science of self-realization, and by developing a strong sense of detachment, one who is expert in understanding the different processes of self-realization realizes the Supreme Personality of Godhead as He is represented in the material world as well as in transcendence.

units.sanskrit: प्रावोचं भक्तियोगस्य स्वरूपं ते चतुर्विधम्। कालस्य चाव्यक्तगतेर्योऽन्तर्धावति जन्तुषु॥ ३/३३/३७॥
units.english: [Text 37] My dear mother, I have explained to you the process of devotion and its identity in four different social divisions. I have explained to you as well how eternal time is chasing the living beings, although it is imperceptible to them.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 37] My dear mother, I have explained to you the process of devotional service and its identity in four different social divisions. I have explained to you as well how eternal time is chasing the living entities, although it is imperceptible to them.

units.sanskrit: जीवस्य संसृतीर्बह्वीरविद्याकर्मनिर्मिताः। याः स्वयं प्रविशन्नात्मा न वेद गतिमात्मनः॥ ३/३३/३८॥
units.english: [Text 38] There are varieties of material existence for the living being according to the work he performs in ignorance or forgetfulness of his real identity. My dear mother, if anyone enters into that forgetfulness, he is unable to understand where his movements will end.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 38] There are varieties of material existence for the living entity according to the work he performs in ignorance or forgetfulness of his real identity. My dear mother, if anyone enters into that forgetfulness, he is unable to understand where his movements will end.

units.sanskrit: नैतत् खलायोपदिशेन्नाविनीताय कर्हिचित्। न स्तब्धाय न भिन्नाय नैव धर्मध्वजाय च॥ ३/३३/३९॥
units.english: [Text 39] Lord Kapila continued: This instruction is not meant for the envious, for the agnostics or for persons who are unclean in their behavior. Nor is it for hypocrites or for persons who are proud of material possessions.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 39] Lord Kapila continued: This instruction is not meant for the envious, for the agnostics or for persons who are unclean in their behavior. Nor is it for hypocrites or for persons who are proud of material possessions.

units.sanskrit: न लोलुपायोपदिशेन्न गृहारूढचेतसे। नाभक्ताय च मे जातु न मद्भक्तद्विषामपि॥ ३/३३/४०॥
units.english: [Text 40] It is not to be instructed to persons who are too greedy and too attached to family life, nor to persons who are nondevotees and who are envious of the devotees and of the Lord.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 40] It is not to be instructed to persons who are too greedy and too attached to family life, nor to persons who are nondevotees and who are envious of the devotees and of the Personality of Godhead.

units.sanskrit: श्रद्दधानाय भक्ताय विनीतायानसूयवे। भूतेषु कृतमैत्राय शुश्रूषाभिरताय च॥ ३/३३/४१॥
units.english: [Text 41] Instruction should be given to the faithful devotee who is respectful to the teacher, nonenvious, friendly to all kinds of living beings and eager to render service with faith and sincerity.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 41] Instruction should be given to the faithful devotee who is respectful to the spiritual master, nonenvious, friendly to all kinds of living entities and eager to render service with faith and sincerity.

units.sanskrit: बहिर्जातविरागाय शान्तचित्ताय दीयते। निर्मत्सराय शुचये यस्याहं प्रेयसां प्रियः॥ ३/३३/४२॥
units.english: [Text 42] This instruction should be imparted by the teacher to persons who have taken the Lord to be more dear than anything, who are not envious of anyone, who are perfectly cleansed and who have developed detachment for that which is outside the purview of Kṛṣṇa consciousness.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 42] This instruction should be imparted by the spiritual master to persons who have taken the Supreme Personality of Godhead to be more dear than anything, who are not envious of anyone, who are perfectly cleansed and who have developed detachment for that which is outside the purview of Kṛṣṇa consciousness.

units.sanskrit: य इदं शृणुयादम्ब श्रद्धया पुरुषः सकृत्। यो वाऽभिधत्ते मच्चित्तः स ह्येति पदवीं मम॥ ३/३३/४३॥
units.english: [Text 43] Anyone who once meditates upon Me with faith and affection, who hears and chants about Me, surely goes back home, back to Godhead.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 43] Anyone who once meditates upon Me with faith and affection, who hears and chants about Me, surely goes back home, back to Godhead.

units.sanskrit:
मैत्रेय उवाच-
एवं निशम्य कपिलस्य वचो जनित्री सा कर्दमस्य दयिता किल देवहूतिः। विस्रस्तमोहपटला तमभिप्रणम्य तुष्टाव तत्त्वविषयाखिलसिद्धभूमिम्॥ ३/३४/१॥
units.english: [Text 1] Maitreya said: Thus Devahūti, the mother of Lord Kapila and wife of Kardama Muni, became freed from all ignorance concerning devotion and transcendental knowledge. She offered her obeisances unto the Lord, the author of the basic principles of the Sāṅkhya system of philosophy, which is the background of liberation, and she satisfied Him with the following verses of prayer.

english_edits.rule: honorific Śrī before a name removed

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 1] Śrī Maitreya said: Thus Devahūti, the mother of Lord Kapila and wife of Kardama Muni, became freed from all ignorance concerning devotional service and transcendental knowledge. She offered her obeisances unto the Lord, the author of the basic principles of the Sāṅkhya system of philosophy, which is the background of liberation, and she satisfied Him with the following verses of prayer.

units.sanskrit:
देवहूतिरुवाच-
अथाप्ययान्ते सलिले शयानं भूतेन्द्रियार्थात्ममयं वपुस्ते। गुणप्रवाहं सदशेषबीजं दध्यौ स्वयं यज्जठराब्जजातः॥ ३/३४/२॥
units.english: [Text 2] Devahūti said: Brahmā is said to be unborn because he takes birth from the lotus flower which grows from Your abdomen while You lie in the ocean at the bottom of the universe. But even Brahmā simply meditated upon You, whose body is the source of unlimited universes.

parts.sanskrit:
देवहूतिरुवाच-
अथाप्ययान्ते सलिले शयानं भूतेन्द्रियार्थात्ममयं वपुस्ते। गुणप्रवाहं सदशेषबीजं दध्यौ स्वयं यज्जठराब्जजातः॥ ३/३४/२॥

भूतेन्द्रियार्थात्ममयं तेभ्यः प्रधानम्।
“त्वं प्रधानमयो देव प्रधानादधिको यतः”
इति वाराहे॥ २॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 2] Devahūti said: Brahmā is said to be unborn because he takes birth from the lotus flower which grows from Your abdomen while You lie in the ocean at the bottom of the universe. But even Brahmā simply meditated upon You, whose body is the source of unlimited universes.

units.sanskrit: स एव विश्वस्य भवान् विधत्ते गुणप्रवाहेषु विभक्तवीर्यः। सर्गाद्यनीहोऽवितथाभिसन्धिरात्मेश्वरोऽतर्क्यसहस्रशक्तिः॥ ३/३४/३॥
units.english: [Text 3] My dear Lord, although personally You have nothing to do, You have distributed Your energies in the interactions of the material modes of nature, and for that reason the creation, maintenance and dissolution of the cosmic manifestation take place. My dear Lord, You are self-determined and are the Lord for all living beings. For them You created this material manifestation, and although You are one, Your diverse energies can act multifariously. This is inconceivable to us.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 3] My dear Lord, although personally You have nothing to do, You have distributed Your energies in the interactions of the material modes of nature, and for that reason the creation, maintenance and dissolution of the cosmic manifestation take place. My dear Lord, You are self-determined and are the Supreme Personality of Godhead for all living entities. For them You created this material manifestation, and although You are one, Your diverse energies can act multifariously. This is inconceivable to us.

units.sanskrit: स त्वं भृतो मे जठरेण नाथ कथं नु यस्योदर एतदासीत्। विश्वं युगान्ते वटपत्र एकः शेते स्म मायाशिशुरङ्घ्रिपानः॥ ३/३४/४॥
units.english: [Text 4] As the Lord, You have taken birth from my abdomen. O my Lord, how is that possible for the supreme one, who has in His belly all the cosmic manifestation? The answer is that it is possible, for at the end of the millennium You lie down on a leaf of a banyan tree, and just like a small baby, You lick the toe of Your lotus foot.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 4] As the Supreme Personality of Godhead, You have taken birth from my abdomen. units.sanskrit: त्वं देहतन्त्रः प्रशमाय पाप्मनां निदेशभाजां च विभो विभूतये। यथावतारास्तव सूकरादयस्तथाऽयमप्यात्मपथोलब्धये॥ ३/३४/५॥
units.english: [Text 5] My dear Lord, You have assumed this body in order to diminish the sinful activities of the fallen and to enrich their knowledge in devotion and liberation. Since these sinful people are dependent on Your direction, by Your own will You assume incarnations as a boar and as other forms. Similarly, You have appeared in order to distribute transcendental knowledge to Your dependents.

parts.sanskrit: त्वं देहतन्त्रः प्रशमाय पाप्मनां निदेशभाजां च विभो विभूतये। यथावतारास्तव सूकरादयस्तथाऽयमप्यात्मपथोलब्धये॥ ३/३४/५॥

देहतन्त्रः देहप्रकाशः।
“ततिः प्रकाशो विस्तारस्तन्त्रं चेत्यभिधीयते”
इति तन्त्रमालायाम्॥ ५॥

Similarly, You have appeared in order to distribute transcendental knowledge to Your dependents.

units.sanskrit: यन्नामधेयश्रवणानुकार्तनाद् यत्प्रह्वणाद् यत्स्मरणादपि क्वचित्। श्वादोऽपि सद्यः सवनाय कल्पते कुतः पुनस्ते भगवन् नु दर्शनात्॥ ३/३४/६॥
units.english: [Text 6] To say nothing of the spiritual advancement of persons who see the Supreme Person face to face, even a person born in a family of dog-eaters immediately becomes eligible to perform Vedic sacrifices if he once utters the holy name of the Lord or chants about Him, hears about His pastimes, offers Him obeisances or even remembers Him.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 6] To say nothing of the spiritual advancement of persons who see the Supreme Person face to face, even a person born in a family of dog-eaters immediately becomes eligible to perform Vedic sacrifices if he once utters the holy name of the Supreme Personality of Godhead or chants about Him, hears about His pastimes, offers Him obeisances or even remembers Him.

units.sanskrit: अहो बत श्वपचोऽतो गरीयान् यज्जिह्वाग्रे वर्तते नाम तुभ्यम्। तेपुस्तपस्ते जुहुवुः सुराद्यान् ब्रह्मानूचुर्नाम गृणन्ति ये ते॥ ३/३४/७॥
units.english: [Text 7] Oh, how glorious are they whose tongues are chanting Your holy name! Even if born in the families of dog-eaters, such persons are worshipable. Persons who chant the holy name of Your Lordship must have executed all kinds of austerities and fire sacrifices and achieved all the good manners of the Āryans. To be chanting the holy name of Your Lordship, they must have bathed at holy places of pilgrimage, studied the Vedas and fulfilled everything required.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 7] Oh, how glorious are they whose tongues are chanting Your holy name! Even if born in the families of dog-eaters, such persons are worshipable. units.sanskrit: तं त्वाऽद्धाऽहं ब्रह्म परं पुमांसं प्रत्यक्स्रोतस्यात्मनि संविभाव्यम्। स्वतेजसा ध्वस्तगुणप्रवाहं वन्दे विष्णुं कपिलं वेदगर्भम्॥ ३/३४/८॥
units.english: [Text 8] I believe, my Lord, that You are Lord Viṣṇu Himself under the name of Kapila, and You are the Lord, the Supreme Brahman! The saints and sages, being freed from all the disturbances of the senses and mind, meditate upon You, for by Your mercy only can one become free from the clutches of the three modes of material nature. At the time of dissolution, all the Vedas are sustained in You only.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 8] I believe, my Lord, that You are Lord Viṣṇu Himself under the name of Kapila, and You are the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the Supreme Brahman! The saints and sages, being freed from all the disturbances of the senses and mind, meditate upon You, for by Your mercy only can one become free from the clutches of the three modes of material nature. At the time of dissolution, all the Vedas are sustained in You only.

units.sanskrit:
मैत्रेय उवाच-
ईडितो भगवानेवं कपिलाख्यः परः पुमान्। वाचाऽविक्ल्बयेत्याह मातरं मातृवत्सलः॥ ३/३४/९॥
units.english: [Text 9] Thus the Lord Kapila, satisfied by the words of His mother, towards whom He was very affectionate, replied with gravity.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 9] Thus the Supreme Personality of Godhead Kapila, satisfied by the words of His mother, towards whom He was very affectionate, replied with gravity.

units.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच-
मार्गेणानेन मातस्ते सुसेव्येनोदितेन मे। आस्थितेन परां काष्ठामचिरादवरोत्स्यसि॥ ३/३४/१०॥
units.english: [Text 10] The Lord said: My dear mother, the path of self-realization which I have already instructed to you is very easy. You can execute this system without difficulty, and by following it you shall very soon be liberated, even within your present body.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 10] The Personality of Godhead said: My dear mother, the path of self-realization which I have already instructed to you is very easy. You can execute this system without difficulty, and by following it you shall very soon be liberated, even within your present body.

units.sanskrit: श्रद्धत्स्वैतन्मतं मह्यं जुष्टं यद् ब्रह्मवादिभिः। येन मामभयं यायान्मृत्युमृच्छन्त्यतद्विदः॥ ३/३४/११॥
units.english: [Text 11] My dear mother, those who are actually transcendentalists certainly follow My instructions as I have given them to you. You may rest assured that if you traverse this path of self-realization perfectly, surely you shall be freed from fearful material contamination and shall ultimately reach Me. Mother, persons who are not conversant with this method of devotion certainly cannot get out of the cycle of birth and death.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 11] My dear mother, those who are actually transcendentalists certainly follow My instructions as I have given them to you. You may rest assured that if you traverse this path of self-realization perfectly, surely you shall be freed from fearful material contamination and shall ultimately reach Me. Mother, persons who are not conversant with this method of devotional service certainly cannot get out of the cycle of birth and death.

units.sanskrit:
मैत्रेय उवाच-
इति प्रदर्श्य भगवानुशतीमात्मनो गतिम्। स्वमात्रा ब्रह्मवादिन्या कपिलोऽनुमतो ययौ॥ ३/३४/१२॥
units.english: [Text 12] Maitreya said: The Lord Kapila, after instructing His beloved mother, took permission from her and left His home, His mission having been fulfilled.

english_edits.rule: honorific Śrī before a name removed
(the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 12] Śrī Maitreya said: The Supreme Personality of Godhead Kapila, after instructing His beloved mother, took permission from her and left His home, His mission having been fulfilled.

units.sanskrit: सा चापि तनयोक्तेन योगादेशेन योगयुक्। तस्मिन्नाश्रम आसीना सरस्वत्याः समाहिता॥ ३/३४/१३॥
units.english: [Text 13] As instructed by her son, Devahūti also began to practice bhakti-yoga in that very āśrama. She practiced samādhi in the house of Kardama Muni, which was so beautifully decorated with flowers that it was considered the flower crown of the river Sarasvatī.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 13] As instructed by her son, Devahūti also began to practice bhakti-yoga in that very āśrama. She practiced samādhi in the house of Kardama Muni, which was so beautifully decorated with flowers that it was considered the flower crown of the river Sarasvatī.

units.sanskrit: अभीक्ष्णावगाहकपिशान् जटिलान् कुटिलाळकान्। आत्मानं चोग्रतपसा बिभ्रती चीरिणं कृशम्॥ ३/३४/१४॥
units.english: [Text 14] She began to bathe three times daily, and thus her curling black hair gradually became gray. Due to austerity, her body gradually became thin, and she wore old garments.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 14] She began to bathe three times daily, and thus her curling black hair gradually became gray. Due to austerity, her body gradually became thin, and she wore old garments.

units.sanskrit: प्रजापतेः कर्दमस्य तपोयोगविजृम्भितम्। स्वगार्हस्थ्यमनौपम्यं प्रार्थ्यं वैमानिकैरपि॥ ३/३४/१५॥
units.english: [Text 15] The home and household paraphernalia of Kardama, who was one of the Prajāpatis, was developed in such a way, by dint of his mystic powers of austerity and yoga, that his opulence was sometimes envied by those who travel in outer space in airplanes.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 15] The home and household paraphernalia of Kardama, who was one of the Prajāpatis, was developed in such a way, by dint of his mystic powers of austerity and yoga, that his opulence was sometimes envied by those who travel in outer space in airplanes.

units.sanskrit: पयःफेननिभाः शय्या दान्ता रुग्मपरिच्छदाः। आसनानि च हैमानि सुस्पर्शास्तरणानि च॥ ३/३४/१६॥
units.english: [Text 16] The opulence of the household of Kardama Muni is described herein. The bedsheets and mattresses were all as white as the foam of milk, the chairs and benches were made of ivory and were covered by cloths of lace with golden filigree, and the couches were made of gold and had very soft pillows.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 16] The opulence of the household of Kardama Muni is described herein. The bedsheets and mattresses were all as white as the foam of milk, the chairs and benches were made of ivory and were covered by cloths of lace with golden filigree, and the couches were made of gold and had very soft pillows.

units.sanskrit: स्वच्छस्फटिककुड्येषु महामारतकेषु च। रत्नादीपार्चिषो भान्ति ललनारत्नासंयुताः॥ ३/३४/१७॥
units.english: [Text 17] The walls of the house were made of first-class marble, decorated with valuable jewels. There was no need of light, for the household was illuminated by the rays of these jewels. The female members of the household were all amply decorated with jewelry.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 17] The walls of the house were made of first-class marble, decorated with valuable jewels. There was no need of light, for the household was illuminated by the rays of these jewels. The female members of the household were all amply decorated with jewelry.

units.sanskrit: गृहोद्यानं कुसुमितै रम्यं बह्वमरद्रुमैः। कूजद्विहङ्गमिथुनं गायन्मत्तमधुव्रतम्॥ ३/३४/१८॥
units.english: [Text 18] The compound of the main household was surrounded by beautiful gardens with sweet, fragrant flowers and many trees which produced fresh fruit and were tall and beautiful. The attraction of such gardens was that singing birds would sit on the trees, and their chanting voices, as well as the humming sound of the bees, made the whole atmosphere as pleasing as possible.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 18] The compound of the main household was surrounded by beautiful gardens with sweet, fragrant flowers and many trees which produced fresh fruit and were tall and beautiful. units.sanskrit: यत्र प्रविष्टमात्मानं विबुधानुचरा जगुः। वाप्यामुत्पलगन्धिन्यां कर्दमेनोपलाळितम्॥ ३/३४/१९॥
units.english: [Text 19] When Devahūti would enter that lovely garden to take her bath in the pond filled with lotus flowers, the associates of the denizens of heaven, the Gandharvas, would sing about Kardama’s glorious household life. Her great husband, Kardama, gave her all protection at all times.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 19] When Devahūti would enter that lovely garden to take her bath in the pond filled with lotus flowers, the associates of the denizens of heaven, the Gandharvas, would sing about Kardama’s glorious household life. Her great husband, Kardama, gave her all protection at all times.

units.sanskrit: हित्वा तदीप्सिततमप्याखण्डलयोषिताम्। किञ्चिच्चकार वदनं पुत्रविश्लेषणातुरा॥ ३/३४/२०॥
units.english: [Text 20] Although her position was unique from all points of view, saintly Devahūti, in spite of all her possessions, which were envied even by the ladies of the heavenly planets, gave up all such comforts. She was only sorry that her great son was separated from her.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 20] Although her position was unique from all points of view, saintly Devahūti, in spite of all her possessions, which were envied even by the ladies of the heavenly planets, gave up all such comforts. She was only sorry that her great son was separated from her.

units.sanskrit: वनं प्रव्रजिते पत्यावपत्यविरहातुरा। ज्ञाततत्त्वाऽप्यभून्नष्टवत्सा गौरिव वत्सला॥ ३/३४/२१॥
units.english: [Text 21] Devahūti’s husband had already left home and accepted the renounced order of life, and then her only son, Kapila, left home. Although she knew all the truths of life and death, and although her heart was cleansed of all dirt, she was very aggrieved at the loss of her son, just as a cow is affected when her calf dies.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 21] Devahūti’s husband had already left home and accepted the renounced order of life, and then her only son, Kapila, left home. Although she knew all the truths of life and death, and although her heart was cleansed of all dirt, she was very aggrieved at the loss of her son, just as a cow is affected when her calf dies.

units.sanskrit: तमेव ध्यायती देवमपत्यं कपिलं हरिम्। बभूवाविरतोत्साहा निःस्पृहा तादृशे गृहे॥ ३/३४/२२॥
units.english: [Text 22] O Vidura, thus always meditating upon her son, the Lord Kapiladeva, she very soon became unattached to her nicely decorated home.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 22] O Vidura, thus always meditating upon her son, the Supreme Personality of Godhead Kapiladeva, she very soon became unattached to her nicely decorated home.

units.sanskrit: ध्यायती भगवद्रूपं यदाह ध्यानगोचरम्। सुतं प्रसन्नवदनं समस्तव्यस्तचिन्तया॥ ३/३४/२३॥
units.english: [Text 23] Thereafter, having heard with great eagerness and in all detail from her son, Kapiladeva, the eternally smiling the Lord, Devahūti began to meditate constantly upon the Viṣṇu form of the Supreme Lord.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 23] Thereafter, having heard with great eagerness and in all detail from her son, Kapiladeva, the eternally smiling Personality of Godhead, Devahūti began to meditate constantly upon the Viṣṇu form of the Supreme Lord.

units.sanskrit:
भक्तिप्रवाहयोगेन वैराग्येण बलीयसा। युक्तानुष्ठानजातेन ज्ञानेन ब्रह्महेतुना॥ ३/३४/२४॥
विशुद्धेन तदाऽत्मानमात्मना विश्वतोमुखम्। स्वानुभूत्या तिरोभूतमायागुणविशेषणम्॥ ३/३४/२५॥
units.english: [Text 24-25] She did so with serious engagement in devotion. Because she was strong in renunciation, she accepted only the necessities of the body. She became situated in knowledge due to realization of the Absolute Truth, her heart became purified, she became fully absorbed in meditation upon the Lord, and all misgivings due to the modes of material nature disappeared.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 24-25] She did so with serious engagement in devotional service. Because she was strong in renunciation, she accepted only the necessities of the body. She became situated in knowledge due to realization of the Absolute Truth, her heart became purified, she became fully absorbed in meditation upon the Supreme Personality of Godhead, and all misgivings due to the modes of material nature disappeared.

units.sanskrit: ब्रह्मण्यवस्थितमतिर्भगवत्यात्मसंश्रये। निवृत्तजीवभावत्वात् क्षीणक्लेशाऽऽप्तनिर्वृतिः॥ ३/३४/२६॥
units.english: [Text 26] Her mind became completely engaged in the Supreme Lord, and she automatically realized the knowledge of the impersonal Brahman. As a Brahman-realized soul, she was freed from the designations of the materialistic concept of life. Thus all material pangs disappeared, and she attained transcendental bliss.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 26] Her mind became completely engaged in the Supreme Lord, and she automatically realized the knowledge of the impersonal Brahman. As a Brahman-realized soul, she was freed from the designations of the materialistic concept of life. Thus all material pangs disappeared, and she attained transcendental bliss.

units.sanskrit: नित्यारूढसमाधित्वात् परावृत्तगुणभ्रमा। न सस्मार तदाऽऽत्मानं स्वप्नदृष्टमिवोत्थितः॥ ३/३४/२७॥
units.english: [Text 27] Situated in eternal trance and freed from illusion impelled by the modes of material nature, she forgot her material body, just as one forgets his different bodies in a dream.

parts.sanskrit: नित्यारूढसमाधित्वात् परावृत्तगुणभ्रमा। न सस्मार तदाऽऽत्मानं स्वप्नदृष्टमिवोत्थितः॥ ३/३४/२७॥

“जीवोपाधिप्रभृतय आमुक्तेः सर्वदेहिनाम्।
नियमात् सन्त्यभावस्तु निष्फलत्वादुदीर्यते॥”
इति वाराहे॥ २७॥

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 27] Situated in eternal trance and freed from illusion impelled by the modes of material nature, she forgot her material body, just as one forgets his different bodies in a dream.

units.sanskrit: तद्देहोपगतः पोषोऽप्यकृशश्चाध्यसम्भवात्। बभौ मलैरवच्छन्नः सधूम इव पावकः॥ ३/३४/२८॥
units.english: [Text 28] Her body was being taken care of by the spiritual damsels created by her husband, Kardama, and since she had no mental anxiety at that time, her body did not become thin. She appeared just like a fire surrounded by smoke.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 28] Her body was being taken care of by the spiritual damsels created by her husband, Kardama, and since she had no mental anxiety at that time, her body did not become thin. She appeared just like a fire surrounded by smoke.

units.sanskrit: स्वाङ्गं तपोयोगमयं मुक्तकेशं गताम्बरम्। दैवगुप्तं न बुबुधे वासुदेवप्रविष्टधीः॥ ३/३४/२९॥
units.english: [Text 29] Because she was always absorbed in the thought of the Lord, she was not aware that sometimes her hair was loosened or her garments were disarrayed.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 29] Because she was always absorbed in the thought of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, she was not aware that sometimes her hair was loosened or her garments were disarrayed.

units.sanskrit: एवं सा कपिलोक्तेन मार्गेणाविरहं परम्। आत्मानं ब्रह्म निर्वाणं भगवन्तमवाप ह॥ ३/३४/३०॥
units.english: [Text 30] My dear Vidura, by following the principles instructed by Kapila, Devahūti soon became liberated from material bondage and achieved the Lord, as the Supreme Self, without difficulty.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 30] My dear Vidura, by following the principles instructed by Kapila, Devahūti soon became liberated from material bondage and achieved the Supreme Personality of Godhead, as Supersoul, without difficulty.

units.sanskrit: तद् वीरासीत् पुण्यतमं क्षेत्रं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम्। नाम्ना सिद्धपदं यत्र सा संसिद्धिमुपेयुषी॥ ३/३४/३१॥
units.english: [Text 31] The place where Devahūti achieved her perfection, my dear Vidura, is understood to be a most sacred spot. It is known all over the three worlds as Siddhapada.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 31] The place where Devahūti achieved her perfection, my dear Vidura, is understood to be a most sacred spot. It is known all over the three worlds as Siddhapada.

units.sanskrit: तस्यास्तद् योगविधुतमाशु मर्त्यमभूत् सरित्। स्रोतसां प्रवरा सौम्य सिद्धिदा सिद्धसेविता॥ ३/३४/३२॥
units.english: [Text 32] Dear Vidura, the material elements of her body have melted into water and are now a flowing river, which is the most sacred of all rivers. Anyone who bathes in that river also attains perfection, and therefore all persons who desire perfection go bathe there.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 32] Dear Vidura, the material elements of her body have melted into water and are now a flowing river, which is the most sacred of all rivers. Anyone who bathes in that river also attains perfection, and therefore all persons who desire perfection go bathe there.

units.sanskrit: कपिलोऽपि महायोगी भगवान् पितुराश्रमात्। मातरं समनुज्ञाप्य प्रागुदीचीं दिशं ययौ॥ ३/३४/३३॥
units.english: [Text 33] My dear Vidura, the great sage Kapila, the Lord, left His father’s hermitage with the permission of His mother and went towards the northeast.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 33] My dear Vidura, the great sage Kapila, the Personality of Godhead, left His father’s hermitage with the permission of His mother and went towards the northeast.

units.sanskrit: सिद्धचारणगन्धर्वैर्मुनिभिश्चाप्सरोगणैः। स्तूयमानः समुद्रेण दत्तार्हणनिकेतनः॥ ३/३४/३४॥
units.english: [Text 34] While He was passing in the northern direction, all the celestial denizens known as Cāraṇas and Gandharvas, as well as the munis and the damsels of the heavenly planets, prayed and offered Him all respects. The ocean offered Him oblations and a place of residence.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 34] While He was passing in the northern direction, all the celestial denizens known as Cāraṇas and Gandharvas, as well as the munis and the damsels of the heavenly planets, prayed and offered Him all respects. The ocean offered Him oblations and a place of residence.

units.sanskrit: आस्ते योगं समास्थाय साङ्ख्याचार्यैरभिष्टुतः। त्रयाणामपि लोकानामुपशान्त्यै समाहितः॥ ३/३४/३५॥
units.english: [Text 35] Even now Kapila Muni is staying there in trance for the deliverance of the conditioned souls in the three worlds, and all the ācāryas, or great teachers, of the system of Sāṅkhya philosophy are worshiping Him.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 35] Even now Kapila Muni is staying there in trance for the deliverance of the conditioned souls in the three worlds, and all the ācāryas, or great teachers, of the system of Sāṅkhya philosophy are worshiping Him.

units.sanskrit:
मैत्रेय उवाच-
एतन्निगदितं तात यत् पृष्टोऽहं त्वयाऽनघ। कपिलस्य च संवादो देवहूत्याश्च पावनः॥ ३/३४/३६॥
units.english: [Text 36] My dear son, since you have inquired from me, I have answered. O sinless one, the descriptions of Kapiladeva and His mother and their activities are the purest of all pure discourses.

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 36] My dear son, since you have inquired from me, I have answered. O sinless one, the descriptions of Kapiladeva and His mother and their activities are the purest of all pure discourses.

units.sanskrit: य इदमनुशृणोति योऽभिधत्ते कपिलमुनेर्मतमात्मयोगगुह्यम्। भगवति कृतधीः सुपर्णकेता- वुपलभते भगवत्पदारविन्दम्॥ ३/३४/३७॥
units.english: [Text 37] The description of the dealings of Kapiladeva and His mother is very confidential, and anyone who hears or reads this narration becomes a devotee of the Lord, who is carried by Garuḍa, and he thereafter enters into the abode of the Supreme Lord to engage in the transcendental loving service of the Lord.

english_edits.rule: (the) Supreme Personality of Godhead -> the Lord

meta.english_verbatim: [Text 37] The description of the dealings of Kapiladeva and His mother is very confidential, and anyone who hears or reads this narration becomes a devotee of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is carried by Garuḍa, and he thereafter enters into the abode of the Supreme Lord to engage in the transcendental loving service of the Lord.

notes: Vedabase SB 3.25-3.33 correspond to Setutila's chapters 26-34 (Setutila numbers one chapter higher in Skandha 3). Sanskrit is verse-only in 'sanskrit' (Setutila mula, speaker lines attached to the verse they introduce); Madhva's commentary blocks are in bhashya part and are NOT translated by the English. English = Prabhupada's verse translation per Vedabase 'Text' entry, fetched from the chapter pages. Setutila's verse numbers (from its own '॥ s/c/v ॥' marks) were matched to Vedabase 'Text' numbers; a chapter keeps number pairing only if the Sanskrit and English lengths stay proportional for at least 85% of pairs (align='number'; 385 units). In the other chapters (the two recensions split or number some verses differently, e.g. Setutila 11.8.20 = Vedabase Text 21) the whole chapter was aligned by Sanskrit-to-English length with 1-1, 1-2, 2-1 beads (align='length'; 0 units); spot checks were right but errors can accumulate, so filter on align == 'number' for the safest pairs. Units with align='none' have Sanskrit only (no Vedabase text found for that verse, typically the speaker-intro verse 1). A unit with several Sanskrit verses or Vedabase texts is a group. Prabhupada's translation is interpretive (purport-influenced) rather than literal, so `english` keeps his published wording untouched and `english` is a rule-based neutral variant: only the term swaps listed in meta.english_edits (per unit, with counts) were applied, e.g. '(Supreme) Personality of Godhead' -> 'the Lord', 'devotional service' -> 'devotion', 'living entity' -> 'living being', 'Supersoul' -> 'the Supreme Self', 'demigod' -> 'god', 'sense gratification' -> 'sense enjoyment', 'fruitive activities' -> 'actions aimed at results', 'spiritual master' -> 'teacher', 'pure devotee' -> 'devotee'; honorifics are dropped ('Sūta Gosvāmī' -> 'Sūta Paurāṇika', 'Śukadeva Gosvāmī' -> 'Śukācārya', other 'X Gosvāmī' -> 'X', 'Śrīla' and the honorific 'Śrī' before a name removed; 'Mahārāja X' and 'X Mahārāja' become 'King X'). Nothing was deleted or rewritten beyond these swaps; terms with no neutral equivalent are only listed in meta.english_flags (e.g. 'Kṛṣṇa consciousness'). english is an edit of the source text made for this benchmark, not a published translation; cite meta.english_verbatim, which is the text as published.
